definition.en: A person or company that pays for professional services.

sentence.text: A designer is showing some samples to her client.

scene: In a bright design studio, a designer in her forties with a short black bob and red glasses sits at a round table and shows a fan of fabric color samples to her client, a middle-aged man with a shaved head who leans forward with interest. A cup of tea sits on the table.

definition.en: A book that you read on a screen.

sentence.text: She is reading an e-book in bed before going to sleep.

scene: In bed at night, under a warm reading light, a woman in her thirties with short wavy black hair and striped pajamas reads an e-book on a slim electronic reader held in one hand. The reader's screen shows only a simple picture of a tree. A cup of tea sits on the bedside table.

definition.en: A short written message sent to people at work.

sentence.text: A manager is leaving a short memo on each desk.

scene: Early in the morning in an empty open office, a manager in his sixties with a gray beard and a brown cardigan walks along a row of desks and places a small folded note on each one. The notes are plain white with a few gray lines. The chairs are pushed in and nobody else is there yet.

definition.en: A copy of a document sent through a telephone line.

sentence.text: An assistant is sending a fax to another office.

scene: In a small office, a young assistant with a long black braid feeds a single sheet of paper into an old beige fax machine on a side table. The machine has a few plain round buttons, and the sheet is blank except for a few thin gray lines. A curly phone cord hangs from the machine's handset.

definition.en: Used after a number from one to twelve to give the hour.

sentence.text: The staff meeting starts at three o'clock this afternoon.

scene: In a bright meeting room, a large round wall clock with plain tick marks and no numbers shows exactly three o'clock: the short hand points straight to the right and the long hand points straight up. Below the clock, two coworkers, a young man with a buzz cut and an older woman with a silver bob, pull out chairs at the table to sit down.

definition.en: The time or date by which something must be finished.

sentence.text: The designer is working late to meet the deadline.

scene: Late at night in a quiet design studio with plain pale walls, a designer in her thirties with olive skin and dark curly hair tied up, in a plain white shirt with rolled-up sleeves, works alone at a wooden desk under a warm desk lamp with a focused face, drawing with a pen on a plain gray drawing tablet while she looks at a computer screen that shows only three simple colored shapes: a circle, a triangle and a square. On the wall beside the desk, large and clear, hangs a calendar of empty squares with no numbers or words, and one square is circled in red. The window behind her shows a dark night sky and a crescent moon. The screen shows no words, menus, icons or numbers, the screen and tablet have no logos, and there are no shelves, books or writing. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: To put something in an envelope or package with a letter.

sentence.text: She is enclosing a photo with her letter.

scene: At a wooden desk by a window, a young woman with loose shoulder-length curly brown hair and freckles, wearing a mustard cardigan over a white T-shirt, slides a small photo of a mountain lake into an open envelope, next to a folded letter. The letter is blank with a few faint gray lines, and the envelope is plain. A pen and a small potted plant sit nearby.

definition.en: A person who is making a telephone call.

sentence.text: A caller is waiting on the line for someone to answer.

scene: At home on a sunny afternoon, a caller in his seventies with a white mustache, a flat cap and a knitted vest sits in an armchair and holds a phone to his ear, waiting for someone to answer. He taps his fingers on the armrest and looks toward the window. A small side table beside him holds a cup of tea.

definition.en: The desk or area where visitors arrive and are welcomed.

sentence.text: A visitor is waiting at the reception desk.

scene: In the bright lobby of an office building, a visitor in his sixties with short gray hair and a long camel coat waits at a curved wooden reception desk, holding his hat. Behind the desk, a young staff member with a neat bun makes a short phone call and smiles at him. A tall plant stands beside the desk.

definition.en: A book that explains how to use or fix something.

sentence.text: He is following the manual to set up the new printer.

scene: In a home office, a man in his thirties with dark brown skin and short twists kneels beside a new printer on the floor, holding open a thin instruction booklet. The open pages show only simple drawings of the printer and arrows, with no words. Pieces of packing foam and an open box lie beside him.

definition.en: A small phone that you can carry with you.

sentence.text: A woman is checking her cellphone during a walk in the park.

scene: On a path in a green park on a breezy morning, a woman in her fifties with a short silver pixie cut and a green raincoat stops walking to look at the cellphone in her hand. The screen shows only a soft blue glow with a few colored shapes. Tall trees and a pond are behind her.

definition.en: A person who greets visitors and answers phones at a front desk.

sentence.text: The receptionist is greeting a visitor with a warm smile.

scene: At the entrance of a small office, a receptionist in her twenties with a high black ponytail and a light blue cardigan stands behind a white front desk and greets a visitor with a warm smile and a small wave. The visitor, an older woman with a walking cane, smiles back. A vase of yellow flowers sits on the desk.

definition.en: A piece of furniture with shelves or drawers for storing things.

sentence.text: An office worker is putting files into a metal cabinet.

scene: In a quiet corner of an office, a middle-aged man with a round face, glasses and a striped tie pulls open the top drawer of a tall gray metal filing cabinet and slides a few plain folders into it. More plain folders are stacked on top of the cabinet. A small plant stands beside it.

definition.en: The set of keys you press to type on a computer.

sentence.text: A writer is typing quickly on her keyboard.

scene: Close up at a tidy desk, a writer in her thirties with long straight black hair and a mustard sweater types quickly on a white keyboard, her fingers spread across the keys. The keys are completely blank. A mug and a small plant sit beside the keyboard, and the computer screen above it shows only plain colored blocks.

definition.en: A small computer that you can carry and use anywhere.

sentence.text: A young man is working on his laptop in a coffee shop.

scene: In a cozy coffee shop, a young man with curly red hair and a denim jacket sits at a small round table and works on an open laptop. The laptop screen shows only soft colored blocks. A cup of coffee and a croissant on a plate sit beside the laptop, and warm light comes from a pendant lamp above him.

definition.en: To treat used things so that they can be used again.

sentence.text: An office worker is recycling empty bottles in the break room.

scene: In an office break room, a young office worker with curly red hair drops an empty plastic bottle into one of three colored bins standing in a row. One bin holds bottles, one holds paper and one holds cans. The bins have nothing printed on them; you can tell them apart only by what is inside.

definition.en: A folded cover for keeping loose papers together.
definition.ja: フォルダー、書類ばさみ

sentence.text: She is putting the reports into a blue folder.

scene: At a long meeting table after a meeting, a woman in her forties with a short auburn bob and a gray blazer gathers a few loose sheets of paper and slides them into an open blue folder. The sheets are blank with thin gray lines. Empty chairs surround the table.

definition.en: To make a paper copy of a page with a machine.

sentence.text: A young worker is photocopying some pages for the meeting.

scene: In an office copy room, a young worker with a short black undercut and a white shirt presses a large plain button on a copy machine while warm light passes under its lid. A neat stack of fresh copies comes out into the tray, each page showing only gray lines. A pile of more pages waits on a small table beside the machine.

definition.en: A chart that shows the days, weeks and months of a year.

sentence.text: A woman is hanging a new calendar on the office wall.

scene: In a sunny office kitchen, a woman in her sixties with short curly gray hair and a red cardigan stands on tiptoe and hangs a new wall calendar on a hook. The top half of the calendar is a picture of a flower field, and the bottom half is a grid of completely empty squares. A coffee machine and mugs stand on the counter below.

definition.en: A machine that makes paper copies of documents.

sentence.text: A secretary is putting paper into the copier.

scene: In a bright copy room, a young secretary with a short afro and a lavender sweater bends down and loads a stack of blank white paper into the open paper drawer of a large copy machine. The machine has a few plain buttons and a small blank display. Plain wrapped packs of paper are stacked on a shelf beside her.

definition.en: The place where people go to do their job.

sentence.text: Plants and sunlight make this workplace feel calm and pleasant.

scene: A wide view of a calm open-plan office with large windows and many green plants. Sunlight falls on rows of light wooden desks. A few workers of different ages sit at their desks: a young man with headphones, a middle-aged woman with a gray bob reading papers, and an older man with a beard watering a plant. The atmosphere is quiet and relaxed.

definition.en: To press the buttons on a phone to call someone.
definition.ja: （電話番号を）押す、ダイヤルする

sentence.text: A man is dialing a number on the office phone.

scene: At a wooden desk, a man in his forties with dark brown skin, a shaved head and a light blue shirt holds the handset of a beige desk phone to his ear and presses its buttons with one finger. All of the phone's buttons are plain and blank. A closed notebook and a pen lie next to the phone.

definition.en: A box-shaped part of furniture that slides in and out.

sentence.text: She is looking for a pen in her desk drawer.

scene: At her desk, a woman in her twenties with a long side braid and a green sweater pulls open a desk drawer and searches inside it. The drawer holds rubber bands, a few pens, small blank notepads and paper clips. She smiles as she finds a pen.

definition.en: A short public notice, often posted on a board.

sentence.text: A worker is pinning a bulletin to the board in the hall.

scene: In an office hallway, a worker in her forties with a long gray-streaked braid and a yellow shirt pins a new sheet of paper to a large cork board with a red pushpin. The board is covered with other notices that show only gray lines, small photos of people and colored shapes. A water cooler stands nearby.

definition.en: After the usual hours of your job.
definition.zh: 加班地；在规定时间以外

sentence.text: Two engineers are working overtime to finish the project.

scene: In the evening, in a bright workshop whose large windows show a purple dusk sky, two engineers, a woman with a long black ponytail and safety glasses pushed up on her head and a young man with a messy brown fringe, stand at a workbench and fit the last parts into a small robot model. Takeaway food boxes sit at the end of the bench. Everyone else has gone home.

definition.en: A small object that stores electricity and gives power.

sentence.text: He is changing the battery in the TV remote.

scene: On a sofa at home, a man in his forties with a short brown beard and a gray hoodie opens the back of a TV remote control and puts in a new battery. Two old batteries lie on the coffee table next to a small box of new ones. The batteries and the box are plain with no markings.

definition.en: A flat case for carrying papers and documents.
definition.ja: ブリーフケース、書類かばん

sentence.text: A man is carrying a brown leather briefcase to work.

scene: On a tree-lined city street in the morning, a man in his fifties with dark brown skin, short gray hair and a navy suit walks briskly with a brown leather briefcase in one hand. A few other people walk far behind him. Autumn leaves cover the ground.

definition.en: A small container of ink that fits into a printer.

sentence.text: An office worker is putting a new cartridge into the printer.

scene: A close view of a small home printer with its lid lifted. A man in his fifties with a gray ponytail and a striped shirt presses a small new ink cartridge, about the size of a matchbox, into a row of four slots that hold small cyan, magenta, yellow and black cartridges. An empty small cartridge and its little opened plain box lie on the table beside the printer.

definition.en: To copy files from the web onto your computer or phone.

sentence.text: She is downloading a large file before her flight.

scene: At an airport gate, a woman in her thirties with long braided hair and a teal scarf sits with an open laptop on her knees and watches a thick green progress bar slowly filling up on the screen. The screen shows only that bar. Her small suitcase stands beside her, and a plane is visible through the big window.

definition.en: Colored liquid used for writing, drawing or printing.

sentence.text: An artist is dipping her pen into a bottle of ink.

scene: At a wooden table by a window, an artist in her sixties with long gray hair tied back and a linen apron dips a thin pen into a small glass bottle of dark blue ink. On the table lies a sheet of paper with a simple drawing of a bird and a few blue ink drops. Brushes stand in a jar beside her.

definition.en: A person who designs and builds computer programs.

sentence.text: A software developer is testing a new app on two screens.

scene: In a bright room, a software developer in his twenties with short dreadlocks and a green hoodie sits in front of two computer monitors and holds a phone in one hand, comparing it with the screens. The monitors and the phone show only colored blocks and simple shapes. A potted cactus and a mug sit on the desk.

definition.en: The main office of a company or organization.

sentence.text: The company's headquarters is in a tall glass building.

scene: A tall modern glass office building rises against a clear blue sky, with green trees and a wide plaza in front of it. Small figures of workers walk toward its entrance. The building has no sign, logo or name on it. A few white clouds float above it.

definition.en: Paper, pens and other things used for writing.

sentence.text: The office stationery is arranged by color on one shelf.

scene: A close view of a tidy wooden shelf in an office supply corner. Neat rows of colored pens in cups, stacks of plain notebooks, envelopes, paper clips, rolls of tape and a stapler are arranged by color. A young woman with two puffs of curly hair reaches for a blue notebook. Nothing has labels or writing on it.

definition.en: The forms and documents you must deal with at work.

sentence.text: The new manager has a lot of paperwork on her desk.

scene: At a busy desk, a new manager in her thirties with short black hair and a crisp white blouse sits behind tall stacks of papers and folders and picks up one sheet with a small, patient smile. The papers show only gray lines. A cup of coffee balances on top of one stack.

definition.en: To move to a new place to live or work.

sentence.text: The company is relocating its office to a bigger building.

scene: Outside an old brick office building, two movers, a strong young woman with a ponytail and a man in his forties with a beard, carry cardboard boxes and an office chair toward a moving truck with plain white sides. More boxes and a desk lamp wait on the sidewalk. The boxes are plain with no labels.

definition.en: A computer that is made to stay on a desk.
definition.ja: デスクトップパソコン

sentence.text: An older woman is learning to use a desktop computer.

scene: In a bright community room, an older woman in her seventies with white hair in a bun and a floral blouse sits in front of a desktop computer with a large monitor, holding the mouse carefully. A young volunteer with a shaved head and a friendly smile sits beside her and points at the screen. The screen shows a simple picture of a flower and colored blocks.

definition.en: Working without wires or cables.

sentence.text: He is listening to music with wireless earphones on the train.

scene: On a commuter train in the morning, a young man with a short blond buzz cut and a gray coat sits by the window with small white wireless earphones in his ears, nodding to music with his eyes half closed. No wires hang from his ears. Green fields pass by outside the window.

definition.en: Old-fashioned and no longer useful or modern.

sentence.text: These outdated computers are being carried out of the office.

scene: In an office storage room, a young worker with a red bandana and work gloves lifts a bulky old beige computer monitor from a pile of old machines: chunky monitors, old keyboards and tangled cables. Through the doorway, a new desk with a slim modern monitor can be seen.

definition.en: A small card or sign you wear to show who you are.

sentence.text: Every visitor must wear a badge inside the factory.

scene: At the entrance of a clean factory, a visitor in her thirties with long curly dark hair and a beige trench coat clips a plain blue badge onto her coat. The badge shows only a small simple photo of her face and a blank area. A security guard with a thick black mustache holds out a tray of more blank badges.

definition.en: Someone who works in business, especially as a manager or owner.

sentence.text: A businessperson is reading the news on her phone at breakfast.

scene: In a hotel breakfast room with morning light, a businessperson in her forties with a sleek black bob and a navy suit sits alone at a small table with coffee and toast and reads the news on her phone. The phone screen shows only a small picture and gray lines. A rolling carry-on bag stands beside her chair.

definition.en: A book for writing down your plans and appointments.

sentence.text: She is checking her plans for the week in her planner.

scene: At a small table by a sunny window, a young woman with short pink hair and round glasses holds an open paper planner. Its pages are divided into boxes filled with small colored stickers and tiny drawings of suns and cups, with no words or numbers. A latte and colored pens sit beside it.

definition.en: A person who writes computer programs.

sentence.text: Two programmers are working together at one computer.

scene: In a bright tech office, two programmers share one desk and one large monitor: a woman in her fifties with cropped black hair and big hoop earrings points at the screen, while a young man with a turban and a neat beard types on the keyboard. The screen shows only colored horizontal bars and blocks. Plain colored sticky notes line the edge of the monitor.

definition.en: Not present at a place where you are expected.

sentence.text: One team member is absent from today's meeting.

scene: In a bright meeting room, three colleagues sit at a small round table that has exactly four chairs. The fourth chair stands on the far side of the table, in the middle of the picture, facing the viewer, and it is empty. On the table in front of it lie a closed notebook, a pen and a full cup of coffee that nobody has touched. On the left sits an older man with a bald head and glasses, in a gray sweater; on the right sits a young woman with long straight black hair tucked behind her ears, in a green cardigan; in the front, seen from behind, sits a middle-aged woman with short red hair, in a navy blazer. All three have turned their heads toward the empty chair with slightly puzzled faces, and the red-haired woman points to it with an open hand. There are no laptops, tablets or phones on the table, and no other chairs in the room.

definition.en: A man who works in business, especially as a manager.

sentence.text: A businessman is waving for a taxi outside his hotel.

scene: On a city street in light rain, a businessman in his thirties with slicked-back black hair, a dark overcoat and an umbrella raises one hand to stop a yellow taxi. The taxi's roof light is plain with no writing. A hotel entrance with a red awning is behind him.

definition.en: A small piece of bent wire that holds papers together.

sentence.text: He is holding the pages together with a paper clip.

scene: A close view of hands at a desk: a man's hands slide a shiny paper clip onto the corner of three sheets of paper. The sheets show only gray lines. A small dish of colorful paper clips sits beside the papers, next to a mug of tea.

definition.en: A lawyer who represents people in legal matters.

sentence.text: An attorney is explaining a contract to an older couple.

scene: In a warm law office with wooden bookshelves, an attorney in her forties with long locs tied back and a gray suit sits across a desk from an older couple, a man with a white mustache and a woman with a silver bun, and points to a page of a document. The pages show only gray lines. The books on the shelves have plain spines.

definition.en: Light and small enough to carry easily.
definition.ja: 持ち運びできる、携帯用の

sentence.text: Two friends are playing music on a portable speaker at the beach.

scene: On a sandy beach at sunset, two friends in their twenties, a woman with a short curly bob and a man with a ponytail, sit on a striped blanket next to a small round portable speaker with a carrying strap. They sway and smile. The sea glows orange behind them.

definition.en: A thin, flat computer that you use by touching the screen.

sentence.text: A florist is checking her orders on a tablet.

scene: In a small flower shop full of buckets of tulips and sunflowers, a florist in her thirties with a short brown pixie cut and a green apron stands at the counter and taps on a tablet. The tablet screen shows only pictures of flowers and colored blocks. A half-wrapped bouquet lies on the counter.

definition.en: Sheets of paper joined at one edge for writing notes.

sentence.text: A reporter is taking notes on a small pad.

scene: At an outdoor press event, a reporter in her twenties with a long red braid and a beige jacket listens carefully while writing on a small spiral notepad with a pencil. The pad shows only short gray lines. Behind her, a few other reporters stand in front of a plain podium with no logo.

definition.en: A small tool that joins pages with a thin wire staple.

sentence.text: She is using a stapler to join the pages together.

scene: At a tidy desk, a woman in her sixties with short silver hair and pearl earrings presses down on a red stapler to fasten the corner of a small stack of papers. The papers show only gray lines. A neat pile of stapled handouts sits beside her.

definition.en: The powder ink used in printers and copy machines.

sentence.text: The printer has run out of toner again.

scene: In a small office, a young man with shaggy brown hair and a sweater vest holds a plain black toner cartridge in both hands and looks at a printer with a puzzled smile. The printer's output tray holds a few very faint, nearly blank pages. A new toner box in plain white sits on the table, and the printer has a plain blank display. No speech bubbles, puffs or other comic marks.

definition.en: A small piece of paper with a picture that sticks to things.

sentence.text: He is putting a bright sticker on his water bottle.

scene: At a desk, a young man with curly black hair and a striped T-shirt carefully presses a colorful round sticker of a smiling sun onto his metal water bottle. Other stickers on the bottle show a mountain, a leaf and a wave. A sheet of more picture stickers lies on the desk.

definition.en: A thin covered wire that connects a machine to power.

sentence.text: The power cord is too short to reach the wall.

scene: In a living room, a woman in her thirties with a messy bun, wearing a yellow sweater and jeans, kneels on the floor and pulls a black power cord from a floor fan toward a wall socket. The cord is stretched completely straight and tight between the fan and her hand, and the plug stops a hand's width short of the socket. She looks at the gap with a puzzled frown.

definition.en: A device worn over your ears for listening to sound.

sentence.text: A student is listening to music with headphones in the library.

scene: In a quiet library with tall shelves of books, a student in her twenties wearing a hijab and round glasses sits at a long wooden table with big padded headphones over her headscarf, eyes half closed, gently nodding to music. A closed notebook lies in front of her. The book spines on the shelves are plain colors with no marks.

definition.en: A device that lets a plug fit a different kind of socket.

sentence.text: A tourist is using an adapter to charge her phone.

scene: In a hotel room, a tourist in her twenties with long wavy blond hair and a striped T-shirt kneels by the wall and pushes a white travel adapter into the socket, with her phone's charging cable plugged into it. Her open suitcase lies on the bed behind her.

definition.en: A place where old documents and records are kept.

sentence.text: A man is looking for an old file in the archive.

scene: In a quiet archive room with long rows of tall shelves full of plain gray boxes and old folders, a man in his fifties with a bald head, a neat black beard and a sweater vest stands on a small step stool and pulls out a box. The boxes have no labels. Dust sparkles in a beam of light from a small high window.

definition.en: A device that connects computers to the internet.

sentence.text: He is restarting the modem to fix the connection.

scene: A close view of a home office corner: a man in his twenties with a high-top fade, wearing a green flannel shirt over a white T-shirt, crouches beside a low wooden shelf and presses the plain round button on the front of a small white modem box. The button has no symbol on it. Two short antennas stand up from the top of the box, a row of small green lights glows on its front, and a gray cable runs from its back into the wall. He watches the lights with a hopeful look. There is no laptop, computer, phone or screen anywhere in the picture.

definition.en: A machine sent into space to collect or send information.

sentence.text: A satellite is moving slowly around the Earth.

scene: In deep blue space dotted with small stars, a white satellite with two wide blue solar panels floats above the curve of the Earth, which shows soft green land, blue oceans and swirls of white clouds. No people.

definition.en: A mobile phone that also works like a small computer.

sentence.text: A grandmother is taking a photo with her new smartphone.

scene: In a flower garden, a grandmother in her seventies with silver hair in two short braids and a lavender cardigan holds up a smartphone with both hands and takes a photo of pink roses. The phone screen shows the roses. A watering can stands beside her on the path.

definition.en: To remove writing or marks completely.

sentence.text: The teacher is erasing the whiteboard after class.

scene: In a bright classroom after class, a teacher in her forties with a long dark braid and rolled-up sleeves wipes a large whiteboard with an eraser. Only faint colored smudges and a few blue swirls remain on the board. Empty desks and chairs fill the room.

definition.en: A person who is in charge of a group of workers.

sentence.text: The supervisor is showing a new employee how to use the machine.

scene: On a factory floor, a supervisor in a safety vest stands beside a large machine and points at its control panel, which has a few plain round buttons and switches. A new employee stands next to her, watching closely and holding a notebook.

definition.en: A document that lists goods or services and the amount to pay.

sentence.text: An office worker is handing an invoice to a customer.

scene: In a tidy office on a rainy afternoon, an older office worker with short gray hair and round glasses, wearing a lavender cardigan over a cream blouse, sits at a desk and hands a single sheet of paper across it to a young customer with neat black hair, in a light-blue shirt, who sits opposite her. The sheet is plain, with a colored band at the top and a few thin gray lines. A small potted plant stands on the desk, which is otherwise clear, and rain streaks the window. There is no laptop, computer or phone anywhere in the picture.

definition.en: A person whose job is to keep or check the money records of a business.

sentence.text: The accountant is checking the company's accounts at her desk.

scene: In a quiet office, an accountant in her forties with light brown skin, dark hair in a neat low bun and reading glasses, wearing a gray cardigan over a white blouse, sits at a tidy desk and runs her pencil down a long column of short gray lines in a large open account book. Neat stacks of paper and a cup of tea stand beside the book. There is no calculator, laptop, tablet or phone on the desk.

definition.en: A short document that lists a person's education and work experience, used when applying for a job.

sentence.text: The interviewer is reading her résumé carefully.

scene: A close view across a desk in an interview room: a man in his fifties with short gray hair and a trimmed gray beard, wearing a charcoal suit, holds a single-page résumé in both hands and studies it. The page has a small photo of a smiling young woman in the top corner and several blocks of thin gray lines, with no letters or numbers. On the other side of the desk, the young woman from the photo, who has shoulder-length straight black hair and wears a navy blazer, sits upright with her hands folded. There is no laptop, tablet or phone in the picture.

definition.en: A person who asks to be given something, such as a job or a place at a school.

sentence.text: Four applicants are waiting outside the interview room.

scene: In a bright corridor, four applicants in business clothes sit on a row of chairs along the wall beside a closed wooden door, waiting for their interviews. From left to right: a young man with tan skin and a buzz cut, in a gray suit, adjusting his tie; a woman in her thirties with pale skin, a long dark ponytail and a navy dress, holding a plain folder on her lap; an older man with deep brown skin and short silver hair, in a brown jacket, reading a page of thin gray lines; and a young woman with light brown skin in a soft pink hijab and a beige suit, smiling nervously. The door has no sign. Nobody holds a phone.

definition.en: A person you work with at the same company.

sentence.text: Her coworker is bringing her a cup of tea.

scene: In an open office, a man in his thirties with olive skin, short wavy black hair and a neat beard, wearing a mustard sweater, places a plain white mug of tea on the desk of his coworker. She is a woman in her forties with deep brown skin and short natural hair, wearing a teal blouse, and she looks up from her papers with a grateful smile. The papers show only thin gray lines. No laptops, tablets or phones.

definition.en: An official paper that shows you have finished a course or passed a test.

sentence.text: She is proudly holding up her new certificate.

scene: A close view in an office: a woman in her forties with warm tan skin and wavy shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a rust-colored blazer, smiles proudly and holds up a certificate with both hands so that it fills much of the picture. The certificate is cream paper with a thin gold border, a plain round gold seal with a short red ribbon in one corner, and a few thin gray lines, with no letters or numbers. Behind her, two colleagues smile and applaud softly: a young man with a curly top in a blue shirt and an older woman with short gray hair in a green cardigan.

definition.en: A person whose job is to give advice, especially about money.

sentence.text: A financial advisor is helping an older couple plan their savings.

scene: At a kitchen table in a sunny home, a financial advisor in his thirties with light skin, freckles and neatly combed auburn hair, wearing a light-blue shirt and a dark green tie, points to a simple circle chart drawn on a sheet of paper. The circle is divided into three colored parts, blue, green and orange, with no numbers or words. Across the table, an older couple listens: a man in his seventies with a white mustache and a brown cardigan, and a woman in her seventies with short white curly hair and a pink sweater. Two cups of tea sit on the table. There is no laptop, tablet or phone in the picture.

definition.en: An official check of a company's financial records.

sentence.text: Two experts are carrying out an audit in the records room.

scene: In a small records room lined with shelves of plain cardboard file boxes, two people in business clothes sit at a table covered with open boxes and thick binders, comparing pages: a young woman with light skin and a short pixie cut, in a beige suit, and an older man with dark brown skin and a full white beard, in a brown tweed jacket. A young office worker with a shaved head and a green sweater carries in another box. Every page shows only thin gray lines, and the boxes and binders have no labels. There is no laptop, tablet or phone in the picture.

definition.en: To watch over people or work to make sure that everything is done the right way.

sentence.text: She is supervising two young workers as they plant a tree.

scene: In a city park on a spring morning, a woman in her fifties with sun-tanned skin and short gray hair, wearing a wide straw hat and a dark green work jacket, stands with one hand on her hip and points with the other, watching two young workers plant a small tree. One worker, a young man with shaggy black hair in a brown T-shirt, holds the tree straight; the other, a young woman with short wavy blond hair in a blue T-shirt, fills the hole with soil using a shovel.

definition.en: A person who is learning how to do a job.
definition.vi: học viên, nhân viên tập sự

sentence.text: The trainee is learning how to make coffee.

scene: Behind the counter of a small café, a trainee in his early twenties with tan skin and short curly black hair, wearing a dark green apron over a white T-shirt, carefully pours steamed milk from a small metal jug into a cup. Beside him, an experienced barista in her forties with a silver pixie cut, wearing a brown apron over a striped shirt, gently guides his hand and smiles. The coffee machine has plain round knobs with no symbols, the cups are plain, and there is no menu board.

definition.en: An act of buying or selling something, or of moving money.

sentence.text: The customer is completing the transaction with her bank card.

scene: A close view of a flower shop counter: a young customer with light skin and an auburn bob, wearing a cream trench coat and holding a bouquet wrapped in brown paper, taps a plain blue card on a small card reader. The florist, a man in his forties with deep brown skin, short gray-flecked hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a light green apron over a white shirt, holds out the reader. Its small screen glows plain green, and its keys are plain with no numbers or symbols. The card has no numbers, letters or pictures, and there are no price tags or signs.

definition.en: A small electronic machine used for doing math.

sentence.text: He is adding up the bills with a calculator.

scene: A close view at a kitchen table: a man in his thirties with light brown skin and a short black beard, wearing a gray hoodie, presses the keys of a small white calculator with one finger, while his other hand holds down a few bills, which are plain sheets with thin gray lines. The calculator fills a large part of the picture; its keys are plain light-gray squares with no numbers or symbols, and its small display is blank. A cup of coffee stands nearby.

definition.en: A book used by students to study a subject.

sentence.text: He is studying a thick textbook in the library.

scene: In a quiet library with tall wooden bookshelves, a university student in his twenties with dark brown skin and short twisted hair, wearing round glasses and an orange sweater, sits at a long table with a thick textbook open in front of him. The open pages show a large, simple colored picture of a green plant with its roots and a few thin gray lines, and he marks one line with a yellow highlighter. The books on the shelves have plain spines.

definition.en: A student or young person who works for a short time to get experience.

sentence.text: The new intern is carrying files for the team.

scene: In a busy open office, a young intern in her early twenties with light brown skin and shoulder-length wavy hair, wearing a white shirt, khaki trousers and a blank card on a lanyard, carefully carries a tall stack of plain files with no labels between the desks and smiles. Around her, two older staff members work at their desks with papers: a man with gray temples in a gray sweater and a woman with short curly hair in a red blouse. No laptops, tablets or phones.

definition.en: Words that show you are happy about someone's success or good news.

sentence.text: The guests are offering their congratulations to the newly married couple.

scene: In a sunny garden, a newly married couple stand together: the bride, a woman in her thirties with deep brown skin and her hair in an elegant updo, wearing a simple white dress, and the groom, a man in his thirties with light skin and short sandy hair, wearing a light-gray suit. Guests gather around to congratulate them: an older woman with a gray chignon in a blue dress hugs the bride, and a young man with a black side part in a green suit shakes the groom's hand. Flower petals float in the air.

definition.en: A person who has an important job at a bank.

sentence.text: The banker is explaining a home loan to a young couple.

scene: In a bright private office at a bank, a banker in her fifties with East Asian features, a sleek black bob and pearl earrings, wearing a charcoal suit, sits behind a polished wooden desk and points to a small white model of a house on the desk. Across from her, a young couple listen closely: a man with a mop of curly brown hair in a denim shirt and a woman with short black hair in a yellow sweater. A few sheets with thin gray lines lie on the desk. There is no laptop, tablet or phone in the picture.

definition.en: Behaving in a way that shows respect and good manners toward other people.

sentence.text: A polite young man is holding the door for an older woman.

scene: At the glass door of a small office building, an older woman in her seventies with short white hair, a plum coat and a walking cane walks through carrying a plain shopping bag. A young man in his twenties with light skin and neat brown hair, wearing a navy peacoat, holds the door open for her with one hand and kindly waves her in with the other, smiling, and she smiles back at him. The door and the building have no signs.

definition.en: A period of time when a student works at a company or organization to get experience.

sentence.text: She is doing a summer internship at a science laboratory.

scene: In a bright science laboratory with green summer trees outside the window, a university student in her early twenties with East Asian features and a high ponytail, wearing an oversized white lab coat and clear safety glasses, carefully pours blue liquid into a small glass tube. Beside her, a scientist in his fifties with deep brown skin and a short gray goatee, also in a white lab coat, watches and nods. The bottles and tubes have no labels.

definition.en: A person who plans and arranges an event.

sentence.text: The organizer is showing the workers where to put up the tents.

scene: In a large green park the morning before a festival, an organizer in her thirties with South Asian features and long straight black hair worn loose, wearing a mustard blazer over a white T-shirt and holding a small closed notebook, points across the grass. Two workers in gray T-shirts carry the poles of a white tent toward the spot she shows them: a tall man with a buzz cut and a woman with a short curly haircut. Several plain white tents already stand in a row. The tents have no writing or pictures.

definition.en: To sign up to become a member of a course, school or program.

sentence.text: He is enrolling in an evening cooking class.

scene: At the front desk of a community center, a man in his fifties with medium brown skin, short gray hair and a gray mustache, wearing a red plaid shirt, fills out a short form with a pen. The form has only thin gray lines. Behind the desk, a young staff member with short curly hair and a yellow cardigan points to where he should write. On the wall behind them hang three simple pictures without words: a cooking pot, a paintbrush and a guitar.

definition.en: A meeting or tour that helps new people learn about a place or a job.

sentence.text: New employees are taking a tour of the office during orientation.

scene: In a bright open office, a guide in his forties with Southeast Asian features, short black hair and thin glasses, wearing an olive cardigan, leads a group of five new employees and points toward the kitchen area. The new employees carry plain folders, wear blank cards on lanyards and look around with interest: a tall young man with curly blond hair in a blue shirt, a woman with straight shoulder-length black hair in a white blouse, an older woman with deep brown skin and a short silver afro in a purple jacket, a young man with a black crew cut in a beige sweater, and a young woman with long red hair in a green dress. Nothing has writing or logos, and there are no laptops, tablets or phones.

definition.en: To work together with other people to do something.

sentence.text: Two workers are cooperating to carry a long table through the door.

scene: Two movers carry a long wooden table through the wide doorway of a meeting room, one at each end. One is a man in his thirties with deep brown skin and short locs, wearing a blue work shirt, who walks backward and looks over his shoulder; the other is a woman in her twenties with light skin and a short blond ponytail, wearing an orange T-shirt, who lifts her end and smiles at him. Both hold the table level and keep their steps together.

definition.en: A person who is looking for something, such as a job.

sentence.text: The job seeker is looking for work in the city.

scene: On a busy city sidewalk lined with tall glass office buildings, a young job seeker in his twenties with light brown skin and neat short black hair, wearing a gray suit and carrying a plain black folder under his arm, walks along and looks up at the buildings with a hopeful face. Other people walk past in the background. The buildings have no signs, logos or writing, and nobody holds a phone.

definition.en: Something you say or write to show that you are sorry.

sentence.text: The shop assistant is offering an apology to an upset customer.

scene: At the counter of a clothing shop, a young shop assistant in his twenties with Southeast Asian features and neat black hair, wearing a green polo shirt, bows slightly with one hand on his chest and a sorry face. In front of him, an older customer in her sixties with short white curly hair and a lilac coat holds up a knitted sweater with a small hole in it and looks upset. Folded sweaters lie on shelves behind the counter. The clothes have no labels or tags.

definition.en: The act of taking money out of a bank account.

sentence.text: She is making a withdrawal from the cash machine.

scene: On a city sidewalk, a woman in her thirties with warm tan skin and long wavy black hair, wearing a red coat, stands at a cash machine set into a stone wall and takes a few green banknotes from its slot. In her other hand she holds a plain blue card. The machine's screen shows only a plain blue color, its keys are plain with no numbers or symbols, and the banknotes have only simple border lines, with no numbers or faces. There are no signs on the wall.

definition.en: To tell someone that you are happy about their success or good news.

sentence.text: The manager is congratulating her on her promotion.

scene: In a bright office, a manager in his fifties with tan skin and salt-and-pepper hair, wearing a navy suit, shakes hands warmly with a young woman in her twenties with Middle Eastern features and curly black hair worn half up, wearing a light-gray suit; he rests his other hand on her shoulder and smiles. She beams with joy. Behind them, two colleagues smile and applaud: a young man with curly brown hair in a white shirt and a woman with a sleek gray bun in a black dress. No laptops, tablets or phones.

definition.en: A person chosen to speak in public for a company or group.

sentence.text: The spokesperson is answering questions from reporters.

scene: In a press room, a spokesperson in her forties with medium brown skin and straight shoulder-length hair with bangs, wearing a dark red suit, stands behind a plain wooden podium with nothing on its front and speaks into two small microphones with plain round heads. In front of her, seated reporters raise their hands or write in notebooks: a young man with a black undercut in a denim jacket, an older woman with white hair in a navy cardigan, and a man with a bald head in a brown jacket. There are no cameras, flags, signs or logos, and the wall behind her is plain light blue.

definition.en: A set of drawings, photos or other work that shows a person's skills.
definition.ja: 作品集、ポートフォリオ

sentence.text: She is showing her portfolio to the interviewer.

scene: In a bright design office, a young artist in her twenties with light skin, freckles and wavy copper hair to her shoulders, wearing a striped shirt, opens a large black portfolio case on a table and turns its big pages toward an interviewer. The pages show colorful drawings of a house, a tree and a fox, with no words. The interviewer, a man in his forties with dark brown skin, short graying hair and a black turtleneck, leans in with interest. There is no laptop, tablet or phone in the picture.

definition.en: The ceremony at which students receive their degrees after finishing their studies.

sentence.text: The students are throwing their caps into the air at graduation.

scene: On a sunny lawn in front of an old red-brick university building, a group of young graduates in plain black gowns throw their square black caps high into the air and cheer. In front are a young woman with deep brown skin and short natural curls, a young man with light skin and a red beard, and a young woman with East Asian features and long straight black hair. The gowns, caps and building have no badges, signs or writing.

definition.en: A person whose job is to find new workers for a company.

sentence.text: A recruiter is talking with students at a job fair.

scene: In a university hall during a job fair, a recruiter in her thirties with deep brown skin and a short curly afro, wearing an emerald blazer, stands behind a small table in front of plain blue panels and hands a plain leaflet to two students while talking with a warm smile. The students listen and nod: a young man with wavy brown hair in a hooded jacket and a young woman with long blond hair in a cream sweater. The panels, table and leaflet have no writing, logos or pictures.

definition.en: A person who learns a skill by working for an expert for a period of time.

sentence.text: The apprentice is learning how to shape wood.

scene: In a sunny woodworking shop with plain tools hanging on the wall, an apprentice in her early twenties with light brown skin and dark curly hair tied back, wearing denim overalls over a white T-shirt, pushes a hand plane along a wooden board, making long curls of wood shavings. Next to her, an experienced woodworker in his sixties with light skin and a gray beard, wearing a canvas apron over a checked shirt, points to the board and explains. Sawdust floats in the sunlight.

definition.en: An experienced person who gives advice and help to someone with less experience.

sentence.text: His mentor is giving him advice on his designs.

scene: In a bright design studio, an experienced designer in her sixties with light skin, a white bob and red-framed glasses, wearing a black turtleneck, sits beside a young designer in his twenties with South Asian features and a neat side part, wearing a light-blue sweater, and points with a pencil at a simple sketch of a chair on his large drawing pad. He listens and nods. There is no laptop, tablet or phone in the picture.

definition.en: The land and buildings of a university or college.

sentence.text: Students are walking across the green campus between classes.

scene: A wide, sunny view of a university campus: red-brick buildings with tall windows surround a large green lawn crossed by paths and shaded by big trees. Small groups of students in casual clothes, carrying backpacks, walk along the paths, and a few sit on the grass reading. The buildings have no signs, flags or writing, and nobody holds a phone.

definition.en: A person whose job is to change written words from one language into another.

sentence.text: A translator is working with a thick dictionary at her desk.

scene: At a wooden desk by a window, a translator in her forties with olive skin and dark curly hair pinned up with a pencil, wearing a soft green blouse, reads a letter in one hand and writes on a fresh sheet with the other. A thick dictionary lies open beside her, and more thick books stand on a shelf. All pages show only thin gray lines, and the books have plain covers and spines. There is no laptop, tablet or phone in the picture.

definition.en: A person who is in the same class as you at school or university.

sentence.text: She is lending a pencil to her classmate.

scene: In a university classroom with rows of desks, a young woman in her twenties with light brown skin and long straight dark hair, wearing a green hoodie, turns to the next desk and hands a yellow pencil to her classmate, a young man with pale skin and messy brown hair in a gray sweater, who takes it with a thankful smile. Other students sit at desks behind them. The notebooks show only thin gray lines.

definition.en: A person whose job is to take in and pay out money at a bank.

sentence.text: The teller is counting money for a customer.

scene: Behind a bank counter with a low glass screen, a teller in his thirties with medium brown skin, short black hair and a neat mustache, wearing a light-gray blazer and a dark tie, counts a stack of green banknotes with quick fingers. On the other side of the counter, a customer in her fifties with a gray bob and a camel coat waits with a smile. The banknotes have only simple border lines, with no numbers or faces, and there are no signs or writing anywhere on the counter.

definition.en: An official paper given to a student who has finished high school or university.

sentence.text: A young woman is receiving her diploma on stage.

scene: On a stage with a plain blue curtain behind it, a university president in his sixties with light skin and white hair, wearing a dark robe, hands a rolled diploma tied with a red ribbon to a graduate, a young woman in her twenties with deep brown skin and long locs tied back, wearing a black gown and a square black cap. They shake hands and smile. The heads of the seated audience are visible at the bottom of the picture. Nothing on the stage has writing or badges.

definition.en: The person who leads a meeting or a group.

sentence.text: The chairperson is starting the meeting at the head of the table.

scene: In a formal boardroom with a long wooden table, the chairperson, a woman in her sixties with light brown skin and short silver curls, wearing a deep purple suit, stands at the head of the table with both hands resting on it and speaks to open the meeting. Six board members in dark suits sit along both sides and turn toward her, men and women of different ages and skin tones, including a young man with a red crew cut and an older woman with a gray bob; each has a closed notebook and a glass of water. There are no name plates. There is no laptop, tablet or phone in the picture.

definition.en: A person whose job is to listen to people's problems and give them advice.

sentence.text: The counselor is listening carefully to a student.

scene: In a cozy office with two soft armchairs and a large plant, a counselor in his fifties with light skin and a neat brown beard, wearing a beige cardigan, leans forward with his hands folded and listens. Across from him, a university student in her twenties with dark straight hair in a loose braid, wearing a purple hoodie, talks while looking down at her hands. A plain mug of tea sits on a small table between them. Behind them is a plain light wall with one framed picture of green hills and a tall window; there are no bookshelves or books anywhere in the picture.

definition.en: A person who teaches at a university or college.

sentence.text: The lecturer is explaining a drawing on the board.

scene: In a large lecture hall with rows of seats rising toward the back, a lecturer in his sixties with light skin and thick gray hair, wearing a brown tweed jacket, stands at the front holding a piece of chalk and gestures to a simple chalk drawing of a leaf on a large green board. Students in the rows listen and take notes in notebooks with thin gray lines. The board has no words or numbers.

definition.en: The act of saying goodbye to someone who is leaving.

sentence.text: Her colleagues are saying farewell as she leaves the office.

scene: At the glass entrance of an office, a woman in her sixties with light skin and white hair in a neat bun, wearing a teal coat, turns back with a warm smile and waves, holding a bouquet of flowers and a small box with a plant and a plain mug in it. Inside, three colleagues wave goodbye: a young man with short spiky hair in a blue shirt, a woman with deep brown skin and curly hair in a yellow dress, and an older man with a gray mustache in a sweater vest, who wipes his eyes. The door and walls have no signs.

definition.en: Clothes, especially formal ones worn for work or a special event.

sentence.text: He is checking his formal attire in the mirror.

scene: In a bedroom in the morning, a young man in his twenties with deep brown skin and a short fade haircut stands in front of a tall mirror and straightens his tie. He wears formal attire: a dark navy suit, a crisp white shirt, a burgundy tie and polished black shoes. His reflection is visible in the mirror, and a plain garment bag hangs on the closet door.

definition.en: A person whose job is to make an official check of a company's financial records.

sentence.text: The auditor is checking every page of the record books.

scene: In a meeting room, an auditor in his fifties with light skin, a clean-shaven face and rimless glasses, wearing a navy suit, sits alone at a long table beside tall stacks of thick binders and slowly runs his pen down a page of an open binder with a serious face. The pages show only thin gray lines, and the binders have plain spines with no labels. There is no laptop, tablet or phone in the picture.

definition.en: A person whose job is to change spoken words from one language into another.

sentence.text: An interpreter is helping two business partners understand each other.

scene: At a small meeting table, two business partners sit across from each other: a man in his fifties with light skin and gray hair with a side part, wearing a dark suit, and a woman in her forties with East Asian features and short layered hair, wearing a white jacket. Between them, at the end of the table, an interpreter in his thirties with medium brown skin and short black hair, wearing a gray blazer, turns toward the man and speaks, gesturing with an open hand, while the woman waits beside them. Each person has a glass of water and a notebook with thin gray lines. There is no laptop, tablet or phone in the picture.

definition.en: A meeting where people learn about a subject by doing activities together.

sentence.text: Small groups are sharing ideas at the workshop.

scene: In a bright training room, adults in casual office clothes stand in small groups around three tables and stick square paper notes in yellow, pink and blue onto large white sheets on the wall, talking and pointing. A leader in her forties with tan skin and short spiky gray hair, wearing an orange cardigan, walks between the groups and encourages them. The paper notes are blank, with no writing or drawings. There is no laptop, tablet or phone in the picture.

definition.en: A thin booklet with pictures that gives information about something.

sentence.text: Some brochures have been placed on a stand by the entrance.

scene: Beside the plain glass entrance door of a quiet building lobby stands a slim display stand. Its pockets hold folded brochures whose covers show only small simple pictures and blocks of color. Morning light falls across the floor, and a potted plant stands on the other side of the door. No people.

definition.en: To produce a book, magazine or other work so that people can buy or read it.

sentence.text: The company is publishing her first children's book.

scene: In a print shop, finished books slide off a large printing machine onto a neat stack. Each book has a plain cover with a simple picture of a red bird and no title. The author, a woman in her thirties with medium brown skin and shoulder-length black hair held back by a headband, wearing a coral sweater, holds up the first copy with both hands and smiles with delight, while a print worker in his fifties with a round face, short gray hair and a plain gray work shirt watches. The machine has plain buttons with no symbols.

definition.en: A meeting where a small group of people discuss a subject with an expert.

sentence.text: A small group is listening to an expert at a seminar.

scene: In a quiet meeting room, eight people sit around a U-shaped table with notebooks open. At the head of the table, an expert in his sixties with light skin and wavy white hair, wearing a brown corduroy jacket, explains something with both hands. One participant, a young woman with curly black hair in a white sweater, raises her hand to ask a question. The whiteboard behind him is empty. There is no laptop, tablet or phone in the picture.

definition.en: Shaped like an egg or a stretched circle.

sentence.text: The team is meeting around a large oval table.

scene: A high view of a bright meeting room: a large oval wooden table, clearly egg-shaped with no corners, fills the middle of the picture, with ten gray chairs around it. Five colleagues sit at different places around the table and talk, with notebooks and glasses of water in front of them: a man with a gray beard in a blue blazer, a woman with long black hair in a red sweater, a young man with curly hair in a white shirt, a woman with a blond ponytail in a green jacket, and an older man with a bald head in a brown suit. There is no laptop, tablet or phone in the picture.

definition.en: To move an event or plan to a later time.

sentence.text: The manager is postponing the meeting because of the heavy snow.

scene: In a meeting room with an empty table and chairs, a manager in her fifties with short dark hair streaked with gray, wearing a navy jacket over a cream blouse, stands at a wall calendar made of plain empty squares. There is only one magnet on the whole calendar: a single red round magnet. In the second row, one square near the left end is filled with a pale blue color to mark today, and it is now empty. With her right hand she is placing the red magnet several squares further to the right in that same row. Her left hand rests at her side, holding nothing. Through the large window beside her, heavy snow is falling and the street outside is covered in white.

definition.en: A person who is at an event such as a meeting or conference.

sentence.text: The attendees are listening closely to the speaker.

scene: A view from the front of a conference hall toward rows of seated attendees, who face the viewer and listen with interest. Each attendee wears a blank white card on a lanyard. In the front row, a man in his forties with deep brown skin and a gray suit takes notes, a young woman in a red hijab and a cream blazer smiles, and an older man with white hair and glasses leans forward. Many more people in business clothes sit behind them. There are no banners or signs, and nobody holds a phone.

definition.en: A large formal meal for many people, often to celebrate something.

sentence.text: Many guests are enjoying a banquet in the grand hall.

scene: A grand hall with tall windows and glowing chandeliers is set for a banquet: long tables with white tablecloths are filled with plates of food, candles and flowers, and many guests in evening clothes sit along them, eating, talking and laughing. Waiters in black vests carry silver trays between the tables. There are no menus, name cards or signs.

definition.en: The place where an event, such as a concert or meeting, happens.

sentence.text: A manager is showing two visitors around the party venue.

scene: On an empty rooftop event space with a glass railing, strings of small lights overhead and a wide city view, a manager in his forties with light brown skin and a neat side part, wearing a dark suit, gestures across the space. Two visitors who are planning a party walk beside him and look around: a woman in her thirties with a blond pixie cut and a green coat, taking notes in a small notebook, and a man in his thirties with deep brown skin and a short beard in a beige jacket. Folded chairs are stacked along one side. The city buildings have no signs or writing.

definition.en: A person who reads news or introduces programs on radio or television.

sentence.text: The announcer is reading the morning news on the radio.

scene: In a small radio studio with soft gray walls, an announcer in his forties with deep brown skin, a shaved head and a neat beard, wearing a maroon sweater and large plain headphones, speaks into a big plain studio microphone on an arm while reading from a sheet of paper with thin gray lines. In front of him is a mixing desk with plain sliders and knobs and no labels. There are no screens, signs or lights with writing.

definition.en: Light food and drinks served at a meeting or event.
definition.vi: đồ ăn nhẹ và nước uống

sentence.text: Refreshments are served in the hall during the break.

scene: In a bright conference hall during a break, a long table with a white cloth holds plain coffee pots, white cups, glass jugs of orange juice, plates of cookies and small sandwiches, and a bowl of fruit. Three people chat while helping themselves: a man in his thirties with light skin and a blue blazer pours coffee, a woman in her fifties with dark brown skin and short gray hair holds a cookie, and a young man with East Asian features and a green sweater picks up a glass of juice. Nothing has labels or writing.

definition.en: A person who gives a talk to an audience.

sentence.text: The presenter is speaking to a large audience.

scene: On a stage in a large, dim hall, a presenter in her thirties with olive skin and long wavy brown hair, wearing a bright blue suit, stands beside a big screen and gestures toward it with an open hand while she speaks. The screen shows only a simple picture of a green hill and a yellow sun, with no words or numbers. The backs of the audience's heads fill the bottom of the picture. A small plain microphone is clipped to her jacket.

definition.en: A drawing that uses lines or bars to show how amounts compare.

sentence.text: He is pointing to the tallest bar on the graph.

scene: In a meeting room, a man in his forties with light brown skin and short wavy hair, wearing a navy vest over a white shirt, stands beside a large sheet of paper on an easel and points to the tallest bar of a simple bar graph. The graph has four blue bars, each taller than the one before, rising from left to right, with no numbers, words or labels. Two colleagues sit at the table and look at it: a woman with short red hair in a gray blazer and an older man with a gray crew cut in a brown sweater. There is no laptop, tablet or phone in the picture.

definition.en: A large printed picture or notice that is put up on a wall.

sentence.text: He is putting up a poster for the music festival.

scene: On a plain wooden wall in a small town square, a young man in his twenties with light skin and messy blond hair, wearing a denim jacket, presses the last corner of a large poster onto the wall with a strip of tape. The poster fills much of the picture and shows only a red guitar under a big yellow sun over green hills, with no words or numbers. There are no other posters or signs on the wall.

definition.en: A small thin book with a paper cover that gives information.

sentence.text: A staff member is handing a booklet to each guest at the door.

scene: At the entrance of a conference hall, a staff member in her thirties with light skin and a high bun, wearing a black blazer and a blank name card, hands a small thin booklet to an arriving guest, an older man with a white goatee, a tweed flat cap and a brown overcoat. The booklet has a plain pale-blue cover with a simple picture of a white mountain, and a short stack of the same booklets sits on a small table beside her. The booklets have no titles, letters or numbers.

definition.en: To make a place look more beautiful by adding things to it.

sentence.text: The staff are decorating the hall for the party.

scene: In a large, bright hall with tall windows and plain cream walls, two event staff decorate for a party. A young woman in her twenties with light brown skin and curly hair tied up in a yellow scarf, wearing a striped T-shirt and green trousers, stands on a short wooden step ladder and hangs a long string of paper flowers in pink, white and orange across the wall. Below her, a man in his thirties with pale skin, short red hair and freckles, wearing a green sweater, holds the other end of the string and passes up more paper flowers from an open box. A few round tables with white cloths stand ready. There are no signs, banners or writing.

definition.en: A single printed sheet of paper that tells people about an event, a sale or a business.

sentence.text: A young man is handing out flyers on the street.

scene: A close view on a sunny city street: a young man in his twenties with deep brown skin and short twists, wearing a plain red cap and a white T-shirt, holds a small stack of bright yellow flyers and hands one to a passing woman in her forties with straight black shoulder-length hair, wearing a gray trench coat, who takes it with a smile. Each flyer shows only a large, simple picture of a slice of strawberry cake, with no words or numbers. There are no other signs or posters, and the cap has no logo.

definition.en: To stop someone while they are speaking or doing something.
definition.ja: 中断させる、（話を）さえぎる

sentence.text: A young assistant is interrupting the meeting with a message.

scene: In a meeting room with plain light walls and a large window, a manager in her fifties with short silver hair, wearing a navy blazer, stands at the head of the table in the middle of speaking and stops short, one hand still raised, as the door opens. In the doorway, a young assistant in his twenties with tan skin and neat black hair, wearing a light-blue shirt, leans in holding a small folded note and raises his other hand in apology. Four colleagues of different ages sit at the table with closed notebooks and turn toward the door. There are no computers, monitors, laptops, tablets or phones in the picture.

definition.en: A formal lunch, often for a group of guests or a special event.

sentence.text: The guests are enjoying a light luncheon on the terrace.

scene: On a sunny garden terrace at midday, guests in smart daytime clothes sit at round tables with pale green tablecloths, eating salads, small sandwiches and fruit and chatting. In front, a woman in her sixties with light skin and white hair in soft waves, wearing a lilac dress and pearl earrings, raises a glass of lemonade toward a man in his forties with dark brown skin and short gray hair, wearing a beige suit, who smiles and raises his glass too. Pots of flowers line the edge of the terrace. There are no menus, name cards or signs.

definition.en: A device that you speak into to make your voice louder or to record it.

sentence.text: She is adjusting the microphone before her speech.

scene: A close view on a small stage: a woman in her thirties with East Asian features and short wavy hair tucked behind her ears, wearing a mint-green blazer, lowers a black microphone on a tall metal stand to the height of her mouth with one hand and smiles. The microphone has a plain round black head and a plain body with no buttons, lights or logos. Behind her is a plain dark-blue curtain.

definition.en: A machine that shows pictures or films on a screen or a wall.

sentence.text: He is setting up the projector before the meeting.

scene: In a dim meeting room with plain walls, a man in his forties with light brown skin, short wavy black hair and a trimmed mustache, wearing a gray polo shirt, bends over a small white projector on the table and turns its round lens with two fingers. A wide beam of light from the projector shows a simple picture of a red sailboat on a blue lake on a white screen on the wall. The projector is plain white with no buttons, lights, words or logos, and the screen shows no words or numbers.

definition.en: A room where the directors of a company hold their meetings.
definition.vi: phòng họp hội đồng quản trị

sentence.text: The boardroom is ready for the afternoon meeting.

scene: A wide view of an empty, formal boardroom on a high floor: a long, dark wooden table with twelve leather chairs, a white notebook and a glass of water placed neatly in front of each chair, and a glass jug of water in the middle. Floor-to-ceiling windows show a city skyline under a clear sky. The walls are plain, with one large painting of a calm sea. No people. There are no computers, monitors, screens, phones, name plates or signs.

definition.en: A large room or building with many seats where people watch shows or listen to talks.

sentence.text: The auditorium is filling up before the concert.

scene: A wide view from the back of a large auditorium: many rows of red seats slope down toward a wide stage with a closed dark-red curtain. People in smart clothes walk down the aisles and take their seats, and about half of the seats are already full. Warm lamps glow along the side walls. There are no signs, screens or writing, and nobody holds a phone.

definition.en: A small area with a table or stand where a company shows its products at a fair.

sentence.text: Visitors are stopping at the booth to look at the new teapots.

scene: At a busy trade fair in a large hall, a small booth with plain pale-yellow walls displays colorful ceramic teapots on white shelves and a low counter. A staff member in her thirties with deep brown skin and short curls dyed copper, wearing a white shirt and a teal scarf, pours tea from a yellow teapot into a small cup for two visitors: a man in his sixties with light skin, a white crew cut and round glasses, in a brown jacket, and a woman in her twenties with South Asian features and a long side braid, in a green dress. Other booths stand in the background. The booths, walls, shelves and teapots have no signs, logos or writing.

definition.en: To hit your hands together several times to show that you enjoyed something.

sentence.text: The audience is clapping at the end of the show.

scene: In a theater, a close view of the front row of the audience clapping happily at the end of a show, their hands raised in front of their chests. In the middle, a woman in her fifties with medium brown skin and gray locs tied up, wearing a mustard cardigan, claps and laughs; beside her, a young man with pale skin and a messy blond fringe, in a navy hoodie, claps with a big smile; and an older man with East Asian features, a white mustache and a gray suit claps with his eyes shining. Warm stage light falls on their faces. There are no motion lines or marks around the hands.

definition.en: To come up with many ideas quickly as a group.
definition.ja: ブレインストーミングする、アイデアを出し合う
definition.vi: động não, cùng đưa ra ý tưởng

sentence.text: The team is brainstorming ideas for the new product.

scene: In a bright meeting room with plain walls and a large window, five colleagues sit around a table covered with a big sheet of white paper, colored markers and blank sticky notes in yellow, pink and green. They lean in, talk at once and point at the paper, full of energy. A young woman with tan skin and a black top knot, in a red sweater, raises her hand with an excited face; the others are a man in his forties with deep brown skin and a gray goatee in a blue shirt, a woman in her thirties with light skin and long straight brown hair in a green blouse, a young man with olive skin and short curly hair in a white hoodie, and an older woman with short white hair and glasses in a purple cardigan. The paper shows only colorful circles, squares and wavy lines, with no words, numbers, arrows or symbols. There are no computers, monitors, laptops, tablets or phones in the picture.

definition.en: A very large room used for formal dances.

sentence.text: Two dancers are practicing in the empty ballroom.

scene: A grand, empty ballroom with a shining wooden dance floor, tall arched windows with gold curtains, large wall mirrors and three crystal chandeliers. In the middle of the floor, two dancers practice a waltz: a man in his thirties with light brown skin and slicked-back black hair, in a white shirt and black trousers, and a woman in her thirties with pale skin and red hair in a low bun, in a flowing sky-blue practice dress. There are no tables, no other people, and no signs or writing.

definition.en: A simple drawing that shows how something works or how its parts fit together.

sentence.text: The engineer is explaining the diagram to her team.

scene: In a meeting room with plain light walls, an engineer in her forties with Middle Eastern features and dark wavy hair pinned back with a clip, wearing a gray blazer over a white T-shirt, points with a marker to a large diagram on a whiteboard. The diagram shows a simple water pump: a blue tank, a gray pump and a green tap joined by thick blue pipes, drawn with clean colored lines and no words, numbers, labels or arrows. Three colleagues sit at the table and look at it: a young man with tan skin and a buzz cut in a navy sweater, an older man with light skin and a white beard in a plaid shirt, and a young woman with deep brown skin and short natural curls held back by a headband, in a yellow blouse. There are no computers, monitors, laptops, tablets or phones in the picture.

definition.en: Something added to a place or an object to make it look more attractive.

sentence.text: Bright decorations are hanging above the tables.

scene: A close, upward view of a festive hall: strings of round paper lanterns in pink, orange and white, rows of small triangles of colored paper on strings, and garlands of green leaves hang above long tables set for a party. Tall windows let in soft evening light. No people. The lanterns and paper triangles are plain colors with no words, numbers, pictures or patterns.

definition.en: A meeting in which people in different places see and talk to each other on screens.
definition.ja: ビデオ会議、テレビ会議
definition.vi: hội nghị truyền hình, họp trực tuyến

sentence.text: The team is talking with another office in a videoconference.

scene: In a meeting room with plain light walls, three colleagues sit at a table facing a large screen on the wall and wave hello: a woman in her thirties with light skin and a high blond ponytail in a red blazer, a man in his fifties with deep brown skin and a neat gray afro in a gray suit, and a young man with East Asian features and a side part in a white shirt. The screen is split into three simple boxes, each showing one smiling person waving back from another office: a man with a gray beard, a young woman in a teal headscarf and a woman with short curly black hair. The screen shows only these people, with no words, buttons, icons or numbers. A small plain camera sits on top of the screen. There are no laptops, tablets or phones.

definition.en: A period of time when you rest from work or travel for pleasure.

sentence.text: The couple is relaxing on the beach during their vacation.

scene: On a sunny white-sand beach with turquoise water and palm trees, a couple in their forties relax on two wooden beach chairs under a big striped umbrella: a man with medium brown skin, a shaved head and a short gray beard, in a flowered short-sleeved shirt and shorts, reads a book with a plain cover; a woman with light skin and long wavy auburn hair under a wide straw hat, in a coral sundress, sips a drink with a straw. A small cooler and two pairs of sandals sit on the sand. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: A place where planes take off and land, with buildings for people who are traveling.

sentence.text: A plane is taking off from the busy airport.

scene: A wide, sunny view of a busy airport from a little above: a long terminal building with a curved glass roof, several white planes parked beside it, small service trucks moving between them, and one plane taking off from a long runway in the distance. Green fields and low hills surround the airport. The planes, trucks and buildings have no logos, numbers or writing. No people are seen up close.

definition.en: In or toward the center of a city, where the main shops and offices are.
definition.vi: ở trung tâm thành phố, vào trung tâm

sentence.text: The streets downtown are crowded at midday.

scene: A wide view of a busy city center at midday: tall office towers surround a wide crossing, and crowds of office workers walk across a striped crosswalk. In the background, two yellow taxis wait at the traffic lights, seen from the side, so their fronts and backs are not visible. Street trees and a small park with benches sit at one corner. The traffic lights are plain round lights. The buildings, shops and taxis have no signs, logos, numbers or writing; the taxi roof lights are plain, and no car has a badge, emblem or license plate.

definition.en: The large open area just inside the entrance of a hotel or office building.

sentence.text: Guests are waiting in the hotel lobby.

scene: A wide view of a bright hotel lobby with a high ceiling, a large hanging lamp, a marble floor, soft sofas and big potted palms. A reception desk of light wood stands at the back with a plain wall behind it. Guests wait on the sofas with their suitcases: a man in his thirties with deep brown skin and short locs, in a denim jacket, and an older woman with light skin and a silver pixie cut, in a pink coat, holding a plain paper cup.
