A bellhop in his twenties with tan skin and neat black hair, in a red jacket with gold buttons, pushes a luggage cart across the floor. There are no signs, screens, monitors or writing.

definition.en: The money you pay to travel on a bus, train, plane or taxi.

sentence.text: She is paying the fare to the bus driver.

scene: A close view inside the front door of a city bus: a woman in her fifties with light brown skin and short gray hair with bangs, wearing a green raincoat, drops two coins into a small metal fare box beside the driver's seat. The bus driver, a man in his forties with pale skin, a round face and a brown mustache, in a light-blue uniform shirt with no badges, smiles and nods. Other riders sit inside. The coins are plain gold circles with no numbers or pictures, the fare box is a plain metal box with a coin slot and no screen, and the bus has no signs, route numbers or screens.

definition.en: A person who is on a trip or who travels often.
definition.vi: du khách, người đi du lịch

sentence.text: A traveler is looking at a map in the old town square.

scene: In a sunny old town square with colorful old houses and window boxes full of flowers, a traveler in her twenties with light skin, freckles and short curly red hair, wearing a large green backpack, a gray T-shirt and hiking boots, holds open a big paper map and turns it sideways with a puzzled smile. The map shows only colored shapes and lines for streets and a river, with no words or numbers. The houses have no signs.

definition.en: A train system that runs under the ground in a city.

sentence.text: People are getting on the subway after work.

scene: On a clean underground platform with pale tiled walls, a silver subway train has stopped with its doors open, and people step inside. In front, a man in his fifties with light brown skin, a bald head and glasses, in a navy coat, carries a briefcase, and a young woman with deep brown skin and long cornrows, in a yellow puffer jacket, holds a pole just inside the door. The train, walls and platform have no signs, route numbers, maps, screens or writing.

definition.en: The bags and cases that you take with you when you travel.

sentence.text: A woman is pulling her luggage past a row of empty seats.

scene: In a bright, quiet airport hall with plain light walls and a long row of empty blue seats, a woman in her forties with deep brown skin and short gray locs, in a plain teal sweater, beige trousers and plain brown leather shoes, walks along pulling a wheeled blue suitcase with a small tan bag resting on top of it, with a plain shoulder bag on her other shoulder. Behind her, a big window shows a plain white airplane parked outside, seen from the side, with no logos, letters, numbers or stripes on its body or tail. The suitcase and bags have no tags, labels or logos, and there are no signs, screens, boards or writing. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: The act of paying money to use something for a short time.

sentence.text: He is choosing skis at the rental shop.

scene: Inside a cozy wooden shop in the mountains, long rows of colorful skis stand in racks along the walls and pairs of ski boots line the shelves. A shop assistant in her twenties with light skin and platinum-blond hair under a gray beanie, in a red fleece jacket, hands a pair of blue skis across the counter to a customer, a man in his thirties with medium brown skin and a short black beard, in a plain gray ski jacket zipped up to the chin. The jackets and beanie are plain, with no labels, tags, patches, buttons or marks on the collars or anywhere else. Snowy mountains show through the window. There are no price tags, signs, screens or writing.

definition.en: A vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing the pedals with your feet.

sentence.text: She is riding her bicycle along the river.

scene: On a sunny path along a calm river lined with trees, a woman in her sixties with light brown skin and a short silver crop, wearing a pink windbreaker, beige trousers and a plain white helmet, rides a mint-green bicycle with a front basket holding flowers and a loaf of bread. Ducks swim on the river. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: A person whose job is to help or serve people in a public place, such as on a plane.
definition.vi: nhân viên phục vụ, tiếp viên

sentence.text: The flight attendant is serving drinks to the passengers.

scene: Inside an airplane cabin with rows of blue seats, a flight attendant in her thirties with deep brown skin and a neat bun, wearing a navy uniform with a red neck scarf and no badges, pours orange juice from a plain white carton into a cup for a passenger by the window, an older man with light skin and white hair in a gray sweater, who smiles up at her. Her drink cart stands in the aisle. The cart, cups and carton have no logos or writing, and there are no screens on the seats.

definition.en: Easy to reach or use, saving you time and effort.

sentence.text: The hotel is in a convenient location next to the train station.

scene: A small hotel with a plain red-and-white striped awning stands right beside a train station platform, just a few steps away, where a plain silver train with one plain blue stripe has just stopped. A traveler, a man in his thirties with East Asian features and short black hair, in a plain gray coat, jeans and plain brown leather shoes, pulls a wheeled suitcase the few steps from the platform to the hotel entrance, where a doorman in his fifties with tan skin and a gray mustache, in a plain red jacket with plain gold buttons and a plain red cap with no badge, holds the door open with one hand and welcomes him with the other. The train, platform and hotel have no numbers, letters, logos, signs, boards or screens, and there is no writing anywhere. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A large case with a handle that you use to carry clothes when you travel.

sentence.text: He is packing his suitcase for a business trip.

scene: A close view in a bedroom: a large open red suitcase lies on a bed, and a man in his thirties with tan skin and short spiky black hair, in a white T-shirt, folds a light-blue shirt and lays it inside on top of neatly packed clothes. A pair of shoes, a small toiletry bag and a rolled tie sit beside the suitcase. Behind him is a plain wall with a window. The suitcase has no tags, stickers or logos.

definition.en: The place that someone is traveling to.

sentence.text: The couple has finally reached their destination by the sea.

scene: Seen from behind, a couple in their twenties stand on a green hilltop path with their arms raised in joy, facing a small white village with blue roofs beside a sparkling sea below them. The man has light brown skin and short curly black hair and wears a green backpack; the woman has pale skin and long straight blond hair blowing in the wind and wears a red backpack. A winding path leads down to the village. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: Small and using very little space.

sentence.text: This compact car is easy to park in the city.

scene: On a narrow city street, a tiny two-seat car in bright yellow fits neatly into a small gap between two large black cars parked along the curb. A woman in her forties with East Asian features and a short layered haircut, wearing a white blazer, steps out of the tiny car with a satisfied smile. The cars have no license plates, badges or writing, and there are no signs.

definition.en: An official document or card that shows who you are.

sentence.text: The guard is checking her identification at the entrance.

scene: A close view at the glass entrance of an office building: a security guard in his forties with deep brown skin, short gray hair and a clean-shaven face, wearing a dark-blue uniform with no badges, looks closely at an identification card held up by a woman in her twenties with light skin and wavy brown hair worn half up, wearing a beige trench coat. The card is large in the picture and shows only a small photo of her face and a few colored bars, with no words, numbers or logos. There are no signs, screens or writing.

definition.en: To leave a place, especially to start a trip.

sentence.text: The boat is departing from the harbor on time.

scene: A white passenger boat slowly pulls away from a wooden pier in a sunny harbor, leaving a trail of foam on the blue water. On its deck, passengers wave goodbye; on the pier, a woman in her thirties with medium brown skin and long box braids, in a yellow dress, and a man in his sixties with light skin and wavy gray hair, in a navy cardigan, wave back. Seagulls fly above. The boat has no name, numbers or logos, and there are no signs.

definition.en: To change something for a better or more expensive kind.
definition.ja: アップグレードする、格上げする

sentence.text: The agent is upgrading him to a bigger car.

scene: In a sunny car rental lot, a cheerful agent in her thirties with tan skin and a high black ponytail, in a green polo shirt, hands a car key to a surprised and delighted man in his fifties with light skin, a gray crew cut and a friendly round face, in a navy windbreaker, and points with her other hand to a big, shiny dark-blue car. A small, plain gray car is parked right next to it for comparison. The cars and key have no license plates, badges, logos or writing, and there are no signs.

definition.en: An official document that shows which country you are from and lets you travel to other countries.

sentence.text: She is showing her passport at the check-in counter.

scene: A close view at an airport check-in counter: a woman in her forties with South Asian features and a long dark braid over one shoulder, wearing a mustard cardigan, hands an open passport across the counter to a staff member in his twenties with light skin and a neat blond side part, in a dark-green uniform jacket with no badges. The passport has a plain dark-red cover with no emblem, words or pictures, and its open page shows only a small photo of her face and a few soft colored lines. Behind the counter is a plain wall. There are no computers, monitors, laptops, tablets or phones in the picture.

definition.en: A vehicle with wings and engines that flies through the air.

sentence.text: An airplane is flying over the high mountains.

scene: A large white airplane with a pale-blue tail flies across a clear blue sky above a range of snowy mountains. Small white clouds float below it. The airplane has no logos, letters, numbers or flags. No people.

definition.en: A trip on a large ship for pleasure, often stopping at several places.

sentence.text: An older couple is enjoying a cruise along the coast.

scene: On the sunny top deck of a large white cruise ship, an older couple lean on the railing and enjoy the view of green islands and a blue sea: a man in his seventies with deep brown skin and a white mustache, in a straw panama hat and a light linen shirt, and a woman in her seventies with light skin and silver curls, in a flowing blue scarf and a white cardigan. Deck chairs and a small pool are behind them. The ship has no name, logos or writing.

definition.en: To make a document or membership last for a longer time.

sentence.text: She is renewing her membership at the front desk.

scene: At the front desk of a fitness center, a woman in her thirties with deep brown skin and a short afro under a yellow headband, wearing a gray sports top, takes a bright new blue membership card from a staff member in his twenties with pale skin and a man bun, in a black polo shirt, while her old, faded card lies on the counter between them. Both cards show only colored stripes, with no words, numbers or logos. Behind the desk is a plain wall with a large potted plant. There are no computers, monitors, laptops, tablets or phones in the picture.

definition.en: The act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a trip.

sentence.text: People are waiting at the gate before their departure.

scene: At an airport gate with a big window, travelers sit in rows of seats with their carry-on bags, while a large white plane stands just outside the window, ready to leave. In front, a man in his thirties with light brown skin and a short beard, in a green hoodie, holds a travel pillow; a woman in her sixties with light skin and short gray hair, in a lavender coat, reads a book with a plain cover; and a young man with deep brown skin and a fade, in a red jacket, stands at the window. The plane has no logos or writing, there are no signs, boards or screens, and nobody holds a phone.

definition.en: The bags and cases that you carry when you travel.

sentence.text: People are waiting for their baggage at the carousel.

scene: At an airport baggage claim, suitcases and bags in many colors move slowly around a long, curved carousel belt. A man in his forties with light skin, short brown hair and a clean-shaven face, in a green parka, reaches down to lift a large orange suitcase, while a woman in her twenties with East Asian features and a bright pink bob, in a denim jacket, waits beside him with a small backpack. Other travelers stand along the belt. The bags have no tags, stickers or logos, and there are no signs, screens or writing.

definition.en: A wide main road for fast travel between cities.

sentence.text: Cars are moving fast on the highway.

scene: A wide view from a grassy hillside of a four-lane highway that runs straight across the picture from left to right, through green hills on a sunny day. Small cars in red, white and blue and one large truck all drive toward the right; every vehicle is seen exactly from the side, so its front and back are not visible. Plain white lines are painted on the dark road. A row of trees and a few farms sit behind it. The vehicles have no license plates, badges, emblems, logos or writing, and there are no road signs.

definition.en: To ask someone for information.

sentence.text: A visitor is inquiring about tours at the information desk.

scene: At the information desk in a bright museum hall with stone columns, a visitor in his thirties with Middle Eastern features and a neat side part, wearing a camel coat and a gray scarf, leans on the desk with one hand raised and asks a question. A staff member in her fifties with light skin and shoulder-length gray hair, in a navy cardigan, answers and points to a simple paper floor plan made of colored blocks, with no words or numbers. Large paintings of landscapes hang in the background. There are no signs, screens or writing.

definition.en: Lasting through the night or happening during the night.

sentence.text: They are taking an overnight train to the coast.

scene: Inside a cozy sleeper compartment on a night train, a woman in her thirties with pale skin and a short dark bob with bangs, wearing a soft gray sweater, reads a book with a plain cover in the lower bunk under a small warm lamp, while a man in his thirties with deep brown skin and short twists sleeps in the upper bunk under a blanket. Through the window, the moon shines over dark hills and a few village lights. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: A person who travels some distance to work and back every day.

sentence.text: Commuters are crossing the bridge on their way to work.

scene: In the early morning, many office workers cross a long bridge toward a city skyline in soft sunrise light, some riding bicycles and some walking fast. In front, a woman in her thirties with light brown skin and a sleek high ponytail, in a beige suit and white sneakers, walks with a coffee cup; a man in his forties with pale skin and a red beard, in a navy suit and a plain helmet, rides a black bicycle; and a young man with East Asian features and round glasses, in a gray coat, walks carrying a briefcase. The bridge and buildings have no signs or writing.

definition.en: A building where buses, trains or planes start and end their trips.

sentence.text: Several buses are waiting at the terminal.

scene: Inside a large covered bus terminal with a high arched steel roof, several green-and-white buses are parked side by side at their bays. Travelers with suitcases and backpacks walk along the platform and climb aboard. In front, an older man with light skin, a white beard and a flat-top haircut, in a brown leather jacket, pulls a small suitcase, and a woman in her twenties with deep brown skin and short bleached curls, in a coral hoodie, carries a duffel bag. The buses have no route numbers, names or logos, and there are no signs, screens or writing.

definition.en: A bus or van that makes short trips again and again between two places.

sentence.text: The hotel shuttle is picking up guests at the entrance.

scene: In front of a hotel entrance with glass doors and potted plants, a small white shuttle van waits with its side door open. The driver, a man in his fifties with tan skin and a thick gray mustache, in a light-gray uniform with no badges, lifts a suitcase into the back, while two guests climb in: a woman in her thirties with East Asian features and long straight black hair, in a red coat, and a man in his thirties with pale skin and a curly brown mop, in a green jacket. The van and the hotel have no writing, logos or signs.

definition.en: To travel regularly between your home and your place of work.

sentence.text: She commutes to work by boat every morning.

scene: On the open deck of a small passenger boat crossing a sunny harbor in the morning, a woman in her forties with medium brown skin and short silver locs, wearing a navy business suit and a light scarf, holds a cup of coffee and a briefcase and faces a city skyline ahead. Other office workers stand along the railing. Seagulls fly over the water. The boat and buildings have no signs, logos or writing.

definition.en: The person in charge of a ship or a plane.

sentence.text: The captain is bringing the ship into the harbor.

scene: In the wheelhouse of a large ship, a captain in his sixties with light skin and a full white beard, wearing a white uniform with gold stripes on the sleeves and a white captain's hat with no badge, holds the big wooden steering wheel with both hands. Through wide windows ahead lies a harbor with cranes and a lighthouse. Beside him, a young officer with tan skin and a short black crew cut, in a navy sweater, watches the water. There are no screens, maps or writing.

definition.en: A road vehicle with four wheels and an engine that carries a small number of people.

sentence.text: An old automobile is on display at the museum.

scene: In a bright museum hall with a polished floor, a shiny red automobile from long ago stands on a low platform behind a velvet rope, shown from the side so its long hood, wide curved fenders, running board, round headlights and white-wall tires are easy to see. A man in his seventies with deep brown skin, a white goatee and glasses, in a tweed jacket, and a woman in her thirties with light skin and a red pixie cut, in a striped sweater, admire it. The car has plain silver grille bars and a plain hood with no ornament, badge or emblem on the front, top or wheels, no license plate and no writing, and there are no signs or plaques.

definition.en: A set of connected rooms in a hotel, usually with a living room and a bedroom.

sentence.text: A bellhop is showing the guests into their hotel suite.

scene: A wide view of a spacious hotel suite: in front, a living room with a cream sofa, two armchairs and a low table with a bowl of fruit and fresh flowers; behind, an open double door leads to a bedroom with a large white bed. Tall windows show a city view at sunset. A bellhop in her twenties with deep brown skin and a short pixie cut, in a burgundy vest and white shirt, holds the entrance door open with a smile for a couple in their fifties: a man with light skin and silver hair combed back in a navy blazer, and a woman with East Asian features and a chignon in an emerald dress. There is no television, and there are no signs, screens or writing.

definition.en: A comfortable room where people can sit and relax while they wait.

sentence.text: People are relaxing in the lounge before their flight.

scene: In a quiet, comfortable airport lounge with soft armchairs, low tables, plants and a long window showing a white plane outside, a few travelers relax: a man in his fifties with pale skin and a bald head, in a navy sweater, sips coffee and reads a book with a plain cover; a woman in her twenties with light brown skin and long wavy hair, in a cream knit dress, rests with her eyes closed in an armchair. A buffet table with fruit and pastries stands at the side. There are no screens, signs, boards or writing, and nobody holds a phone.

definition.en: A car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere; a taxi.

sentence.text: She is getting into a cab outside the station.

scene: On a sunny day in front of a train station with a big arched entrance, a yellow cab waits at the curb with its trunk open. The driver, a man in his sixties with a neat gray beard and a dark-blue turban, in a white shirt, lifts a suitcase into the trunk, while a woman in her twenties with light skin and wavy shoulder-length blond hair, in a mint coat, opens the back door to get in. The roof light is plain, the cab has no numbers, logos or writing, and the station has no signs.

definition.en: A small wooden house in a forest or in the mountains.

sentence.text: They are staying in a small cabin by the lake.

scene: A small log cabin with a stone chimney and a wooden porch stands among tall pine trees beside a calm blue lake, with smoke rising from the chimney. On the porch, a couple in their thirties sit in rocking chairs holding mugs: a man with light brown skin and short black hair, in a red flannel shirt, and a woman with pale skin and shoulder-length chestnut waves, in a cream knit sweater. A canoe rests on the lake shore. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: A person who checks tickets and helps passengers on a train.

sentence.text: The conductor is checking tickets on the train.

scene: Inside a bright train car with rows of blue seats and wide windows showing green countryside, a conductor in his fifties with light skin, a gray mustache and glasses, wearing a navy uniform jacket and cap with no badges, checks a plain paper ticket held up by a passenger, a woman in her thirties with deep brown skin and a curly afro puff, in an orange sweater, who smiles at him. Other passengers sit and look out the windows. The ticket shows only a colored band and a few thin gray lines, with no words or numbers, and there are no signs or screens.

definition.en: A paved path for people to walk on beside a street.

sentence.text: People are walking along the wide sidewalk.

scene: A wide, sunny sidewalk lined with young trees and flower boxes runs past cafés with outdoor tables. A woman in her forties with East Asian features and short layered hair with gray streaks, in a white blouse and blue skirt, walks a small brown dog on a leash; a man in his twenties with deep brown skin and short dreadlocks, in a gray tracksuit, jogs past; and an older couple with white hair walk arm in arm. The café awnings and shop windows have no signs, menus or writing.

definition.en: To visit famous or interesting places as a tourist.

sentence.text: The tourists are sightseeing in the old city.

scene: In a sunny old city with stone streets, a small group of tourists in casual clothes stop in front of a grand old stone palace with green domes. A tour guide in her thirties with medium brown skin and a high bun, in a blue dress and a sun hat, points to the palace with an open hand. In front, a man in his sixties with light skin and a bushy gray mustache, in a khaki vest, looks up with wonder, and a young woman with tan skin and wavy black hair, in a yellow T-shirt, shades her eyes with one hand. The buildings and streets have no signs or writing.

definition.en: A system of buses and trains that people use to travel around a city.
definition.ja: 公共交通機関、交通機関

sentence.text: Many people use public transit in this city.

scene: A wide, sunny city view of a busy stop: a modern blue tram has stopped at a covered platform in the middle of the street, a green city bus waits behind it, and people get on and off. In front, an older woman with light skin and short white hair, in a beige coat, steps onto the tram with a shopping bag; a young man with deep brown skin and a high-top fade, in a plain red hoodie with a dark backpack, waits on the platform with nothing on his ears; and a woman in her thirties with South Asian features and a long ponytail, in a gray suit, steps off. The tram, bus and stop have no route numbers, signs, maps, screens or writing, and nobody wears headphones or holds a phone.

definition.en: A structure that sends water up into the air, often in a park or square.

sentence.text: People are resting by the fountain in the square.

scene: In a sunny city square paved with stones, a large round stone fountain sends tall jets of water into the air, and the water sparkles in the sun. People rest on the edge of the fountain: a woman in her twenties with deep brown skin, a shaved head and big hoop earrings, in a lilac sundress, dips her hand in the water, and a man in his fifties with light skin, a round face and short sandy hair, in a white shirt, eats an ice cream cone. Pigeons walk on the stones. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: A narrow road, especially in the country.

sentence.text: A narrow lane winds between the green fields.

scene: A narrow country lane winds between green fields and low stone walls toward a small farmhouse with a red roof. A woman in her sixties with light brown skin and short gray hair, in a yellow raincoat and green rubber boots, walks along the lane with a brown sheepdog. Sheep graze in the fields on both sides. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: A person whose job is to clean rooms, especially in a hotel.
definition.ja: 客室係、ハウスキーパー

sentence.text: The housekeeper is making the bed in the hotel room.

scene: In a bright hotel room with a large window and plain walls, a housekeeper in her forties with East Asian features and short black hair tied back, wearing a light-blue uniform dress, smooths a crisp white sheet over a large bed with both hands. A cleaning cart with folded white towels and spray bottles stands by the door. The bottles and cart have no labels or writing, and there is no television, phone or screen in the room.

definition.en: A fast plane with powerful engines that push it forward.

sentence.text: A private jet is waiting on the runway.

scene: On a sunny airfield, a small, sleek white private jet stands on the runway with its door open and short stairs down. A pilot in his forties with medium brown skin and a short black crew cut, in aviator sunglasses and a white shirt with plain shoulder stripes and no badges, stands at the bottom of the stairs and greets a businesswoman in her fifties with light skin and a silver bob, in a black coat, who pulls a small suitcase. The jet has no logos, letters or numbers, and there are no signs.

definition.en: A boat that carries people and cars across a short stretch of water.

sentence.text: The ferry is crossing the bay to the island.

scene: A wide, sunny view from the side of a large white ferry crossing a blue bay toward a green island with a small harbor town. Small cars stand in a row on its open lower deck, seen from the side and far away. At the railing of the upper deck, passengers in casual clothes look at the island: in front, an older man with light skin and a white beard in a green windbreaker, and a young woman with deep brown skin and long braids in a coral T-shirt, who waves. Seagulls fly beside it. The ferry and the cars have no name, numbers, license plates, badges, emblems, logos or writing.

definition.en: Left alone, with no one watching or taking care of it.
definition.ja: 放置された、置き去りの

sentence.text: A bag has been left unattended in the waiting hall.

scene: In a quiet, bright waiting hall with tall windows, a single dark-green travel bag sits alone on a long wooden bench, with no one near it. Far in the background, a security guard in his forties with deep brown skin and short black hair, in a navy uniform with no badges, notices it and starts walking toward it. The bag has no tags or logos, and there are no signs, screens or writing.

definition.en: A card with a picture on one side that you can send by mail without an envelope.

sentence.text: A tourist is choosing postcards at the gift shop.

scene: A close view inside a small seaside gift shop: a woman in her twenties with light brown skin and long curly black hair, wearing a white sun hat and a coral T-shirt, takes a postcard from a spinning wire rack full of postcards. Every postcard shows only a simple picture, such as a lighthouse, a sailboat, a beach or a sunset, with no words, numbers or stamps. There are no price tags or signs.

definition.en: The part of a vehicle that you use to make it slow down or stop.

sentence.text: She is squeezing the brake to slow down.

scene: A close view of a cyclist riding down a gentle hill on a country road: a woman in her thirties with East Asian features and a short ponytail under a plain white helmet, in a teal cycling jacket, squeezes the brake lever on the handlebar with her right hand, and the bicycle slows before a curve. The brake lever and bicycle have no logos or writing.

definition.en: A short trip that a group of people takes for pleasure.
definition.vi: chuyến tham quan, chuyến đi chơi ngắn

sentence.text: The hotel guests are going on an excursion to the waterfall.

scene: On a forest trail beside a tall waterfall, a small group of hotel guests in casual hiking clothes follow a guide. The guide, a man in his thirties with tan skin and a short black beard, in a khaki shirt and a plain wide-brimmed hat, points to the waterfall with an open hand. Behind him walk a woman in her sixties with light skin and short white hair in a lilac windbreaker, a young man with deep brown skin and short twists in a gray hoodie, and a woman in her forties with South Asian features and a long braid in a green jacket. The falling water and the pool are drawn with soft white foam and gentle ripples only, with no star-shaped sparkles or glints. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: To go somewhere with someone to guide, help or protect them.
definition.ja: 付き添う、案内する、護衛する

sentence.text: A staff member is escorting an older woman to her seat.

scene: In a theater with rows of red seats and warm lights, a young usher in his twenties with light skin and neat brown hair, wearing a black vest and bow tie, gently holds the arm of an older woman in her eighties with deep brown skin and short silver curls, in a plum coat and holding a cane, and walks her slowly down the aisle toward her seat. Other people are taking their seats. There are no signs, numbers or writing on the seats or walls.

definition.en: Above your head, high up in a room or vehicle.
definition.vi: phía trên đầu, ở trên cao

sentence.text: She is putting her bag in the overhead bin.

scene: Inside an airplane cabin with rows of blue seats, a woman in her thirties with pale skin and a short platinum pixie cut, wearing a denim jacket, stands in the aisle and lifts a small black travel bag into an open overhead bin above the seats. Other passengers settle into their seats. The bins and bags have no logos, numbers or writing, and there are no screens.

definition.en: A long passage under the ground or through a mountain.

sentence.text: The cars are driving into a long tunnel.

scene: A wide view from high on a green, rocky mountainside, looking down at a curving road that runs into the round, lit mouth of a long tunnel. A few small cars, seen from above and far away, drive into it. A row of warm lights glows along the inside of the tunnel. The cars are small, plain colored shapes with smooth roofs and backs, with no license plates, badges, emblems, logos or writing, and there are no road signs.

definition.en: A vehicle with two wheels and an engine.

sentence.text: He is riding his motorcycle along the coast.

scene: On a sunny road that winds along cliffs above a blue sea, a man in his forties with medium brown skin and short gray hair, wearing a brown leather jacket, jeans and a plain black helmet, rides a shiny red motorcycle. The motorcycle has no license plate, logos or writing, and there are no road signs.

definition.en: A figure of a person or animal made of stone or metal.

sentence.text: A large stone statue stands in the middle of the park.

scene: In a green city park with paths and flower beds, a large white stone statue of a woman holding a bird stands on a plain stone base in the middle of a round plaza. A couple in their thirties stop to look at it: a man with light brown skin and a curly high-top in a green jacket, and a woman with pale skin and red hair in a high bun in a yellow coat, who points at the statue. The statue and its base have no writing, plaques or numbers.

definition.en: The act of closing a road or a place, so that people cannot use it.
definition.vi: sự đóng cửa, sự phong tỏa

sentence.text: A road closure is sending drivers onto another street.

scene: On a city street, a row of orange and white striped barriers and orange cones blocks the road ahead, where workers are fixing the road surface. A road worker in her thirties with tan skin and a black ponytail under a plain white hard hat, in a bright yellow safety vest, waves cars to turn onto a side street. The vehicles have no license plates, badges, logos or writing, and the barriers have only stripes, with no signs, words or arrows.

definition.en: A long line of cars and trucks that are moving very slowly or not at all.

sentence.text: Cars are stuck in a traffic jam on the bridge.

scene: A close view of a long bridge packed with cars in every lane, all stopped bumper to bumper in the late afternoon sun. In the front car, a man in his fifties with pale skin, thinning gray hair and glasses, in a white shirt, rests his chin on his hand and looks tired; in the next car, a young woman with deep brown skin and short locs sighs with her head back against the seat. The vehicles have no license plates, badges, logos or writing, and there are no signs.

definition.en: A person who is walking, especially in a city street.

sentence.text: Pedestrians are crossing the street at the crosswalk.

scene: A close, sunny view of a city crosswalk with white stripes, seen from the sidewalk at one end so the pedestrians walk toward the viewer. In front, a woman in her sixties with light skin and short gray hair, in a blue raincoat, walks with a shopping bag; a man in his twenties with East Asian features and a black undercut, in a green parka, walks beside her; and a man in his forties with deep brown skin and a shaved head, in a gray suit, carries a briefcase. On both sides of the crosswalk, cars wait at the line, seen from the side, with plain smooth doors. The traffic lights show only plain round colors. The cars have no license plates, badges, emblems, logos or writing, and there are no signs or symbols.

definition.en: A liquid fuel that is used to run car engines.

sentence.text: He is putting gasoline in his car at the station.

scene: At a gas station under a roof, a man in his thirties with light brown skin and a short black crew cut, wearing a red flannel shirt, holds a fuel nozzle in the side of a small blue car. The gas pump is plain white with a black hose, and it has no screen, numbers, logos or writing. The car has no license plate, and there are no signs or price boards.

definition.en: Without being hurt or put in danger.

sentence.text: The swimmer has reached the beach safely.

scene: On a sunny beach, a lifeguard in her twenties with tan skin and a long brown ponytail, wearing a red swimsuit, helps a tired swimmer out of the shallow water: a man in his forties with pale skin and short wet blond hair, in blue swim shorts, who smiles with relief. A yellow rescue float lies on the sand, and calm waves roll in behind them. The float and swimsuits have no writing, logos or symbols.

definition.en: To close or fix something firmly so that it will not come open.

sentence.text: He is fastening his seat belt before the plane leaves.

scene: A close view of a passenger in an airplane seat by the window: a man in his sixties with light skin, a white goatee and round glasses, in a navy cardigan, pulls the two ends of his seat belt together and clicks the metal buckle shut across his lap. Clouds and the wing show through the small window. The buckle is plain metal with no logos or writing, and there are no screens.

definition.en: On or onto a ship, plane, train or bus.
definition.ja: （船・飛行機などに）乗って、乗り込んで
definition.vi: lên (tàu, máy bay, xe), trên (tàu, xe)

sentence.text: Passengers are walking aboard the large white ship.

scene: At a sunny harbor, passengers with bags walk up a wide gangway onto a large white ship. In front, a woman in her fifties with medium brown skin and short silver locs, in a yellow coat, pulls a small bag, and a young man with pale skin and a messy brown fringe, in a blue hoodie, carries a backpack. A crew member in a white uniform with no badges smiles at the top of the gangway. The ship has no name, logos or writing.

definition.en: A person in a hotel whose job is to help guests with information and bookings.
definition.vi: nhân viên hỗ trợ khách (ở khách sạn)

sentence.text: The concierge is showing the guests a good place to eat.

scene: At a polished wooden desk in an elegant hotel lobby with a plain wall behind it, a concierge in his fifties with East Asian features and neatly combed gray hair, wearing a dark suit with a small gold pin, points to a spot on a simple paper map that shows only colored shapes and lines. A couple in their thirties lean over the desk: a woman with deep brown skin and a short afro in a camel coat, and a man with light skin and a red beard in a navy sweater. There are no computers, monitors, laptops, tablets or phones in the picture.

definition.en: A flat wooden floor built outside a house, or the floor of a ship.
definition.vi: sàn gỗ ngoài trời, boong tàu

sentence.text: They are having breakfast on the wooden deck.

scene: On a sunny wooden deck behind a small house, with potted plants along its railing and a garden beyond, a couple in their forties eat breakfast at a round table with coffee, toast and fruit: a man with tan skin and short curly black hair, in a white T-shirt, and a woman with light skin and a wavy blond bob, in a striped shirt. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: To have a view of a place from above.
definition.vi: nhìn ra, nhìn xuống (từ trên cao)

sentence.text: Their hotel room overlooks a quiet harbor.

scene: From a hotel room with a small balcony, a wide view looks down over a quiet harbor with small boats, colorful houses and hills beyond. On the balcony, a woman in her thirties with olive skin and long dark wavy hair, in a white robe, leans on the railing with a cup of tea and enjoys the view. The boats and houses have no names, signs or writing.

definition.en: To pull a car or boat behind another vehicle with a rope or chain.
definition.ja: 牽引する、（車などを）引っぱる

sentence.text: A truck is towing a broken car down the road.

scene: On a country road, seen from the side: a yellow tow truck pulls a small gray car behind it, the front of the car lifted off the ground on the truck's arm, and the car's front tire is flat. The driver, a man in his fifties with deep brown skin and a gray mustache, in a blue work shirt, can be seen through the side window of the truck's cab. The car's front is plain, with smooth grille bars and no round badge in the middle. The vehicles have no license plates, badges, emblems, logos or writing, and there are no road signs.

definition.en: The area next to the sea, often a place where people go on holiday.

sentence.text: The couple is enjoying a walk by the seaside.

scene: Along a sunny seaside path with low white railings, sand and gentle waves, a couple in their seventies walk hand in hand: a man with light skin and a neat white beard, in a beige linen jacket, and a woman with East Asian features and short gray hair, in a pale-blue dress and sun hat. A row of colorful beach huts with plain walls and plain roofs, with no decorations or shapes on them, and a small lighthouse stand in the distance. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: A separate space inside a vehicle or a piece of furniture, used for keeping things.
definition.zh: 隔层；隔间；（车辆的）行李舱

sentence.text: The driver is loading bags into the compartment under the bus.

scene: Beside a long white coach bus with its side luggage compartment open under the passenger seats, the bus driver, a man in his forties with light brown skin and short black hair, in a light-gray uniform with no badges, lifts a suitcase into the compartment, where several bags are already stacked. A woman in her twenties with pale skin and long red hair, in a green coat, hands him her bag. The bus and bags have no route numbers, names, logos or writing.

definition.en: Money that you pay to use a road or bridge.

sentence.text: The driver is paying the toll at the bridge.

scene: A close view at a small toll booth at the entrance to a big bridge: a woman in her forties with light skin and wavy brown hair leans out of her red car window and hands a plain green bill to a toll worker in his sixties with medium brown skin, a round face and short gray hair, in a yellow safety vest, who reaches out from the booth window. The bill has only simple border lines, with no numbers or faces. The vehicles have no license plates, badges, logos or writing, and there are no signs, screens or price boards.

definition.en: A path for people to walk on, often raised or covered.

sentence.text: A long wooden walkway leads to the beach.

scene: A long, raised wooden walkway with simple railings winds across sand dunes and tall grass toward a blue sea. A woman in her thirties with deep brown skin and long box braids, in a white sundress, walks along it carrying sandals in her hand, and a man in his thirties with light skin and a curly brown mop, in a striped T-shirt, carries a beach umbrella. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: A situation in which there are too many cars or people in one place.
definition.vi: sự ùn tắc, tình trạng tắc nghẽn

sentence.text: There is heavy congestion on the roads into the city.

scene: A wide, very high view of a big city at evening, as if from the top of a tall tower: wide roads leading into the city are packed with cars, buses and trucks so far below that they are only small shapes, their red and white lights stretching far into the distance between tall buildings. No vehicle is close to the viewer. The vehicles have no license plates, badges, emblems, logos or writing, and there are no signs or screens.

definition.en: Moving stairs that carry people up or down.

sentence.text: People are riding the escalator to the upper floor.

scene: In a bright, modern train station with a glass roof, people ride a long escalator up to the next floor while others go down on the escalator beside it. In front, a woman in her thirties with East Asian features and a black bob, in a red coat, holds the handrail, and behind her a man in his fifties with deep brown skin and a gray goatee, in a navy suit, holds a coffee cup. There are no signs, screens or writing.

definition.en: Thick cloud near the ground that makes it difficult to see.

sentence.text: Thick fog covers the bridge this morning.

scene: A wide view of a tall suspension bridge in the early morning, with thick white fog covering most of it so that only the tops of its towers and a few cars' headlights show. Soft gray water lies below, and a seagull flies close by. No people up close. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: To control the direction a vehicle or boat is moving in.

sentence.text: He is steering the small sailboat toward the shore.

scene: On a bright blue lake, a man in his sixties with light skin and short white hair, wearing a navy sweater and a cap with no logo, sits at the back of a small white sailboat and holds the wooden tiller to steer it toward a green shore with trees. The white sail is full of wind. The boat and sail have no numbers, names or logos.

definition.en: Not heavy and easy to carry.

sentence.text: Her new lightweight bike is easy to carry up the stairs.

scene: On the stone stairs outside a small apartment building, a woman in her twenties with light brown skin and a short curly afro, wearing a yellow T-shirt and jeans, carries a slim silver folding bicycle up the stairs easily with one hand, smiling. The bicycle has no logos or writing, and the building has no signs.

definition.en: A person who rides a horse, a bike or another vehicle.
definition.ja: （馬・自転車などに）乗る人、騎手

sentence.text: A rider is guiding her horse along the beach.

scene: On a wide, sandy beach at sunset, a rider in her thirties with tan skin and a long dark braid, wearing a cream sweater, riding pants and a plain black helmet, sits on a brown horse and guides it at a slow walk along the edge of the waves. The sky glows orange and pink. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: Below the surface of the ground.

sentence.text: The hotel has a large underground parking lot.

scene: A wide view inside a bright, clean underground parking lot deep below the street, with a low concrete ceiling, rows of lights and painted parking lines. The walls are plain gray concrete with no windows or openings, and no trees, plants or sky can be seen. At the far end, a ramp curves up toward a small bright opening to the street above, showing that the lot is below the ground. Several cars are parked in a row, each seen exactly from the side, so their fronts and backs are not visible, with plain smooth doors. A woman in her forties with pale skin and short dark hair, in a beige trench coat, walks toward a white car with a plain black key in her hand. The pillars and walls have no numbers, letters or signs. The cars have no license plates, badges, emblems or logos, and the key has no marks.

definition.en: A bag that you carry on your back.
definition.ja: リュックサック、バックパック

sentence.text: She is carrying a heavy backpack up the trail.

scene: On a rocky mountain trail with pine trees and snowy peaks behind, a hiker in her twenties with East Asian features and two short braids, wearing a red jacket and hiking boots, climbs with a big green backpack on her back, holding the shoulder straps. A sleeping bag is tied to the bottom of the backpack. The backpack has no logos or writing.

definition.en: Land outside towns and cities, with fields, farms and woods.

sentence.text: They are cycling through the quiet countryside.

scene: A wide view of rolling green countryside with patchwork fields, woods, a red barn and a few cows. Along a narrow road in the middle, two cyclists ride side by side: a man in his thirties with deep brown skin and short dreadlocks, in an orange shirt, and a woman in her thirties with light skin and short blond curls, in a blue shirt, both in plain white helmets. Neither of them wears a watch or anything on their wrists. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: A man whose job is to stand at the door of a hotel or building and help people.
definition.vi: người gác cửa (khách sạn, tòa nhà)

sentence.text: The doorman is opening the door for a guest.

scene: At the tall glass doors of an elegant hotel, a doorman in his sixties with deep brown skin and a neat gray mustache, wearing a dark-green long coat with gold buttons and a matching cap with no badge, holds one door open with a slight bow. A guest in her forties with light skin and a sleek silver bob, in a cream coat, walks in carrying a small handbag. The doors and building have no signs or writing.

definition.en: Not willing to wait calmly for something.
definition.ja: いらいらした、せっかちな

sentence.text: An impatient customer is waiting in a long line.

scene: In a bank hall with plain walls, a long line of customers waits in front of a single open counter. Near the end of the line, a man in his forties with light skin and short spiky brown hair, wearing a gray suit, stands with his arms crossed, frowns and leans to the side to see the front of the line. The others wait calmly. There are no signs, screens or writing, and no motion lines or marks around anyone.

definition.en: A place where two or more roads meet and cross each other.

sentence.text: A police officer is directing traffic at the intersection.

scene: A view from a little above of a busy intersection where two wide roads cross, with white crosswalk stripes on all four sides. In the middle, a police officer in her thirties with medium brown skin and a neat bun under a plain white cap faces the viewer and holds up one open hand to stop the traffic on the road that leads toward the viewer, while her other arm waves the cars on the crossing road through. She wears a long navy uniform coat that covers her belt, white gloves, and no badges. The road that leads toward the viewer is empty. The cars drive only along the crossing road, from left to right and from right to left, each seen exactly from the side, so their fronts and backs are not visible, with plain smooth doors. The traffic lights show only plain round colors. The vehicles have no license plates, badges, emblems, logos or writing, and there are no signs or writing.

definition.en: A large structure built to help people remember an important person or event.

sentence.text: Tourists are visiting the tall stone monument.

scene: In a wide, sunny plaza with trees around it, a tall, pointed white stone monument rises from a stepped stone base. A few tourists in casual clothes stand around it and look up: a man in his fifties with light skin and a bushy brown beard in a red jacket, and a young woman with deep brown skin and short braids in a lilac top. The monument and its base have no writing, plaques, numbers or carvings of letters.

definition.en: To put too many people or things into a place.
definition.zh: 使过于拥挤；使人满为患
definition.ja: 過密にする、（人や物を）詰め込みすぎる
definition.vi: làm cho quá đông đúc, nhồi nhét quá nhiều

sentence.text: The small beach is overcrowded on hot days.

scene: A small, sunny beach is packed with people: colorful umbrellas and towels cover almost all of the sand, swimmers fill the shallow water, and people step carefully between the towels. In front, a woman in her thirties with light skin and long wavy brown hair, in a sun hat, holds a rolled towel above her head and looks for a free spot. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: To clear snow from a road with a large blade, or to turn over soil in a field.

sentence.text: A big truck is plowing snow from the road.

scene: On a snowy country road after a storm, a large orange truck with a wide metal blade on its front pushes thick snow off the road into a high bank at the side. Snow-covered pine trees line the road. The driver, a man with pale skin in a knitted hat, is seen through the windshield. The truck has no license plate, logos or writing, and there are no road signs.

definition.en: A track for trains, or a system of trains and tracks.

sentence.text: A railway runs along the rocky coast.

scene: A wide, sunny view of a railway running along a rocky coast: two shining tracks follow the edge of green cliffs above a blue sea, and a short red train travels along them in the distance. A small stone station stands beside the tracks. The train and station have no names, numbers, signs or writing.

definition.en: The natural features of a place, such as mountains, lakes and forests.

sentence.text: Passengers are enjoying the scenery from the train.

scene: Inside a train car with very large windows and a glass roof, passengers look out at beautiful scenery: snowy mountains, a turquoise lake and dark green forests. In front, a woman in her sixties with East Asian features and short gray hair, in a lavender sweater, presses her hand to the glass in wonder, and a man in his twenties with light brown skin and round glasses, in a green flannel shirt, smiles beside her. There are no signs, screens or writing.

definition.en: A thing such as toothpaste or shampoo that you use to wash and take care of yourself.
definition.zh: 洗漱用品；个人护理用品
definition.ja: 洗面用具、トイレタリー
definition.vi: đồ dùng vệ sinh cá nhân

sentence.text: She is packing her toiletries into a small bag.

scene: A close view of a hotel bathroom counter that shows only a woman's hands and forearms: pale skin, a silver ring, and the sleeves of a plain light-gray sweater. Her hands place a toothbrush into an open, light-pink travel bag. Her face and the rest of her body are outside the picture. Small plain bottles, a tube, a bar of soap and a comb lie on the counter beside it. All the bottles, the tube and the soap have no labels, words, numbers or logos. A folded white towel sits nearby.

definition.en: From or like the hot, wet parts of the world near the middle of the Earth.

sentence.text: Tropical fruit is sold at the market.

scene: At a busy outdoor market under green palm trees, a fruit stall is piled with tropical fruit: pineapples, mangoes, papayas, bananas, coconuts and dragon fruit. The seller, a woman in her fifties with tan skin and black hair in a low bun, wearing a bright orange blouse, hands a mango to a customer, a man in his twenties with light skin and wavy blond hair in a white T-shirt. There are no price tags, signs or writing.

definition.en: A car with four doors and a separate space at the back for bags.
definition.vi: xe sedan, xe hơi bốn cửa

sentence.text: A black sedan is waiting in front of the hotel.

scene: In front of a hotel entrance with stone steps and potted trees, a shiny black four-door sedan waits at the curb, seen fully from the side so that its long, low body, its four doors and its separate trunk are clear. A driver in his forties with East Asian features and short black hair, in a dark suit and white gloves, stands beside it and holds the back door open with one hand. The car has plain, smooth doors, no license plate, badges, emblems, logos or writing, and the hotel has no signs.

definition.en: Money that is given back to you when you return something.
definition.vi: tiền hoàn lại, khoản hoàn tiền

sentence.text: A customer is returning a shirt and getting a refund.

scene: At the service counter of a clothing store, a young customer with a blond ponytail places a folded shirt on the counter with one hand. The clerk behind the counter, a middle-aged man with short black hair, hands back a few blank green paper notes. Neatly folded shirts are stacked on shelves behind him.

definition.en: A person whose job is to sell things to customers in a shop.

sentence.text: A clerk is helping a customer find the right size.

scene: In a bright shoe shop with plain shelves of shoes, a clerk in her twenties with deep brown skin and short natural curls, wearing a green cardigan, kneels on the floor and helps a customer, a man in his sixties with light skin and white hair in a navy sweater, try on a brown leather shoe. Two plain shoe boxes lie open beside them. The boxes and shoes have no labels, logos or writing, and there are no price tags or signs.

definition.en: A piece of paper showing that you have paid for something.

sentence.text: The shop assistant is handing a receipt to a customer.

scene: At the wooden counter of a small, sunny bakery with plain cream walls and baskets of bread on wooden shelves, a shop assistant in her twenties with light brown skin and short curly black hair, in a plain mint-green shirt and a plain cream apron, hands a long, narrow paper slip across the counter to a customer, a man in his thirties with pale skin and a short red beard, in a plain navy sweater, who takes the slip with one hand and holds a paper bag of bread in his other arm. The slip is plain white with only a few thin gray lines, with no words, numbers or logos. There is no cash register, card machine or screen on the counter, and there are no signs or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A written promise from a company to repair or replace a product if it breaks.

sentence.text: She is showing the warranty card to the repair worker.

scene: In a kitchen with plain walls, a woman in her forties with South Asian features and a long dark braid, in a mustard sweater, holds up a small cream card with a gold seal and a few thin gray lines, while a repair worker in his thirties with light skin and short brown hair, in a blue work uniform with no badges, kneels beside an open washing machine with a toolbox and nods. The card has no words, numbers or logos, and the washing machine has plain buttons and no screen.

definition.en: Things that are for sale in a shop.

sentence.text: The staff are arranging new merchandise on the shelves.

scene: In a bright home-goods shop, two staff members arrange new merchandise on white shelves: colorful mugs, vases, cushions and candles. A young man with tan skin and a short black crew cut, in a gray apron, places a stack of blue mugs, and a woman in her thirties with light skin and a red bob, in a gray apron, unpacks a box of cushions. The products, boxes and shelves have no labels, price tags, logos or writing.

definition.en: A small piece of paper that lets you pay less for something.

sentence.text: She is using a coupon at the register.

scene: A close view at a supermarket counter: a woman in her sixties with deep brown skin and short gray locs, in a purple raincoat, hands a small paper coupon to a cashier in his twenties with East Asian features and a side part, in a green polo shirt. The coupon has a dotted border and a simple picture of a bottle of milk, with no words, numbers or symbols. Groceries without labels sit on the counter. There are no screens or signs.

definition.en: A machine used in the home, such as a washing machine or a fridge.
definition.vi: đồ điện gia dụng, thiết bị gia dụng

sentence.text: A couple is shopping for kitchen appliances.

scene: In a large, bright appliance store, rows of white and silver fridges, washing machines and ovens stand on display. A couple in their thirties look inside an open silver fridge: a woman with light skin and shoulder-length brown waves in a coral sweater, and a man with deep brown skin and a short beard in a denim jacket. The appliances have plain doors and knobs, with no screens, logos, labels or price tags, and there are no signs.

definition.en: A large shop that sells food and things for the home.
definition.ja: スーパーマーケット、スーパー

sentence.text: People are buying fresh vegetables at the supermarket.

scene: A wide view inside a bright supermarket: a fresh produce section with colorful piles of apples, oranges, tomatoes, lettuce and carrots on wooden stands, and long rows of shelves stretching to the back. Shoppers with baskets and carts choose vegetables; in front, an older man with light skin and a white mustache in a green jacket picks up a tomato. There are no signs, labels, price tags or writing anywhere.

definition.en: A large building with many shops and restaurants inside.
definition.vi: trung tâm thương mại, trung tâm mua sắm

sentence.text: Many people are shopping at the mall on the weekend.

scene: A wide view inside a large, bright shopping mall with three floors of shops around an open center under a glass roof. People with shopping bags walk along the balconies and across the shiny ground floor, and trees in big pots stand in the middle. In front, a couple in their twenties walk with paper shopping bags: a woman with deep brown skin and a high puff of curls, in a mustard sweater and jeans, and a man with light skin and a short brown beard, in a green jacket. The other shoppers wear varied casual clothes such as coats, sweaters and T-shirts. The shop fronts show only clothes, shoes and colorful goods in the windows, with no names, signs, logos or writing.

definition.en: A long narrow space between rows of shelves or seats.
definition.vi: lối đi (giữa các kệ, dãy ghế)

sentence.text: A worker is stocking the shelves in the aisle.

scene: A view down a long, narrow supermarket aisle between tall shelves full of plain boxes, jars and cans in many colors. In the middle of the aisle, a store worker in his fifties with medium brown skin and a gray crew cut, in a red apron, kneels beside a cart of boxes and places jars on a low shelf. All the boxes, jars and cans have no labels, words or logos, and there are no signs or price tags.

definition.en: A warm knitted piece of clothing for the top half of the body.

sentence.text: He is trying on a warm sweater in the store.

scene: In a cozy clothing shop with wooden tables of folded sweaters, a man in his twenties with deep brown skin and a short fade stands in front of a tall mirror and pulls on a thick cream knitted sweater with a cable pattern, smiling at his reflection. Piles of sweaters in green, gray and red sit on the table beside him. The clothes have no labels, tags or logos, and there are no signs.

definition.en: Something that makes life easier; often used in 'convenience store', a small shop that is open late.
definition.ja: 便利さ、コンビニエンス

sentence.text: He is buying a coffee at the convenience store.

scene: At night, a small, brightly lit convenience store glows on a quiet street corner. Inside, at the counter by the window, a man in his thirties with light skin and a shaggy brown beard, in a gray hoodie, hands coins to a clerk in her twenties with light brown skin and long black hair, in a blue vest, and picks up a paper cup of coffee. Shelves of snacks in plain packages stand behind. The store, packages and windows have no signs, logos, labels or writing.

definition.en: Things such as rings and earrings that people wear to look nice.

sentence.text: She is trying on a ring at the jewelry counter.

scene: A close view at a glass jewelry counter: a woman in her thirties with East Asian features and long straight black hair, in a white blouse, holds out her hand and admires a gold ring with a small blue stone on her finger. Behind the counter, a jeweler in his sixties with light skin, a white beard and glasses, in a dark vest, smiles. Inside the glass case, necklaces, earrings and rings shine on dark velvet. There are no price tags, labels or writing.

definition.en: A person who is buying things in shops.

sentence.text: The shoppers are carrying many bags down the street.

scene: On a sunny shopping street with shop windows full of clothes, two cheerful shoppers walk side by side, each carrying several colorful paper shopping bags: a woman in her twenties with deep brown skin and long braids, in a yellow coat, and a woman in her twenties with pale skin and a short black pixie cut, in a pink jacket. The bags and shop windows have no logos, names, signs or writing.

definition.en: A metal frame on wheels that you push to carry things while you shop.
definition.ja: ショッピングカート、カート

sentence.text: He is pushing a full cart to the car.

scene: In a sunny supermarket parking lot, a man in his forties with tan skin and short wavy black hair, in a navy windbreaker, pushes a metal shopping cart full of grocery bags, bread and a bunch of flowers toward the open trunk of a small green car, seen from the back. The parking spaces are marked only with plain straight white lines, with no arrows or other shapes painted on the ground. The bags and groceries have no labels or logos, and the car has no license plate, badges or emblems. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: Food and other things for the home that you buy at a shop; often used in the plural.

sentence.text: He is carrying two bags of groceries into the kitchen.

scene: In a bright home kitchen with plain cream walls and a window with green plants, a man in his sixties with deep brown skin, a short white beard and a gray flat cap, wearing a rust-colored cardigan, walks in carrying two full brown paper bags of groceries. Bread, celery, carrots, bananas and bottles of milk stick out of the bags, and more groceries wait on the wooden table. The bags, bottles and boxes have no labels, logos or writing.

definition.en: A shop that sells books.

sentence.text: The bookstore is full of tall shelves of books.

scene: Inside a cozy, bright bookstore with tall wooden shelves full of books from floor to ceiling, a rolling ladder, a soft green armchair and warm hanging lamps. A shop assistant in her twenties with light skin and a short red pixie cut, in a mustard sweater and a brown apron, places a book on a high shelf. Near a low table piled with books, two customers each hold a closed book and smile: a man in his forties with East Asian features and round glasses, in a navy coat, and a woman in her seventies with medium brown skin and short silver curls, in a lilac cardigan. Every book is one plain solid color, and the spines and covers have no titles, letters, lines or marks. There are no signs, price tags or writing.

definition.en: A person whose job is to sell things in a shop.

sentence.text: The salesperson is helping a young couple choose furniture.

scene: In a bright furniture store with sofas, armchairs, lamps and rugs set out in small living-room groups, a salesperson in his thirties with light brown skin and a neat black side part, in a light blue shirt and gray trousers, opens his hand toward a soft green sofa. A young couple sits on it, testing it and smiling: a woman in her twenties with light skin and a long auburn ponytail, in a cream sweater, and a man in his twenties with deep brown skin and short twists, in a denim jacket. His shirt has no badge or name tag. There are no price tags, signs, computers, monitors or writing.

definition.en: A person who is selling something.

sentence.text: The seller is giving her old bike to a young man.

scene: On a sunny front lawn during a yard sale, folding tables hold lamps, plates, vases and baskets. An old bicycle stands on its kickstand in the middle of the lawn, seen exactly from the side, with faded pale-blue paint, a worn brown leather saddle and a small wicker basket on the front. A seller in her fifties with East Asian features and short gray hair with bangs, in a yellow sweater and jeans, stands behind the bicycle, rests one hand on the saddle and opens her other hand toward a young man to offer him the bike. The young man, with light skin and short curly blond hair, in a plain orange hoodie, stands just past the front wheel, facing her with both hands clasped together at his chest and a delighted smile. Nobody holds the handlebar. Because the bicycle is seen from the side, only the near grip of the handlebar shows, and the grips are smooth and plain dark brown with no scratches or marks. The frame is smooth and plain, with no rust spots, stickers, badges or marks anywhere, including the front tube under the handlebar, and the pedals are plain. Their wrists are bare. The items have no price tags or stickers, and there are no signs or writing.

definition.en: A small, flat case that folds, used for carrying money and cards.

sentence.text: He is taking a card out of his wallet.

scene: A close view of only a man's hands and forearms, in the sleeves of a navy jacket, with his face outside the picture, above a wooden café table. He holds open a brown leather wallet and pulls out a plain light-blue card; a few more plain cards in green and white show inside the wallet. The cards are completely plain, with no numbers, letters, pictures or chips, and the wallet has no logo or marks.

definition.en: A person whose job is to take money from customers and give change in a shop.

sentence.text: The cashier is giving the customer her change.

scene: At the counter of a small neighborhood food shop with baskets of fruit and bread on shelves behind, a cashier in his fifties with medium brown skin, a gray mustache and a bald head, in a burgundy vest over a white shirt, drops a few coins into the open hand of a customer, a woman in her thirties with light skin and a long dark-blond braid, in a blue raincoat, who holds a paper bag of fruit. The cash register on the counter has no screen and only blank keys, and the coins are plain with no pictures or numbers. There are no computers, monitors, signs, price tags or writing.

definition.en: Comfortable and relaxed, not formal (often used about clothes).
definition.ja: カジュアルな、くだけた

sentence.text: They are wearing casual clothes on the weekend.

scene: On a sunny park lawn, three friends in casual clothes relax on a picnic blanket and laugh together: a man in his twenties with tan skin and a messy black topknot, in a loose gray T-shirt, shorts and canvas sneakers; a woman in her thirties with deep brown skin and short coily hair, in a soft pink hoodie and sweatpants; and a man in his forties with light skin and a brown buzz cut, in an open plaid flannel shirt over a white T-shirt. The clothes have no logos, letters or prints.

definition.en: A piece of clothing.

sentence.text: Each garment is cleaned and hung up carefully.

scene: At the counter of a bright dry-cleaning shop with plain white walls, a clerk in her forties with light brown skin and short dark curls, in a teal smock, hands a long blue dress on a hanger, covered in thin clear plastic, to a customer, a man in his thirties with pale skin and a neat red beard, in a camel coat. Behind her, a long rail holds many other garments, such as coats, shirts and dresses, each on a hanger in a clear plastic cover. There are no tags, tickets, numbers, signs or writing.

definition.en: A large room where things such as cars, furniture or kitchens are shown to people who may buy them.

sentence.text: We are looking at new kitchens in the showroom.

scene: A wide view of a large, bright kitchen showroom with four complete model kitchens side by side, each in a different color: mint green, white, navy and warm wood, with smooth counters, sinks, cabinets, open shelves of plain white bowls and hanging lights. A couple in their fifties walks slowly between them and points at the mint-green kitchen: a woman with East Asian features and a gray bob, in a long beige cardigan, and a man with tan skin and a bushy gray mustache, in a dark green quilted vest. The kitchens have only cabinets with plain bar handles, counters, sinks and shelves, and every surface is plain, with no knobs, buttons, screens, numbers, logos, signs, price tags or writing.

definition.en: A situation in which there is not enough of something.

sentence.text: There is a shortage of bottled water in the shop.

scene: In a supermarket aisle, one long, tall shelf for bottled water is almost empty: only two plain bottles stand on the bottom shelf, and the rest is bare. A woman in her thirties with medium brown skin and a high puff of curly hair, in a mustard raincoat, holds an empty shopping basket and looks at the bare shelf with a worried face. The shelves further down the aisle are full of plain boxes and cans. The bottles have no labels, and there are no signs, price tags or writing.

definition.en: Strong and able to last for a long time.

sentence.text: This hard case is light but very durable.

scene: In a bright luggage shop with plain pale walls, a salesperson in his forties with light skin and a shaved head, in a navy polo shirt, stands with both feet on top of a closed, hard orange suitcase lying flat on the floor, smiling and holding his arms out to show that it does not break. A customer, a woman in her sixties with deep brown skin and short gray natural hair, in a lavender coat, laughs in surprise. Other suitcases in many colors stand along the walls. The suitcases have no logos, tags or writing, and there are no signs.

definition.en: A covering for the hand with a separate part for each finger.

sentence.text: She is putting on her warm gloves.

scene: On a snowy street in winter, a close view of a woman in her forties with light brown skin and long dark hair under a knitted cream hat, in a dark red coat, pulling a thick brown leather glove onto her right hand; the matching glove is already on her left hand. Snow is falling softly behind her. The gloves are plain with no logos or marks.

definition.en: Tools and equipment for the home and garden, such as hammers, screws and locks.

sentence.text: He is buying a hammer at the hardware store.

scene: Inside a small, tidy hardware store with wooden shelves, a man in his sixties with East Asian features, white hair and black-rimmed glasses, in a blue denim work shirt, holds up a new hammer and looks at it closely. The shelves behind him are full of tools: hammers, saws, wrenches, coils of rope, small boxes of nails and screws, and paint cans with colored lids. The boxes and cans have no labels, and there are no signs, price tags, numbers or writing.

definition.en: A person who sells things, often from a small stall or stand in the street.

sentence.text: A vendor is selling hot corn in the park.

scene: In a sunny park, a vendor in his fifties with medium brown skin, a thick gray mustache and a white cap, in a green apron over a checked shirt, hands an ear of hot roasted corn wrapped in paper to a customer, a young woman with light skin and wavy brown hair held up with a clip, in a blue denim jacket. His small cart has a red-and-white umbrella and a grill full of corn. The cart and umbrella have no signs, prices, names or writing.

definition.en: A small bag that a woman carries for money, keys and other small things.

sentence.text: She is looking for her keys in her purse.

scene: At the front door of a house with a plain blue door and potted plants, a woman in her fifties with East Asian features and short black hair with gray streaks, in a cream trench coat, looks inside a small red leather purse with a short handle and searches for her keys with one hand. The purse has a plain gold clasp with no logo, letters or marks.

definition.en: A small stall in the street that sells newspapers and magazines.
definition.ja: 新聞売店、ニューススタンド

sentence.text: He buys a newspaper at the newsstand every morning.

scene: On a city street corner in the morning, a small green newsstand with a little roof is covered with rows of magazines and stacks of newspapers. Every magazine cover is one plain bright color with one simple picture, such as a flower, a cat or a mountain, and the newspapers are folded so that only plain pale gray paper shows. The newsstand owner, a woman in her sixties with light skin and white hair in a low bun, in a brown cardigan, hands a folded newspaper to a customer, a man in his thirties with medium brown skin and short black hair parted in the middle, in a gray overcoat. There are no headlines, letters, numbers, lines of print, signs or writing anywhere.

definition.en: A frame or shelf for holding or hanging things.

sentence.text: She is hanging new dresses on the rack.

scene: In a small clothing boutique with plain white walls and a big sunny window, a shop assistant in her twenties with deep brown skin and a short bleached buzz cut, in a black jumpsuit, hangs a coral dress on a long metal rack on wheels. The rack is already full of dresses in many colors on wooden hangers. The dresses have no tags, labels or writing, and there are no signs.

definition.en: A small thing such as a belt, hat or bag that you wear or carry with your clothes.

sentence.text: She is choosing a belt and other accessories.

scene: In a bright accessories shop with plain white walls, a long white table and wall hooks show sun hats, belts, sunglasses, small handbags and colorful bracelets. A woman in her forties with light skin and long wavy red hair, in a simple navy dress, holds a brown belt against her waist and checks it in a tall mirror, with a straw sun hat in her other hand. The belts have plain buckles, and nothing has logos, letters, tags or price tags. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: A holder made of thin pieces of wood or similar material woven together, used for carrying things.

sentence.text: She is putting fruit into her basket.

scene: At a sunny outdoor farmers market, a woman in her seventies with East Asian features and short white curly hair, in a lilac jacket, puts red apples into a woven basket on her arm, which already holds a loaf of bread and a bunch of carrots. Wooden crates of fruit and vegetables fill the stall in front of her. There are no signs, price cards or writing.

definition.en: The part of a piece of clothing that covers your arm.

sentence.text: The sleeves of this jacket are too long for her.

scene: In the fitting area of a clothing shop with plain beige walls and a tall mirror, a woman in her twenties with Southeast Asian features and short wavy black hair tries on a big gray jacket whose sleeves are so long that they hide her hands completely. She lifts her arms and laughs, and the empty ends of the sleeves hang down. Her friend, a woman in her twenties with pale freckled skin and a copper pixie cut, in a green sweater, laughs beside her. The jacket has no labels or tags.

definition.en: A public sale where each thing is sold to the person who offers the most money.

sentence.text: The painting is being sold at an auction.

scene: In a grand auction room with rows of chairs, an auctioneer in her fifties with medium brown skin and a sleek silver bob, in a dark green suit, stands at a wooden stand and raises a small wooden hammer. Beside her, a large painting of a sunflower field rests on an easel. In the rows of chairs, several people raise plain round white paddles; in front, a man in his forties with light skin and a gray side part, in a navy blazer, raises his paddle high. The paddles are completely blank with no numbers, and there are no signs, screens or writing.

definition.en: Beautiful, graceful and stylish.

sentence.text: She looks elegant in her long green dress.

scene: In a grand hall with soft golden light, a woman in her sixties with light brown skin and silver hair in a smooth updo walks down a curved marble staircase with her chin up, holding the rail lightly. She wears a long dark-green silk gown and small pearl earrings. Tall flower arrangements stand at the bottom of the stairs. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: A soft covering for your foot that you wear inside a shoe.

sentence.text: He is putting on a pair of warm socks.

scene: In a cozy bedroom with plain blue walls on a winter morning, a man in his thirties with tan skin and short dark hair, in gray pajamas, sits on the edge of the bed and pulls a thick yellow sock onto his foot. His other foot already wears the matching yellow sock, and a few more folded pairs of socks in red, green and blue lie on the bed beside him. The socks are plain with no logos or writing.

definition.en: The place in a shop where you pay for the things you buy.

sentence.text: There is a long line at the checkout.

scene: A view of a supermarket checkout: a moving belt carries bread, vegetables, eggs and milk toward a cashier at the end of the counter, a man in his twenties with light skin and a short red crew cut, in a teal apron. Four shoppers with carts and baskets wait in a line behind: at the front, a woman in her fifties with deep brown skin and a short crop of gray coily hair, in a purple coat, and behind her a man in his thirties with East Asian features and a black beanie, in a green parka. The cash register has no screen and only blank keys, the packages have no labels, and there are no signs, numbers or writing.
