definition.en: A long piece of material that you wear around your neck to keep warm.

sentence.text: She is wrapping a scarf around her neck.

scene: On a windy autumn street with orange leaves blowing, a woman in her twenties with deep brown skin and a short rounded afro, in a camel coat, wraps a long red knitted scarf around her neck, and its ends blow in the wind. The scarf is plain with no pattern, labels or writing.

definition.en: To sell small things such as drinks or sweets, often from a machine.
definition.ja: （自動販売機で）売る、販売する
definition.vi: bán (bằng máy bán hàng tự động)

sentence.text: This machine vends cold drinks all day.

scene: In a bright, quiet hall with plain cream walls, a tall drink machine with a glass front shows rows of plain bottles and cans in many colors. A man in his forties with East Asian features and short spiky hair, in a gray suit, bends down and takes a cold bottle of water out of the tray at the bottom. The machine has only plain round buttons, no screen, no prices, no numbers, no logos and no writing, and the bottles and cans have no labels. There are no signs.

definition.en: A product such as lipstick or face powder that people put on their face or body to look nice.

sentence.text: She is trying cosmetics at the store.

scene: At a bright counter in a department store, a makeup artist in her thirties with pale skin and a sleek black high ponytail, in a black smock, gently brushes pink blush onto the cheek of a customer, a woman in her fifties with deep brown skin and short silver curls, in a coral blouse, who sits on a tall stool before a round mirror. On the glass counter are lipsticks, small round powder cases, brushes and little bottles. None of the cosmetics have labels, logos, letters or writing, and there are no signs.

definition.en: An old object that is worth a lot of money because of its age or beauty.

sentence.text: This old chair is a fine antique.

scene: Inside a cozy antique shop with warm light and a wooden floor, full of old things: carved wooden chairs, a brass lamp, a gramophone with a big horn, china teapots and a painted vase. A man in his seventies with light skin, a white goatee and round glasses, in a tweed vest, gently runs his hand along the carved back of an old wooden chair and admires it. There are no price tags, signs or writing.

definition.en: To look at things in a shop slowly, without a plan to buy anything.
definition.ja: （店の商品を）見て回る、ぶらぶら見る

sentence.text: She likes to browse in small shops.

scene: In a small, sunny pottery shop with wooden shelves of handmade cups, bowls and vases in soft colors, a woman in her forties with medium brown skin and long locs tied back with a yellow band, in an olive linen shirt, strolls slowly along the shelves. She picks up a blue cup and turns it in her hand with a relaxed smile, carrying no shopping bag. There are no signs, price tags or writing.

definition.en: Material used for making clothes, curtains and other things.

sentence.text: She is choosing fabric for new curtains.

scene: In a fabric shop with walls of tall rolls of cloth in many colors and patterns, plain, dotted, floral and checked, a woman in her thirties with East Asian features and a long side braid, in a mustard cardigan, unrolls a length of soft green fabric with small white flowers across a wide wooden cutting table and feels it with her hand. Large scissors lie beside it. There are no tags, labels, rulers, numbers or writing.

definition.en: A business that sells cars, usually made by one company.
definition.ja: （自動車の）販売店、ディーラー

sentence.text: She is buying a new car at the dealership.

scene: A sunny view of a car dealership: in front of a low glass building, a row of new cars in red, white, blue and silver is parked side by side on a straight line, each seen exactly from the side, so their fronts and backs are not visible, with plain smooth doors. A salesperson in his thirties with light skin and a short brown quiff, in a white shirt and dark tie, shakes hands with a buyer, a woman in her forties with medium brown skin and long black hair in a low ponytail, in a mustard blazer, in front of the red car, which has a big white ribbon bow on its roof. The cars have no license plates, badges, emblems, logos or writing, and the building has no signs or writing.

definition.en: A book with a soft paper cover.
definition.ja: ペーパーバック、ソフトカバーの本

sentence.text: She always takes a paperback to the beach.

scene: On a sunny beach, a woman in her fifties with light skin and short ash-blonde hair, in a wide straw hat and a turquoise cover-up, lies on a deck chair under a blue umbrella and reads a thin paperback book whose soft cover bends back in her hand. The pages face her, so only the back cover shows: it is plain pale blue with one simple picture of a sailboat. There is no title, letters or writing on the cover or the spine.

definition.en: A long, narrow band of color.

sentence.text: He is painting a blue stripe on the wall.

scene: In a bright, empty room with plain white walls, a man in his twenties with deep brown skin and short dreadlocks, in white overalls with a few paint spots, rolls a wide light-blue stripe across the wall with a paint roller, between two strips of tape. A yellow stripe and a green stripe are already painted above it. Paint cans with colored lids sit on a cloth on the floor. The cans have no labels, and there is no writing.

definition.en: A person who buys and sells things, often in large amounts.

sentence.text: The spice merchant has many customers today.

scene: In a busy covered market, a spice merchant in his sixties with medium brown skin, a full gray beard and a white knitted cap, in a long blue tunic, weighs bright red spice on an old brass balance scale for a customer, a woman in her thirties with light brown skin and short black curls, in a mustard coat. Around him are big open sacks and bowls of spices in red, yellow, orange and brown, piled into cones, and more customers wait behind her. The scale uses plain round weights with no numbers, and there are no signs, tags or writing.

definition.en: A person whose job is to make or repair clothes, especially suits.

sentence.text: The tailor is making the trousers shorter.

scene: In a tailor's shop with plain cream walls, a big mirror, a dress form wearing a half-finished gray jacket and rolls of cloth on shelves, a tailor in his sixties with East Asian features, neat gray hair and small round glasses, in a white shirt and a brown vest, kneels and pins the bottom of a customer's navy trousers. The customer, a young man with tan skin and short wavy black hair, in a white shirt, stands on a low wooden box in front of the mirror. A red pincushion and chalk lie on a small table. There is no tape measure, and there are no tags, labels, numbers or writing.

definition.en: A set of clothes that you wear together.
definition.ja: 衣装一式、コーディネート

sentence.text: She is wearing a new outfit to the party.

scene: In a bright bedroom with plain peach walls, a woman in her thirties with medium brown skin and long wavy dark hair, wearing a complete matching outfit of a mustard beret, a cream blouse, a rust-colored skirt and brown ankle boots, turns in front of a tall mirror. Her friend, a man in his thirties with light skin and a neat brown beard, in a gray sweater, sits on the bed and gives a big thumbs-up. Two other complete outfits are laid out side by side on the bed. The clothes have no logos, tags or writing.

definition.en: A chain of gold, silver or beads that you wear around your neck.

sentence.text: Her friend is helping her put on a necklace.

scene: In a cozy bedroom with plain pink walls, in front of a round mirror on a wooden dresser, a woman in her twenties with East Asian features and long straight black hair, in a dusty-pink dress, lifts her hair while her friend, a woman in her twenties with deep brown skin and short bleached curls, in a white shirt, fastens a thin gold necklace with a small round pearl behind her neck. The necklace and the open box on the dresser have no logos, letters or writing.

definition.en: The soft, thick hair of sheep, used to make yarn and warm clothes.

sentence.text: The farmer is holding a pile of soft wool.

scene: On a green farm on a sunny day, a farmer in her fifties with light skin, rosy cheeks and short gray hair, in a blue checked shirt and brown overalls, holds a big, fluffy armful of white wool and smiles. Behind her, three sheep with thick woolly coats eat grass near a wooden fence, and two baskets full of more wool sit on a bench. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: A very hard, clear stone that is worth a lot of money and is often used in rings.

sentence.text: The jeweler is looking closely at a diamond.

scene: A close view at a jeweler's desk: a jeweler in his sixties with medium brown skin, a neat white mustache and a small magnifying lens over one eye, in a dark blue vest, holds a single clear diamond in thin metal tweezers under a bright desk lamp. The diamond is cut with many flat faces and looks clear and bright, like clean glass. A small black velvet tray with a few more diamonds lies on the desk. There are no labels, tags or writing.

definition.en: Trousers made of strong blue cotton.

sentence.text: He is folding jeans on the table.

scene: In a bright clothing shop with plain white walls, a shop assistant in his twenties with light brown skin and a curly mop of black hair, in a mustard T-shirt, folds a pair of blue jeans on a wooden table, where neat stacks of jeans in light blue, dark blue and black stand. More jeans hang on the wall behind him. The jeans have no labels, leather patches, tags, logos or writing.

definition.en: A coat that keeps you dry in the rain.

sentence.text: She is wearing a yellow raincoat in the rain.

scene: On a rainy city street with puddles, a woman in her sixties with pale skin and a short white pixie cut walks happily through the rain in a bright yellow raincoat with the hood up and green rain boots, while raindrops splash around her feet. The raincoat and boots have no logos or writing, and there are no signs.

definition.en: A shop where people go to have their hair cut or styled.

sentence.text: She is getting her hair cut at the salon.

scene: Inside a bright hair salon with big mirrors, plants and soft chairs, a hairstylist in his thirties with light skin and a tall swept-back blond quiff, in a black apron, trims the hair of a customer, a woman in her forties with medium brown skin and shoulder-length wavy dark hair, who sits wrapped in a gray cape. In the back, another customer sits under a hood hair dryer. The bottles on the shelves have no labels, and there are no signs or writing.

definition.en: To join pieces of material together, or fix something to material, using a needle and thread.

sentence.text: She is sewing a button onto the shirt.

scene: A close view of only a pair of hands with medium brown skin and the sleeves of a lilac sweater, with the face outside the picture, sewing a white button onto a light blue shirt with a needle and white thread. The shirt lies on a wooden table beside an open sewing box with spools of colored thread and a pincushion. There are no labels or writing.

definition.en: A small clock that you wear on your wrist.

sentence.text: He looks at his wristwatch on the street.

scene: A close view of a man in his thirties with tan skin and short black hair, in a navy suit, on a sunny city street, raising his left arm to look at the silver wristwatch on his wrist. The watch has a plain round white face with only two hands and plain tick marks, and no numbers, letters, logos or writing. There are no signs or writing behind him.

definition.en: Things that you wear on your feet, such as shoes and boots.

sentence.text: This shop sells all kinds of footwear.

scene: A wide view of a bright shop wall covered from floor to ceiling with footwear on plain white shelves: hiking boots, rain boots, sandals, sneakers, high heels, slippers and dress shoes in many colors. In front of the wall, a woman in her forties with light skin and short brown curly hair, in a teal sweater, holds up a green rain boot in one hand and a sandal in the other, comparing them. The footwear has plain sides with no logos, letters or marks, and there are no signs or price tags.

definition.en: An arrangement to keep a table, room or seat for someone.

sentence.text: We have a reservation for two at eight.

scene: At the entrance of a warm, cozy restaurant, a host in his fifties with light skin, a neat gray beard and slicked-back gray hair, in a black vest and white shirt, smiles and runs his finger down a page of an open book on a wooden stand; the page has only plain blank lines. A couple waits in front of him: a woman in her thirties with deep brown skin and long braids gathered over one shoulder, in a red coat, and a man in his thirties with East Asian features and short neat black hair, in a dark jacket. Behind them, a table for two by the window is set with a candle and a small folded white card. The book and card are completely blank, and there are no letters, numbers, signs or writing.

definition.en: Twelve in the middle of the day; midday.

sentence.text: The workers have lunch at noon.

scene: A sunny town square at noon, with the sun high overhead and very short shadows. A tall stone clock tower stands in the middle; its round clock face has only plain tick marks and no numbers, and both hands point straight up together. Office workers sit on benches and on the edge of a fountain, eating lunch from paper bags and boxes. In front, a woman in her twenties with light brown skin and a sleek high ponytail, in a white blouse, and a man in his fifties with pale skin and a gray crew cut, in a light blue shirt, open their lunch boxes. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: A man whose job is to bring food and drinks to people at their tables in a restaurant.
definition.ja: ウェイター、（男性の）給仕係

sentence.text: The waiter is bringing our food to the table.

scene: In a bright, friendly restaurant with plain sage-green walls and potted plants, a waiter in his twenties with medium brown skin and a short fade, in a white shirt, black vest and long black apron, carries two plates of pasta and salad toward a table where a couple waits with smiles: a woman in her forties with light skin and auburn hair in a messy half-up knot, in a navy blouse, and a man in his forties with tan skin and a shaved head, in a gray sweater. The menus on the table are closed and plain. There are no signs or writing.

definition.en: A restaurant in an office building or school where people serve themselves.
definition.ja: （セルフサービスの）食堂、カフェテリア

sentence.text: Several employees are having lunch together in the company cafeteria.

scene: In a bright company cafeteria at lunchtime, three coworkers of different ages sit together at a long table, eating from trays and talking: a young woman with a short black bob, a middle-aged man with a mustache, and an older man with gray hair and glasses. Behind them is a serving counter with dishes of food behind glass, and the wall above it is plain with a few hanging plants.

definition.en: A professional cook, especially the main cook in a restaurant.

sentence.text: The chef is cutting vegetables in the restaurant kitchen.

scene: In a restaurant kitchen, a young chef with black hair tied back under a tall white hat, wearing a white jacket, stands at a wooden counter and cuts colorful vegetables on a cutting board. Pots are steaming on the stove behind her, and bowls of fresh ingredients sit on the counter.

definition.en: Happening or used outside, not in a building.

sentence.text: We are having lunch at an outdoor table.

scene: On a sunny cobblestone street, a restaurant has set its tables outside under big cream umbrellas, with flower boxes and potted lemon trees around them. People eat and chat at the outdoor tables. At the front table, a woman in her forties with deep brown skin and short twisted hair, in a yellow sundress, and a man in his seventies with light skin and short white hair, in a straw hat and a linen shirt with long sleeves, lift glasses of lemonade over plates of salad. Their wrists are bare, with no watches. The restaurant front and umbrellas have no name, signs or writing.

definition.en: To eat dinner, especially at a restaurant or for a special meal.
definition.ja: 食事をする、ディナーをとる

sentence.text: They are dining by candlelight tonight.

scene: In a quiet, softly lit restaurant at night, a couple in their sixties dines at a small table with a white tablecloth beside a window full of city lights: a man with deep brown skin and short gray hair, in a dark suit, and a woman with light brown skin and gray hair in a neat chignon, in a burgundy dress. Two candles glow between their plates of fish and vegetables and two glasses. There are no signs, menus or writing.

definition.en: A small restaurant that serves coffee, tea, cakes and light meals.

sentence.text: She is reading at a small café by the window.

scene: A cozy, small café with warm lights, hanging plants and a wooden counter with a glass case of simple cakes topped with fresh fruit. Behind the counter there are only open shelves with plain white cups and green plants. A woman in her thirties with East Asian features and shoulder-length straight black hair tucked behind her ears, in a cream knitted sweater, sits at a table by the big front window with a cup of milky coffee with a plain smooth top and a slice of strawberry cake, reading a book with a plain green cover. Other customers sit at small round tables. There are no machines, menu boards, signs, patterns or writing.

definition.en: Two pieces of bread with food such as cheese, meat or vegetables between them.

sentence.text: He is making a big sandwich for lunch.

scene: A close view of a kitchen counter, where a man in his forties with East Asian features and short black hair with a gray streak, in a red flannel shirt, puts the top slice of bread on a tall sandwich of lettuce, tomato, cheese, ham and cucumber on a wooden board. A knife, a loaf of bread and a few small jars sit nearby. The jars have no labels, and there is no writing.

definition.en: A small amount of food that you eat between meals.
definition.vi: đồ ăn vặt, bữa ăn nhẹ

sentence.text: They are stopping for a snack on the trail.

scene: On a sunny mountain trail, two hikers sit on a big flat rock and share a snack of nuts, dried fruit and crackers from a small cloth bag: a woman in her twenties with tan skin and a short shaggy cut, in an orange fleece jacket, and a man in his thirties with pale skin and a sandy brown beard, in a plain green knitted sweater. Their clothes are plain, with no logos, patches, badges, pockets or marks on the chest or sleeves. Their backpacks lean against the rock, and mountains rise behind them. The backpacks are plain solid colors with plain straps and buckles only, with no tags, labels, patches, badges, logos or marks, and the cloth bag has no writing.

definition.en: A drink, such as tea, coffee or milk.

sentence.text: Cold beverages are served at the long table.

scene: At a bright garden party, a long table with a white cloth holds glass jugs of orange juice, lemonade and iced tea, a big jar of water with lemon slices and glasses of cold milk. A server in her twenties with medium brown skin and a high bun, in a white shirt and green apron, pours lemonade into a glass for a guest, a man in his fifties with light skin and a gray buzz cut, in a light blue shirt. The jugs, jars and glasses have no labels, and there are no signs, menus or writing.

definition.en: Wanting or needing to eat.
definition.ja: 空腹の、おなかがすいた

sentence.text: He is very hungry after a long day.

scene: In a warm home kitchen with plain yellow walls, a young man in his twenties with deep brown skin and a short high-top fade, in a gray hoodie, sits at the table with a big eager smile, holding a fork in one hand and a knife in the other, both pointing up. Both of his hands are busy holding the fork and knife. In front of him is an empty plate, and he looks eagerly at a woman in her seventies with light brown skin and white hair in a loose bun, in a flowered apron, who carries a large steaming pot of stew toward the table. There are no comic lines, symbols or writing.

definition.en: One of the foods that you mix together to make a dish.

sentence.text: All the ingredients for the cake are on the table.

scene: A close view of a home kitchen table set out with the ingredients for a cake: a bowl of eggs, a paper bag of flour, a block of butter, a glass jar of sugar, a jug of milk, two lemons and a small bowl of strawberries. A woman in her forties with light skin and a messy auburn bun, in a pale green apron over a white T-shirt, cracks an egg into a big mixing bowl. The bag, jar and jug have no labels, and there is no recipe card, book or writing.

definition.en: Sweet food that you eat at the end of a meal.

sentence.text: We are sharing a chocolate dessert after dinner.

scene: At a restaurant table after dinner, the dinner plates have been cleared, and a plate with a slice of chocolate cake, a scoop of vanilla ice cream and fresh strawberries sits in the middle. A couple in their thirties, each holding a small spoon, lean in to share it with happy smiles: a man with light brown skin and short curly black hair, in a green shirt, and a woman with pale skin and a long blond braid, in a navy dress. There are no signs, menus or writing.

definition.en: Having a very good taste.

sentence.text: The stew tastes delicious.

scene: In a cozy home kitchen with plain blue tiles, a man in his seventies with East Asian features and short white hair, in a blue cardigan, tastes stew from a wooden spoon beside a pot on the stove, closing his eyes with a big, happy smile and one hand on his cheek. Beside him, a woman in her seventies with tan skin and short gray permed curls, in a red apron, looks at him proudly. There are no comic lines, symbols or writing.

definition.en: A woman whose job is to bring food and drinks to people at their tables in a restaurant.

sentence.text: The waitress is pouring more coffee.

scene: Inside a small, bright diner with a long counter, round red stools and a black-and-white checked floor, a waitress in her forties with tan skin and a short dark brown bob, in a pale yellow dress and a white apron with no name tag, pours coffee from a plain glass coffee pot into the white cup of a customer at the counter. The customer, a man in his sixties with light skin, a gray crew cut and a short gray beard, in a red plaid shirt, smiles up at her. His wrists are bare. Behind the counter there are only plain cream walls, a window and open shelves of white cups and plates. There are no menu boards, signs, machines or writing.

definition.en: The taste that a food or drink has.

sentence.text: She is choosing her favorite flavor.

scene: In a bright ice cream shop with plain mint-green walls, a glass case holds six metal tubs of ice cream in different colors: pink, yellow, pale green, brown, purple and orange. On top of each tub sits the food that gives it its taste: a strawberry, a lemon slice, mint leaves, a piece of chocolate, a few blueberries and an orange slice. A customer in her thirties with medium brown skin and long box braids tied back, in a plain lime-green T-shirt, points at the pink strawberry tub with a big smile. Behind the case, a server in his twenties with light skin and sandy curls, in a white shirt and a mint-green apron with no badge, holds a scoop ready. The tubs have no labels, flags, signs or price tags, and there is no writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A meal that you take with you and eat outside, for example in a park or a field.

sentence.text: They are having a picnic under a big tree.

scene: In a sunny meadow full of wildflowers, under a big shady oak tree, a couple in their sixties sit on a red-and-white checked blanket for a picnic. An open wicker picnic basket sits on the blanket beside plates of sandwiches, a bowl of strawberries, a round cheese, grapes and a glass jug of lemonade. The woman, with light skin and silver hair in a short layered cut, in a lilac blouse and white trousers, hands a sandwich to the man, who has deep brown skin, a bald head and a short white beard, in a pale blue short-sleeved linen shirt and khaki trousers. Their wrists are bare. Green hills and a blue sky are behind them, and there is no writing.

definition.en: A set of instructions that tells you how to cook a dish.

sentence.text: She is teaching him her old family recipe.

scene: In a warm home kitchen with plain peach walls and a window, a grandmother in her eighties with East Asian features and short white hair in soft curls, in a lavender cardigan, points at a recipe card standing in a small wooden holder, with her other hand resting on the table. Her grandson, in his twenties with East Asian features and a black undercut, in a navy sweater, folds a dumpling with both hands. The card shows only three simple pictures in a row: a ball of dough, a bowl of filling and a finished dumpling, with no words, numbers, arrows or lines. A plate of folded dumplings, a rolling pin and a bowl of filling sit on the wooden table. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: To provide the food and drinks for a party or other event.
definition.zh: 承办餐饮；提供饮食服务
definition.ja: （宴会などに）料理を提供する、ケータリングする
definition.vi: cung cấp đồ ăn uống (cho sự kiện)

sentence.text: A small company is catering the wedding.

scene: In a sunny garden at a wedding party, a catering team in black shirts and long black aprons with no badges or name tags serves food from a long table with a white cloth and big silver dishes of rice, roast vegetables, chicken and bread rolls. In front, a server in her twenties with deep brown skin and short twists puts food on a plate for a smiling guest, a man in his forties with light skin and wavy brown hair, in a light gray suit, who holds out his plate. Another server, a man in his thirties with tan skin and a neat black beard, carries a big silver dish to the table with both hands. In the background, the bride in a white dress and the groom in a navy suit chat with guests under strings of lights. There are no signs, banners or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person who uses a particular shop, restaurant or other business.

sentence.text: Patrons are waiting in line outside the restaurant.

scene: On a lively city street in the early evening, a line of patrons waits outside a small, busy restaurant with warm yellow windows and a dark green door. Through the windows, every table inside is full. At the front of the line, a couple in their thirties chat happily: a woman with light skin and a sleek black ponytail, in a camel coat, and a man with medium brown skin and a short curly afro, in a gray wool coat. Behind them wait a man in his fifties with light skin, round glasses and a gray side part, in a navy jacket, and a woman in her twenties with tan skin and a long auburn fringe, in a mustard coat. The restaurant has no name, sign, menu board or writing, and its windows and door are plain.

definition.en: A cold dish of mixed raw vegetables, such as lettuce, cucumber and carrots.

sentence.text: He is mixing a big bowl of salad.

scene: In a bright kitchen with plain white tiles and a window with green plants, a man in his thirties with olive skin and a dark brown man bun, in a light green shirt with rolled-up sleeves, mixes a big wooden bowl of salad with two wooden spoons, one in each hand. The salad is full of green lettuce, cucumber slices, grated carrot, red onion, black olives and small cubes of white cheese. A glass bottle of olive oil with no label and half a lemon sit on the wooden counter. There is no writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: A meal where people serve themselves from many dishes set out on a long table.
definition.ja: ビュッフェ、バイキング

sentence.text: The hotel has a big breakfast buffet.

scene: In a bright hotel breakfast room with big windows and potted palms, a long buffet table holds many dishes: scrambled eggs, sausages, baskets of bread rolls and croissants, bowls of fruit, yogurt and cereal, and glass jugs of milk and orange juice. Guests serve themselves. In front, a woman in her fifties with deep brown skin and short gray locs, in a coral linen dress, holds her plate in one hand and uses tongs to take a croissant with the other. Beside her, a man in his twenties with light skin and a red buzz cut, in a plain white T-shirt and blue shorts, holds a bowl and spoons fruit into it. There are no name cards, labels, signs or writing in front of the dishes. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A sweet, frozen food made from milk or cream and sugar.

sentence.text: They are eating ice cream by the sea.

scene: On a sunny seaside path, two friends in their seventies sit on a low stone wall with the blue sea behind them, each holding an ice cream cone and laughing. A man with deep brown skin and short white hair, in a short-sleeved mint shirt and beige shorts, licks a big scoop of strawberry ice cream that drips a little down the cone. A woman with light skin and a short silver pixie cut, in a yellow sundress and a wide straw hat, holds a cone with one scoop of chocolate and one scoop of vanilla. Their wrists are bare. Seagulls fly over the water, and there are no signs or writing.

definition.en: A hot liquid food made by cooking vegetables, meat or fish in water.

sentence.text: He is having hot soup on a cold day.

scene: Inside a cozy kitchen on a snowy day, with snow falling outside the window, a man in his fifties with East Asian features and short graying hair parted on the side, in a thick oatmeal knitted sweater, sits at a wooden table and blows on a spoonful of hot soup, holding the spoon in one hand and the edge of the bowl with the other. A big white bowl of vegetable soup with carrots, potatoes and peas steams in front of him, next to a piece of bread. The walls are plain pale blue, and there is no writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: The liquid that comes out of fruit or vegetables when you press them.

sentence.text: She is making fresh orange juice.

scene: In a sunny kitchen with plain yellow tiles, a woman in her twenties with light brown skin and a high curly puff, in a plain white T-shirt, presses half an orange onto a glass hand juicer with one hand while holding the juicer steady with the other. A tall glass of fresh orange juice and a bowl of whole and cut oranges sit beside her on the counter. Her wrists are bare. The glass and the juicer are plain, and there are no labels or writing.

definition.en: A small paper or plastic bag that holds a small amount of something.

sentence.text: She is pouring a packet of sugar into her tea.

scene: A close view of a café table: a woman's hands hold a small, torn-open white paper packet of sugar over a white cup of tea on a saucer, and the sugar pours into the tea. Only her hands and forearms in pale green sleeves are visible, and her face is out of the frame. A teaspoon and a small plate with a lemon slice sit beside the cup. The packet is plain white with no writing, pictures or logos, and there are no other packets. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: A box-shaped space in a kitchen that you heat to cook food inside it.

sentence.text: He is taking the potatoes out of the oven.

scene: In a warm home kitchen with plain green tiles, a man in his forties with deep brown skin, short black hair and a trimmed black beard, in a plain gray T-shirt and a dark green apron, wears thick mitts on both hands and pulls a hot dish of golden roast potatoes out of an oven. The oven door is open, showing a glowing hot inside with metal racks. The oven is built into plain white cabinets and has a plain glass door and a plain bar handle, with no knobs, buttons, screen, numbers or logos. There is no writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: A large machine in a kitchen that keeps food and drinks cold.

sentence.text: She is putting the milk in the refrigerator.

scene: In a bright kitchen with plain cream walls, a woman in her thirties with pale skin, freckles and long loose copper waves, in a plain navy T-shirt and jeans, stands at an open refrigerator and puts a glass bottle of milk on a shelf inside the door. The open refrigerator is full of food: vegetables, eggs, cheese, fruit and plain glass jars. The refrigerator is plain white, with no logo, screen, magnets, notes or writing, and the bottles and jars have no labels. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person who does not eat meat or fish.
definition.ja: ベジタリアン、菜食主義者

sentence.text: She is a vegetarian, so she does not eat meat.

scene: At a family dinner table at home, a man in his sixties with light skin and a gray mustache, in a burgundy sweater, holds out a big platter of roast chicken with both hands toward a young woman in her twenties with South Asian features and long wavy black hair, in a mustard blouse. She smiles kindly and raises one open hand to say no, thank you, with her other hand resting on the table. Her own plate is already full of roasted vegetables, rice and beans. Bowls of vegetables and rice fill the table. Their wrists are bare. The walls are plain cream with one landscape painting, and there is no writing.

definition.en: A person or company whose job is to provide food and drinks for events.
definition.zh: 餐饮承办人；餐饮服务商
definition.ja: ケータリング業者、仕出し屋
definition.vi: người cung cấp dịch vụ ăn uống

sentence.text: The caterer is packing lunches for a big meeting.

scene: In a clean, bright kitchen with steel counters and plain white walls, a caterer in her forties with light skin and short red hair in a tidy crop, in a white chef's jacket with no badge, packs lunches into long rows of open brown paper boxes on the counter. She holds a box steady with one hand and puts a sandwich into it with the other. Each box holds a sandwich, a small salad and an apple. Behind her, many closed boxes are stacked high on a cart. The boxes have no labels, stickers, logos or writing. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: A soft, round, red fruit that is eaten as a vegetable.

sentence.text: She is picking ripe tomatoes in the garden.

scene: In a sunny vegetable garden with tall green tomato plants tied to wooden sticks, a woman in her fifties with medium brown skin and short gray coily hair, in a denim shirt and a wide cotton sun hat, picks a ripe red tomato from the plant with one hand and holds a basket full of red tomatoes on her other arm. Green and red tomatoes hang on the plants all around her. There are no signs or writing. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: A flat piece of wood, metal or plastic with raised edges, used for carrying food and drinks.

sentence.text: He is bringing her breakfast on a tray.

scene: In a sunny bedroom with plain pale blue walls and white curtains, a man in his thirties with East Asian features and messy black hair, in gray pajamas, carries a wooden tray with both hands to his wife in bed. sentence.text: This is a large distribution center.

scene: Inside a huge, bright distribution center, long moving belts carry plain brown boxes and split into many lanes, and each lane slides down to a different wide loading door. Workers in plain lime-green safety vests guide the boxes into the right lanes. In front, a woman in her thirties with olive skin and a dark brown low bun, in a plain gray T-shirt and a plain lime-green vest, pushes a box onto a lane with both hands. The boxes have no labels, barcodes, stickers or writing, and there are no signs, screens or numbers on the doors or walls. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person whose job is to take packages or papers from one place to another.

sentence.text: The courier is bringing a package to the office.

scene: In a bright office reception area with plain white walls, a potted plant and a big window, a courier in his twenties with light skin and short blond hair, in a plain red jacket and black trousers with no logos or badges, holds out a small brown package with both hands to a receptionist in her forties with medium brown skin and a sleek black bob, in a lilac blouse, who reaches for it across the front desk. The package has no labels, barcodes, stamps or writing. There are no computers, monitors, phones, signs or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A place where trucks or ships stop so that things can be put on or taken off.
definition.vi: khu bốc dỡ hàng, bến cảng

sentence.text: Workers are moving boxes across the loading dock.

scene: Inside a big storage building, a long loading dock has three wide open doors, and through each door the empty inside of a truck's cargo box can be seen, lined up close against the dock. A worker in his forties with deep brown skin and a gray beard, in a plain white hard hat and a plain orange safety vest, drives a small plain red forklift carrying a pallet of boxes toward one of the doors, while a woman in her twenties with light skin and a red ponytail, in a plain green work shirt, pulls a pallet of boxes on a hand cart. The forklift, boxes, doors and walls have no letters, numbers, logos, signs or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person or company that carries letters, packages or people from one place to another.
definition.vi: người vận chuyển, người đưa thư

sentence.text: The mail carrier is putting letters in the box.

scene: On a quiet, leafy street of small houses, a mail carrier in her fifties with tan skin and gray hair in a low ponytail, in a plain light green shirt, navy shorts and a wide sun hat, with a big brown leather bag on her shoulder, puts a few plain white envelopes into a plain green mailbox on a wooden post in front of a white house. The envelopes have no writing or stamps, the mailbox and houses have no numbers or names, and her shirt and bag have no badges or logos. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: To put things one on top of another in a pile.

sentence.text: He is stacking clean plates.

scene: In a busy restaurant kitchen with steel counters and plain white tiles, a kitchen worker in his twenties with light brown skin and short wavy black hair, in a plain white T-shirt and a long gray apron, stacks clean white plates into a tall, neat pile on the counter, one on top of another. Beside him stand more stacks of plates and bowls. There is no writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: A fault in something that makes it not perfect.

sentence.text: The worker found a defect in the bowl.

scene: In a bright pottery workshop with wooden shelves of white bowls, a worker in her thirties with East Asian features and short black hair with straight bangs, in a plain beige smock, holds up a white bowl with both hands and frowns at a thin dark crack running down its side. Rows of perfect white bowls stand on the table in front of her. There is no writing. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: Not made in the right way, or not working as it should.

sentence.text: The new shoe is defective.

scene: At the counter of a bright shoe shop with plain cream walls and shelves of shoes, a customer in his forties with deep brown skin and a short gray beard, in a camel coat, holds up a new brown leather shoe whose sole is coming away at the front, and shows it to a shop assistant in her twenties with light skin and wavy auburn hair, in a black sweater, who looks at it with concern. An open shoe box with tissue paper sits on the counter. The shoes and box have no logos, labels or writing, and there are no signs, price tags or computers. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: To make machines do a job instead of people.

sentence.text: The company has automated its packing line.

scene: Inside a clean, bright factory, a row of plain orange robot arms packs glass jars into plain brown boxes on a moving belt, with no people working on the line. At the end of the line, an engineer in his fifties with light skin, round glasses and short gray hair, in a white coat over a light green shirt, stands with his arms folded and looks at the robots. The robot arms are plain, with no screens, lights, logos, numbers or writing, and the boxes and jars have no labels. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person who sends a letter, package or message.

sentence.text: The sender is dropping a letter into the box.

scene: On a sunny city street, a young woman in her twenties with light skin and short wavy brown hair held back with a clip, in a mustard sweater and jeans, smiles as she drops a plain white envelope into the slot of a plain blue mailbox standing at the edge of the street. The envelope has no writing, stamps or address, and the mailbox has no letters, numbers, symbols or stickers. There are no signs or writing. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: Things that are carried by a ship, plane or truck.

sentence.text: Workers are loading cargo onto the plane.

scene: At a sunny airport, a large plain white cargo plane, seen from the side, stands with a big side door open. A long moving belt carries plain brown boxes and wrapped pallets of cargo up into the door, and two workers in plain orange safety vests and ear protectors guide them. The plane has no logos, letters, numbers, stripes or symbols on its body or tail, the cargo has no labels or writing, and there are no signs.

definition.en: Connected with machines and their moving parts.

sentence.text: He is oiling the mechanical parts.

scene: A close view inside a big old machine in a workshop: large metal gears, a chain and moving rods fit together. A worker in his forties with tan skin and a short black beard, in plain dark brown overalls with no badges or patches, oils the gears with a small oil can with a long spout. The machine, gears and oil can have no labels, numbers, logos or writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: To put the parts of something together.

sentence.text: He is assembling a new desk.

scene: In a bright living room with plain light green walls and a big window, a man in his thirties with medium brown skin and short locs tied back, in a plain gray T-shirt and jeans, kneels on the floor and assembles a new wooden desk, turning a screw with a screwdriver in one hand and holding a desk leg steady with the other. Wooden boards, screws and an empty cardboard box lie around him. There is no instruction sheet, and the box and boards have no labels, pictures or writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: A fault that stops a machine from working as it should.

sentence.text: A malfunction has stopped the machine.

scene: In a factory with plain gray walls, a packing machine has stopped working: a plain red light on top of it glows, a little gray smoke rises from its side, and plain brown boxes are piled up in a jam on the stopped belt. A worker in her thirties with deep brown skin and a short natural afro, in a plain teal crew-neck sweater with no pockets, badges or marks on the chest, scratches her head as she looks at the jam, while a man in his fifties with light skin and a white mustache, in plain brown overalls with no badges or patches, opens a side panel of the machine with a wrench. The machine has no screens, labels, numbers, warning signs, symbols or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: The process of putting the parts of something together, often in a factory.
definition.vi: sự lắp ráp, việc lắp ráp

sentence.text: The workers on the assembly line are building chairs.

scene: In a bright furniture factory, wooden chairs move slowly along an assembly line. Workers in plain green aprons stand along it, each doing one step: one fits the legs, one fits the backs, and one paints the finished chairs white. In front, a woman in her forties with light skin and short silver curls, in a plain green apron over a white shirt, presses a chair back into place with both hands. The chairs, machines and walls have no labels, numbers, signs or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: Things that are carried in large amounts by train, truck, ship or plane.
definition.vi: hàng hóa vận chuyển, vận tải hàng hóa

sentence.text: A long freight train is passing through the fields.

scene: A long freight train, seen exactly from the side, moves along a straight track through golden wheat fields under a blue sky. It pulls many freight cars in red, brown, green and blue, some carrying plain containers and some carrying logs, behind a plain dark green engine. The engine, cars and containers have no letters, numbers, logos or writing, and there are no signs.

definition.en: Something wrapped in paper or packed in a box so that it can be sent.

sentence.text: She is wrapping a parcel in brown paper.

scene: At a wooden kitchen table by a window, a woman in her seventies with East Asian features and short silver hair brushed back, in a rose cardigan, wraps a parcel in plain brown paper and ties it with white string, pulling the string tight with both hands. A roll of brown paper and a pair of scissors lie on the table. The paper has no writing, address or stamps. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: Connected with the post office and the sending of letters and packages.

sentence.text: The postal worker is taking a box from a customer.

scene: Inside a small, old-fashioned post office with plain pale green walls, a postal worker in his thirties with light skin and a neat black mustache, in a plain light green shirt and a navy vest with no badges, takes a small brown box across the wooden counter from a customer, a woman in her forties with tan skin and long dark wavy hair, in a red coat. Behind him are rows of wooden pigeonholes holding plain white envelopes. The box and envelopes have no writing, stamps or labels, and there are no scales, screens, signs, posters or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person whose job is to carry messages or packages to people.
definition.ja: メッセンジャー、使いの者

sentence.text: The messenger is riding through the city.

scene: On a city street lined with trees and brick buildings, a bicycle messenger in his twenties with deep brown skin and short twists, in a plain yellow jacket, black shorts and a plain gray helmet, rides a dark green bicycle along the straight street, seen exactly from the side, with a big plain black bag across his back. His hands rest on the grips of the handlebar. The bicycle, helmet, bag and buildings have no logos, numbers, signs or writing, there are no cars, and there are no markings on the street. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: To take things off or out of a vehicle.

sentence.text: They are unloading furniture from the van.

scene: On a sunny street of small houses, a plain white moving van is parked with its big side door open, seen exactly from the side. Two movers carry a green armchair out of the van together: a man in his thirties with light skin and a sandy crew cut, in a plain gray T-shirt, and a woman in her thirties with medium brown skin and a high ponytail, in a plain red T-shirt. Cardboard boxes and a rolled rug wait on the ground beside the van. The van has no logos, letters, numbers or license plates, and the boxes have no labels or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A large ship that carries things, not people.

sentence.text: A large freighter is crossing the ocean.

scene: On the calm blue ocean under a clear sky, a large freighter, seen exactly from the side, moves slowly, its dark red body low in the water and its long deck stacked high with plain containers in blue, orange, green and yellow. A white tower with windows stands at the back of the ship. Seagulls fly nearby. The ship and containers have no names, letters, numbers, logos, flags or writing.

definition.en: A factory where oil, sugar or other natural materials are made pure.
definition.vi: nhà máy tinh chế, nhà máy lọc dầu

sentence.text: The refinery turns oil into fuel.

scene: At an oil refinery by the sea in the early evening, tall silver towers, round white storage tanks and many pipes glow with small lights, and a small flame burns at the top of one thin tower. In front, two workers in plain white hard hats and plain orange coveralls with no badges walk along a path and talk: a woman in her forties with light brown skin and a man in his fifties with pale skin and a gray beard. The tanks, towers and pipes have no letters, numbers, logos, symbols or writing.

definition.en: A group of trucks, ships or planes that belong to one company.

sentence.text: The company has a fleet of white trucks.

scene: Seen from straight above, looking directly down like a map, a large, sunny parking lot holds a fleet of identical white delivery trucks parked side by side in three neat rows. Each truck is easy to see as a truck: a long, plain white box with a shorter white cab at its front end, a thin dark strip of windshield at the front edge of the cab roof, two small side mirrors sticking out from the cab, and the black edges of its tires showing at its sides. No grilles, lights or fronts of the trucks can be seen. Two tiny workers in plain orange vests walk far apart from each other between the rows, and each is one separate person with one head. The roofs are plain white, with no letters, numbers, logos or writing, and the gray ground is smooth, with only plain white parking lines and no numbers, arrows, marks or symbols.

definition.en: A room where things are kept until they are needed.

sentence.text: She is taking supplies from the storeroom.

scene: In a small, tidy hotel storeroom with plain gray walls and metal shelves from floor to ceiling, the shelves hold stacks of clean white towels, rolls of paper, plain white boxes, buckets and mops. A worker in her fifties with deep brown skin and short gray hair in a tapered cut, in a plain lavender work dress and white sneakers, takes a stack of towels from a high shelf. The boxes, bottles and shelves have no labels, numbers or writing. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: A worker who repairs or looks after machines and equipment.

sentence.text: A technician is repairing the copy machine in the office.

scene: In the corner of an office, a middle-aged technician with dark brown skin, short black hair and a short beard, wearing a plain gray work uniform, kneels beside a large copy machine with its side panel open and works inside it with a screwdriver. An open toolbox sits on the floor next to him. The machine has a few plain buttons.

definition.en: A building, or part of a house, where a car is kept.

sentence.text: He keeps his tools in the garage.

scene: Inside a bright, tidy home garage with its big door rolled up to a sunny driveway, a man in his sixties with light skin, a bald head and a white goatee, in a plain solid red shirt, hangs a hammer with a smooth, plain wooden handle on a wall board full of tools above a wooden workbench. The other tools on the board are wrenches, screwdrivers and hand saws, and all their handles are smooth solid colors, with no patterns, scratches or marks. A rake, a shovel and plain storage boxes stand along the walls. There is no car or lawn mower in the garage. The boxes and tools have no labels, logos or writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: The work of repairing and improving an old building or room.
definition.vi: sự cải tạo, việc sửa sang

sentence.text: The kitchen is under renovation.

scene: A home kitchen in the middle of renovation: the old cabinets have been taken out, the bare walls show patches of fresh plaster, new pale wood cabinets wait in a row, and plastic sheets cover the floor. A worker in his thirties with olive skin and a short black beard, in plain white overalls dusted with plaster, smooths fresh plaster on the wall with a wide flat tool, while the owner, a woman in her forties with light skin and shoulder-length strawberry-blond hair, in a denim shirt, looks around happily. There are no labels, logos or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A new thing that takes the place of an old or broken one.

sentence.text: He is putting in a replacement window.

scene: In a living room with plain cream walls, a glass worker in his forties with East Asian features and short black hair, in plain gray work clothes and thick work gloves, carefully fits a new, clear pane of glass into an empty wooden window frame, holding it with both hands. The old pane, with a long jagged crack across it, leans against the wall below. A woman in her seventies with deep brown skin and white hair in a low bun, in a green cardigan, stands nearby with her hands folded. The walls are plain cream, with only a potted plant on the floor beside her, and there are no shelves, books or pictures anywhere in the room. There is no writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: Connected with electricity.

sentence.text: She is fixing the electrical wires.

scene: A close view of an open box in a white wall, with bundles of red, blue, yellow and black electrical wires coming out of it. A woman's hands in thick rubber gloves twist two wires together with pliers. Only her hands and forearms in plain navy work sleeves are visible, and her face is out of the frame. The box, wires and wall have no labels, numbers, symbols, warning signs or writing.

definition.en: A door or way out of a building or place.

sentence.text: People are leaving through the exit.

scene: At the end of a wide, bright theater hallway, two big double doors stand wide open, and sunlight pours in from the street outside. A crowd of people walks out through the exit after a show. In front, a couple in their sixties walk arm in arm toward the light: a man with light skin and short gray hair, in a navy coat, and a woman with medium brown skin and short silver curls, in a red coat. There is nothing above the doors, and there are no exit signs, arrows, symbols, lit words or writing anywhere.

definition.en: To repair and improve an old building.

sentence.text: They are renovating the old house.

scene: On a sunny day, an old two-story stone farmhouse with wooden scaffolding along its front wall is being renovated. On the scaffolding, a worker in his twenties with tan skin and curly black hair, in plain orange work clothes and a plain white hard hat, fits a new window frame, while a woman in her thirties with light skin and short red hair, in plain white overalls and a plain white hard hat, carries a bucket of plaster across the scaffolding. New roof tiles are stacked on the ground. The scaffolding, house and buckets have no signs, banners, logos or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: To look at something carefully to check that it is right.

sentence.text: A worker is inspecting the engine of a delivery truck.

scene: In a bright repair garage with plain light gray walls and big windows, a worker in her forties with tan skin and a short black bob, in plain navy overalls with no badges, patches or name tag, leans over the open hood of a small white delivery truck and looks closely at the engine, holding a flashlight in one hand and resting the other hand on the front of the truck. The truck has plain white sides, its grille is plain horizontal bars with no round badge in the center, and it has no license plate, letters or logos. The floor around the truck is clear and empty, with no toolbox or other things on it. There are no signs, posters or writing on the walls. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person whose job is to repair machines, especially car engines.

sentence.text: The mechanic is fixing a car.

scene: In a clean, bright car repair shop, a small blue car is raised high on a lift, seen exactly from the side. A mechanic in his thirties with deep brown skin, short black hair and a thin mustache, in plain gray overalls with no name patch, badge or logo, stands under the car and tightens a bolt on its wheel with a wrench. Tools hang on the wall behind him. The car has no logo, badge or license plate, the wheels are plain, and there are no signs, posters or writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person whose job is to design buildings.

sentence.text: The architect is showing a model of the house.

scene: In a bright studio with big windows and plain white walls, an architect in her forties with light brown skin and long dark hair tucked behind her ears, in a black turtleneck, points at a small white model of a modern house on a large table and explains it to a couple in their thirties: a man with light skin and a short brown beard, in a green sweater, and a woman with East Asian features and a short black pixie cut, in a yellow blouse. Large sheets of drawing paper with only pencil lines lie on the table. The model and the drawings have no numbers, letters or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person or company that is paid to do building work.

sentence.text: The contractor is shaking hands with the owner.

scene: In front of a new house that is being built, with its wooden frame standing on a fresh concrete base, a contractor in his fifties with tan skin and a gray mustache, in a plain white hard hat, a plain orange safety vest and jeans, shakes hands with the owner, a woman in her forties with deep brown skin and short locs, in a camel coat. Piles of wood and bricks lie on the ground. The hard hat, vest and house have no logos, letters, signs or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person whose job is to clean houses, offices or other buildings.
definition.vi: nhân viên vệ sinh, người dọn dẹp

sentence.text: The cleaner is mopping the floor.

scene: In the bright lobby of an office building in the evening, a cleaner in his forties with East Asian features and short gray hair, in a plain teal work shirt and gray trousers, mops the smooth stone floor with a long mop, with a plain yellow bucket on wheels beside him. Part of the floor is wet and clean. Behind him are plain pale stone walls, two potted plants and tall windows with thin white frames, and the walls and frames are smooth and clean, with no marks, scratches or stains. There is no warning sign, and there are no signs, symbols, computers or writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: The act of putting a machine or other equipment in place so that it can be used.

sentence.text: The installation of the solar panels is almost finished.

scene: On the sloping roof of a house on a sunny day, two workers in plain white hard hats, plain gray work clothes and safety harnesses fit dark blue solar panels into neat rows. A woman in her thirties with medium brown skin lifts a panel into place, and a man in his forties with light skin and a sandy beard fastens it with a tool. Most of the roof is already covered with panels. The panels, harnesses and roof have no letters, numbers, logos or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: Machines, especially large ones.

sentence.text: Heavy machinery is working at the site.

scene: At a big construction site under a blue sky, heavy machinery is at work, seen from the side: a yellow digger scoops brown earth with its big bucket, and a yellow bulldozer pushes a pile of soil. A worker in a plain white hard hat and a plain orange vest stands at a safe distance and guides them with one raised hand. The machines are plain yellow, with no letters, numbers, logos, stripes or writing, and there are no signs.

definition.en: A person whose job is to paint walls or buildings.

sentence.text: The painter is painting the wall green.

scene: In an empty room with plastic sheets on the floor, a painter in her twenties with light skin and short platinum hair, in plain white overalls splashed with paint, rolls soft green paint onto a white wall with a long paint roller, holding the handle with both hands. A tray of green paint and a plain metal paint can with no label sit on the floor. There is no writing. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: A set of steps between two long pieces of wood or metal, used for climbing up and down.

sentence.text: He is climbing a ladder to the roof.

scene: On a sunny day, a tall wooden ladder leans against the side of a white house. A man in his forties with medium brown skin and a short black beard, in plain gray work clothes, climbs the ladder toward the roof with a bag of tools on his shoulder, while a woman in her forties with light skin and wavy auburn hair, in a plain green jacket, holds the bottom of the ladder steady with both hands. There is no writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A small hole or crack that lets water or gas come out.

sentence.text: There is a leak in the roof.

scene: In a cozy living room with plain beige walls on a rainy day, water drips from a dark wet patch on the ceiling into a metal bucket on the wooden floor. A woman in her sixties with East Asian features and short gray hair with bangs, in a blue cardigan, looks up at the wet patch with a worried face, holding a towel in both hands. Rain runs down the window behind her. The bucket has no label, and there is no writing. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person whose job is to check that things are done in the right and safe way.
definition.vi: thanh tra viên, người kiểm tra

sentence.text: The inspector is checking the new house.

scene: In the empty, newly built living room of a house with fresh white walls and big windows, a building inspector in his fifties with deep brown skin and a gray goatee, in a plain white hard hat and a plain navy jacket with no badges, shines a flashlight into a corner of the ceiling and checks it carefully, holding a clipboard in his other hand. The clipboard paper has only blank lines, with no words, numbers or marks, and there is no writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: Used to keep a person or thing safe from harm.

sentence.text: She is wearing protective glasses.

scene: In a wood workshop, a woman in her thirties with tan skin and dark curly hair tied back, in a plain gray work shirt, cuts a wooden board with an electric saw while wearing protective gear: clear safety glasses, big ear protectors, a dust mask and thick work gloves. Sawdust flies from the board. The saw, glasses, ear protectors and mask have no logos, letters or writing.

definition.en: To make a hole in something with a tool that turns.

sentence.text: He is drilling a hole in the wall.

scene: In a bright room with plain white walls, a man in his twenties with light skin and short black curls, in a plain mustard T-shirt, drills a hole in the wall with a plain blue power drill, holding the drill with both hands. A little white dust falls from the hole. A wooden shelf board waits on the floor. The drill has no logos, letters, numbers or symbols, and there is no writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: A machine that keeps the air in a room cool, usually called an air conditioner.

sentence.text: The air conditioner keeps the room cool.

scene: On a hot summer day, in a bright bedroom with plain white walls and a window full of sunshine, a plain white air conditioner on the wall above the bed is running, with its long, thin vent flap open. A man in his thirties with light brown skin and short wavy hair, in a plain white T-shirt and shorts, sits on the bed under it and smiles with relief, lifting his face toward it, and his hair and the thin curtains move gently in the cool air. The cool air itself cannot be seen, so nothing is drawn in the air: there are no lines, ribbons, waves or swirls. The air conditioner has no display, numbers, lights, logos or writing, and there is no remote control. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: A place in a wall where you can connect a machine to the electricity.

sentence.text: She is using the outlet next to the bed.

scene: A close view of a wall beside a bed: a woman's hand pushes the plug of a lamp into a white wall outlet with two slots and a round hole. Only her hand and forearm in a plain pink sleeve are visible, and her face is out of the frame. The outlet and plug are plain white, with no letters, numbers, symbols or writing. Her wrist is bare.

definition.en: A person whose job is to fit and repair water pipes, sinks and toilets.

sentence.text: The plumber is fixing the pipe under the sink.

scene: In a bright kitchen, a plumber in her forties with medium brown skin and short twists, in plain navy overalls with no badges or name patch, kneels in front of the open cabinet under the sink and tightens a pipe with a big wrench. A toolbox and a bucket sit on the floor beside her. The toolbox and bucket have no labels, logos or writing. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: Easy for everyone to reach, enter or use.
definition.ja: 利用しやすい、バリアフリーの

sentence.text: The library is accessible to everyone.

scene: At the entrance of a bright public library with big glass doors, a gentle ramp with handrails leads up beside the front steps. A man in his thirties with light skin and a short brown beard, in a green sweater, rolls his wheelchair up the ramp and smiles, while a woman in her thirties with deep brown skin and short black curls, in a yellow coat, walks beside him carrying books. There are no signs, symbols, wheelchair pictures or writing anywhere. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: Working by itself, without a person controlling it.

sentence.text: The automatic doors open by themselves.

scene: At the entrance of a bright supermarket, a pair of glass doors slides open by itself as a man in his sixties with tan skin and a white beard, in a beige raincoat, walks toward them with a full shopping bag in each hand. Inside, shelves of food can be seen. The doors and walls have no signs, stickers, symbols, arrows or writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person whose job is to make and repair wooden things.

sentence.text: The carpenter is making a wooden chair.

scene: In a warm wood workshop full of planks, a carpenter in his sixties with light skin, gray hair in a short ponytail and a gray beard, in a plain brown work apron over a checked shirt, smooths the leg of a wooden chair with a hand plane, and curly wood shavings fall onto the workbench. Hand saws and clamps hang on the wall behind him. The tools have no logos or writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person whose job is to fit and repair wires, lights and other things that use electricity.

sentence.text: The electrician is fixing the lights.

scene: In a dark room where the lights are off, an electrician in his thirties with East Asian features and short black hair, in a plain gray work shirt and a tool belt, stands on a short step stool and connects wires to a light fitting on the ceiling, with a small light on a band around his forehead to see his work. A new light fitting waits in its open box on the floor. The fitting, tools and box have no labels, logos or writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: A thin, pointed piece of metal that you hit with a hammer to join things or to hang things.

sentence.text: He is hammering a nail into the wall.

scene: A close view of a living room wall painted plain sage green: a man in his twenties with deep brown skin and a short high-top fade, in a plain yellow T-shirt, holds a nail against the wall with one hand and hits it with a hammer in the other, to hang a framed landscape painting that leans against the wall below. The nail is large and clear in the picture. There is no writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: The inside surface of the top of a room.

sentence.text: The ceiling of the old hall is painted like the sky.

scene: In a grand old hall with tall stone columns, the high, curved ceiling is painted like a blue summer sky with soft white clouds and a few flying birds. Two visitors stand in the middle of the empty hall and look up at it with wonder: a woman in her twenties with light brown skin and long wavy black hair, in a white dress, and a man in his twenties with light skin and short red hair, in a gray sweater. The ceiling and walls have no words, numbers or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person whose job is to put out fires.

sentence.text: The firefighter is putting out the fire.

scene: In a field next to a small burning wooden shed, a firefighter in his forties with tan skin and a short gray beard, in a plain red helmet and a tan fire coat with yellow stripes, sprays a strong stream of water from a big hose onto the orange flames, holding the hose with both hands. Gray smoke rises. There is no fire truck in the picture, and the helmet and coat have no badges, numbers, letters or logos.

definition.en: Care that you take to stay safe or to avoid mistakes.
definition.vi: sự thận trọng, sự cẩn thận

sentence.text: They are crossing the old bridge with caution.

scene: Deep in a green forest, two hikers cross an old rope bridge high above a rocky stream with great caution. In front, a woman in her thirties with medium brown skin and short black curls, in a plain red sweater and dark trousers, takes slow, small steps and holds both side ropes tightly. Behind her, a man in his forties with light skin and short wavy brown hair, in a plain olive-green sweater, grips the ropes and looks down carefully at the next wooden plank. A few planks are missing, and the water rushes over the rocks far below. They carry no bags, and their clothes have no logos, patches or pockets on the chest. There are no signs or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: The act of taking something away from a place.
definition.vi: việc gỡ bỏ, việc dời đi

sentence.text: The removal of the old carpet is almost done.

scene: Inside an empty living room with plain white walls, seen from the back of the room, two workers carry a long rolled-up old carpet, faded red with dirty, worn edges, on their shoulders out of the house. They walk away from us toward the open front door at the far end of the room, so we see their backs: the man in front, in his forties with tan skin and a gray buzz cut, in a plain navy T-shirt, gray work trousers and plain brown leather work boots, is already stepping out through the doorway into the sunny front yard, and the man behind him, in his twenties with deep brown skin and a high-top fade, in a plain orange T-shirt, jeans and plain brown leather work boots, holds the back end of the roll. The bare wooden floor shows almost everywhere, and close to us one last narrow strip of the same old faded red carpet is still left along the wall. There are no new rugs, boxes, signs or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A worker who leads a group of other workers and tells them what to do.

sentence.text: The foreman is giving the workers their jobs for the day.

scene: At a building site in the early morning, beside the wooden frame of a new house, a foreman in his fifties with light brown skin and a thick gray mustache, in a plain white helmet, a plain blue work shirt and tan work trousers, points up at the roof with one hand and holds a clipboard with blank paper in the other. Four workers in plain orange helmets and plain gray work clothes stand in a half circle and listen to him: a young woman with light skin and a short blond ponytail, a man with deep brown skin and a short beard, a man with East Asian features and glasses, and an older man with tan skin and a white goatee. The helmets and clothes have no logos, stickers, stripes or writing, nobody wears a vest, the clipboard paper is blank, and there are no signs, machines or vehicles. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person whose job is to fix things that are broken.

sentence.text: An old man is watching the repairperson fix his sink.

scene: In a bright home kitchen with plain blue tiles, a repairperson in her thirties with light skin and short red hair in a low knot, in plain gray overalls and plain brown leather work boots with smooth dark soles, kneels in front of the open cupboard under the sink and turns a pipe with a big wrench. The wrench is one smooth piece of plain silver metal with a fixed, open jaw at its end, with no screws, wheels, holes or moving parts, and its handle is plain silver too. A closed plain gray metal toolbox with a plain handle sits beside her on the floor. The owner of the home, a man in his seventies with deep brown skin and short white hair, in a cream cardigan, stands nearby holding a cup of tea and looks on. The overalls have no badge, logo or name tag, the toolbox has no labels, and there are no machines or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A long, thin, straight piece of wood or metal that stands up from the ground.

sentence.text: The workers are putting up a new wooden pole.

scene: Beside a quiet country road between green fields, three workers in plain white helmets and plain blue work clothes put up a tall new wooden pole for power lines. A man in his thirties with light skin and a red beard and a man in his fifties with deep brown skin and a gray mustache pull long ropes to raise the pole upright, and a woman in her twenties with East Asian features and a short black bob holds its base steady in a deep hole. The pole is plain brown wood with no tags, numbers, signs or writing, and there are no trucks or machines. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A tall machine with a long arm that lifts and moves heavy things.

sentence.text: The crane is lifting a steel beam to the top of the building.

scene: At a big building site under a clear blue sky, a tall yellow tower crane lifts a long steel beam on cables up to the top floor of a new building of steel and concrete. On the top floor, two workers in plain orange helmets and plain gray long sleeves reach up with gloved hands to guide the beam. The crane is plain yellow, with no writing, numbers, logos, flags or signs on its arm, cab, tower or weights, and the building has no signs, banners or writing.

definition.en: A large plan on paper that shows how a building will be built.

sentence.text: They are looking at the blueprint of the new house.

scene: At a building site, beside the wooden frame of a new house, an architect in her forties with deep brown skin and a short gray afro, in a plain mustard sweater, and a builder in his thirties with light skin and freckles, in a plain white helmet and a plain gray work shirt, unroll a big blueprint on a wooden table. The builder holds the two far corners down with both hands, and the architect holds a near corner with one hand. The blueprint is deep blue paper with only simple white lines that show the rooms, doors and windows of a house from above, with no words, letters, numbers, measurements, arrows or title box. With her other hand, the architect points at one room. There are no signs or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A full path that electricity can go around.

sentence.text: When she closes the circuit, the little light comes on.

scene: At a wooden workbench in a bright evening class with plain pale walls and no boards, posters or screens, a woman in her forties with olive skin and short wavy gray hair, in a plain teal sweater, presses down a small metal switch on a wooden board with one finger, and a small light bulb on the board glows warm yellow. Red and black wires join the switch, the bulb and a plain gray battery box in one loop. Her teacher, a man in his sixties with light skin, round glasses and a white beard, in a brown cardigan, smiles and points at the glowing bulb. The battery box has no plus or minus signs, letters, numbers or labels, and the board has no writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A machine that makes electricity.

sentence.text: The generator gives the house power during the storm.

scene: On a dark, stormy night with heavy rain, every house on the street is dark except one. The generator is a plain red frame around a plain dark box, with no labels, dials, switches, numbers, stickers or logos. There are no signs or writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: A large pipe under the ground that carries away dirty water.

sentence.text: A worker is going down into the sewer.

scene: On a quiet city street, the round metal cover of a sewer has been lifted and set beside the open hole. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A hard hat that keeps your head safe.

sentence.text: She puts on her helmet before she goes onto the site.

scene: At the gate of a building site, a worker in her thirties with tan skin and a short black pixie cut, in a plain green work jacket with no pockets or badges on the chest and tan work trousers, puts on a plain white helmet with both hands. The helmets are plain, with no stickers, logos, stripes or writing, and there are no signs or writing on the gate or the fence. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: To leave a dangerous place, or to move people out of it, so that they stay safe.

sentence.text: The workers are evacuating the building.

definition.en: A red metal can full of foam or powder that you use to put out a fire.

sentence.text: She is learning how to use a fire extinguisher.

definition.en: A thing such as a sink, a bathtub or a light that is fixed in place in a building.

definition.en: A piece of soft material that you use for cleaning or drying things.

sentence.text: She is wiping the table with a wet cloth.

scene: In a sunny kitchen with plain cream walls, a woman in her sixties with light brown skin and short silver curls, in a plain lilac sweater with rolled-up sleeves, wipes crumbs off a wooden table with a wet blue cloth in one hand and holds a small plate under the edge of the table with the other to catch them. definition.en: A paper that you sign to rent a home or a building for a set time.

definition.en: A round cover on a stick that you hold over your head to keep the rain off.

sentence.text: She is opening her umbrella because it started to rain.

scene: At the glass door of a small café on a city street, rain has just started to fall, and a woman in her forties with olive skin and short wavy auburn hair, in a plain camel coat, steps out and opens a big red umbrella over her head. definition.en: A person who pays money to live in a home that another person owns.

sentence.text: The new tenant is moving in today.

scene: In the hallway of a small apartment building with plain pale yellow walls, a new tenant, a man in his twenties with light skin and short spiky brown hair, in a plain green hoodie, carries a big cardboard box through the open door of his new apartment. sentence.text: He is hanging his coat in the closet.

scene: In a bright bedroom with plain white walls, the tall doors of a wooden closet are open, showing shirts, sweaters and dresses on wooden hangers and folded sweaters on a shelf above them. sentence.text: It is a sunny day at the beach.

scene: On a bright beach under a clear blue sky with a big round sun, people relax on the warm sand. definition.en: Something that you give to help people, such as money, food or clothes.

definition.en: To give money, food, clothes or other things to help people.

sentence.text: She is donating her old coats.

scene: At the front table of a coat drive in a bright hall with plain cream walls, a woman in her forties with deep brown skin and a short natural afro, in a plain purple sweater, smiles and hands a big paper bag full of folded winter coats across the table with both hands to a volunteer, a man in his sixties with light skin, a bald head and round glasses, in a plain blue cardigan, who reaches out to take it. scene: In a town park on a cloudy afternoon, thick gray clouds cover the whole sky, and the sun is hidden.
