definition.en: A long, soft seat with a back and arms, for two or more people.

sentence.text: They are relaxing on their new sofa.

scene: In a cozy living room with plain sage-green walls and a big window, a couple in their thirties sink happily into a big new mustard-yellow sofa with soft cushions. A man with medium brown skin and a shaved head, in a plain navy sweater, stretches his arms along the back of the sofa, and a woman with light skin and a messy blond bob, in a plain pink sweater, puts her feet up. definition.vi: nửa đêm, mười hai giờ đêm

sentence.text: It is midnight, and she is still awake.

scene: In a dark, quiet living room with plain walls at night, a round wall clock shows midnight, with both of its hands pointing straight up together. definition.en: With a lot of rain.

sentence.text: It is a rainy day, so they are staying inside.

scene: On a rainy afternoon, heavy rain streams down a big window, and the street outside is gray and full of puddles. There is no writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A thing that gives light, often standing on a table or on the floor.

sentence.text: He turned on the lamp to read.

scene: In a dim living room with plain walls in the evening, a man in his seventies with tan skin, a white mustache and a bald head, in a plain brown cardigan, sits in an armchair and pulls the small chain of a table lamp with one hand, and its warm light falls on a closed book in his lap. The lamp has a cream shade and a plain wooden base. The book has a plain green cover with no words. There is no writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: Food, paper and other things that you throw away.

sentence.text: He is taking out the garbage.

scene: Early in the morning, a man in his forties with light skin and messy black hair, in a plain gray sweater and slippers, carries two full black garbage bags down the front path of his house to the plain green garbage bins by the street. The bins have no symbols, letters or numbers, and there are no garbage trucks, signs or writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: A room with a toilet, a sink and a bathtub or shower.

sentence.text: He is cleaning the bathroom.

scene: In a bright bathroom with white tiles, a white bathtub, a white sink and a small window with a green plant, a man in his thirties with deep brown skin and a short beard, in a plain yellow T-shirt, dark gray trousers and yellow rubber gloves, kneels barefoot on a plain blue bath mat and scrubs the bathtub with a sponge. definition.en: An animal that you keep at home for company.

sentence.text: Her pet is sleeping beside her while she reads a book.

scene: In a cozy living room with plain cream walls, a woman in her thirties with light brown skin and short wavy chestnut hair, in a plain mustard sweater and soft gray trousers, sits on a sofa beside a sunny window and reads a book whose cover is plain green, with no words or pictures. definition.en: Things that you throw away because you do not want them.

sentence.text: Please put your trash in the bin.

scene: In a green city park, a woman in her twenties with light skin and a long auburn ponytail, in a plain blue sweatshirt and jeans, drops an empty paper cup into a plain green trash bin beside a wooden bench. The bin has no symbols, letters or numbers, and there are no signs or writing. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: With a lot of strong wind.

sentence.text: It is so windy that her hat blew off.

scene: On a seaside path on a windy day, strong wind bends the trees and blows leaves through the air. definition.en: Large, with a lot of room inside.

sentence.text: The new living room is very spacious.

scene: A couple in their forties stand in the middle of a very large, bright living room with a high ceiling, tall windows on two sides and a wide, empty wooden floor, with only one small sofa and a plant far away by the wall. definition.en: To clean a floor or carpet with a machine that pulls up dirt.

sentence.text: She is vacuuming the carpet.

scene: In a bright living room with plain walls and a window, a woman in her thirties with light skin and short wavy chestnut hair, in a plain lime-green T-shirt and jeans, pushes an upright vacuum cleaner across a soft blue carpet, seen from the side. definition.en: To put furniture into a room or a home.

sentence.text: They are furnishing their first home.

scene: In a sunny, almost empty new apartment with plain white walls and bare wooden floors, a young couple in their twenties carry in a new green armchair together: a woman with tan skin and a wavy black bob, in a plain orange sweater, and a man with deep brown skin and short twists, in a plain gray T-shirt. definition.en: Clothes and sheets that need washing or have just been washed.

definition.en: To change the shape or look of a room or a building.

Two plain metal paint cans with no labels and a paint tray sit on an old sheet, and there are no other tools, tape measures or boxes. There is no writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: Covered with ice.

sentence.text: The path is icy this morning.

scene: On a cold winter morning in a park, the path is covered with smooth gray-white ice, and frost covers the grass and the bare branches. There are no signs or writing.

definition.vi: xuống tầng dưới, ở tầng dưới

definition.en: An area with many houses at the edge of a city.

sentence.text: They live in a quiet suburb outside the city.

definition.en: To rub something so that it becomes smooth and bright.

sentence.text: He is holding the plug of the fan.

definition.en: A pot or jar, often tall, that you put cut flowers in.

definition.en: The light and warmth of the sun.

sentence.text: He is enjoying the morning sunshine.

definition.en: A machine that washes dishes.

definition.en: Sleeping.

definition.en: A person who pays to live in a home that belongs to someone else.

There are no cars, signs, house numbers or writing.

definition.en: A large, soft cover that keeps you warm.

sentence.text: They are spreading a blanket on the grass.

scene: In a sunny park on a summer day, two friends in their thirties spread a big red-and-white checked picnic blanket on the green grass, each holding two of its corners: a woman with East Asian features and a short black bob, in a plain yellow sundress, and a woman with light skin and long blond hair in a low ponytail, in a plain blue linen shirt and white trousers. definition.en: A small insect.

sentence.text: People are waving at the parade.

scene: On a sunny city street, a parade moves past: a marching band in plain blue uniforms and white hats plays trumpets and drums, and behind them comes a big float covered with red and yellow flowers. People line both sides of the street and wave. In front, a man in his forties with deep brown skin and short hair, in a plain green sweater, lifts his hand and waves, and next to him a woman in her forties with light skin and wavy brown hair, in a plain coral top, waves too. The drums have plain heads, and there are no banners, flags, signs, numbers, letters or writing anywhere. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: To practice a play, dance or piece of music before the real show.
definition.ja: リハーサルする、下稽古をする

sentence.text: The dancers are rehearsing for the show.

scene: In a bright dance studio with a wooden floor and big windows, three dancers in plain black and gray practice clothes and soft plain dance shoes rehearse a dance together, all leaning forward with their arms stretched out and one leg stretched behind them: a man in his twenties with deep brown skin and short twists, a woman in her twenties with East Asian features and a high bun, and a woman in her twenties with light skin and a short red pixie cut. Their teacher, a woman in her sixties with light skin and short white hair, in a plain navy top, claps the beat. There are no mirrors, posters, signs, shelves or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A film or TV show about real people, animals and events.

sentence.text: They are watching a documentary about penguins.

scene: In a cozy living room with plain sage-green walls in the evening, a couple in their forties sit on a sofa under a blanket and look at a big flat TV on a low cabinet, which shows a nature documentary: a group of penguins walking across white snow and ice under a blue sky. A man with light skin and short brown hair, in a plain gray sweater, and a woman with medium brown skin and long curly hair, in a plain red sweater, share a pot of tea. The TV is plain black with no logo, buttons or lights, and the picture on the screen has no words, subtitles, logos or numbers. There are no shelves, books or other pictures. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A kind of music with a strong beat, in which players often make up the music as they play.

sentence.text: The band plays jazz every Friday night.

scene: In a small, warm jazz club at night with dim lights and round tables, a jazz trio plays on a low stage: a woman in her fifties with deep brown skin and short gray natural hair, in a plain purple dress, plays the saxophone; a man in his sixties with light skin and a white goatee, in a plain black shirt, plays a tall wooden double bass; and a man in his thirties with East Asian features and short black hair, in a plain white shirt, plays a black piano. People at the tables listen with drinks. The piano, bass and saxophone have no names, logos or writing, there is no sheet music, and no music notes are drawn in the air. There are no signs, posters, shelves, books or pictures. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person who makes sure players follow the rules in a game.

sentence.text: The referee is showing the player a yellow card.

scene: On a green soccer field on a sunny day, a referee in his forties with tan skin and short black hair, in a plain black shirt, blows a silver whistle and holds up a plain yellow card in one hand, while a player in his twenties with light skin and short blond hair, in a plain red shirt, holds his hands up in surprise. The picture shows them from the waist up. Their shirts have no numbers, names, badges or logos, and there are no signs, flags or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person who runs, often in races.
definition.vi: người chạy, vận động viên chạy

sentence.text: The runner is very fast.

scene: On a red running track at sunrise, a runner in her twenties with deep brown skin and short black hair, in a plain yellow top, races forward with her arms pumping and a face full of effort, seen from the side and from the waist up, large in the frame. Behind her, the plain white lines of the track and the green field are a little blurry. Her top has no number, letters or logos, and there are no signs or writing. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: To ride on a wave while standing on a board.
definition.ja: サーフィンをする、波に乗る

sentence.text: He is surfing a big wave.

scene: On a sunny day at sea, a surfer in his thirties with tan skin and long wet black hair tied back, in a plain black wetsuit, rides a big blue wave on a plain white surfboard, bending his knees with his arms out for balance, as white foam curls behind him. The board and wetsuit have no logos, letters, stripes or writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: A small object that bursts in the sky with bright colors and a loud noise.

sentence.text: The fireworks light up the night sky.

scene: At night over a wide river in a city, big fireworks burst in the dark sky in red, gold, green and blue, and their colors fall on the water. On a bridge in front, a crowd of adults stand along the railing and look up in wonder; in front, a woman in her twenties with light skin and short spiky blond hair, in a plain red coat, points up, and a man in his twenties with deep brown skin and short twists, in a plain gray coat, smiles. The fireworks make only round bursts and falling trails of light, with no shapes like letters, hearts or stars, and there are no signs or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A kind of exercise in which you stretch your body and breathe slowly.

sentence.text: She does yoga by the lake every morning.

scene: At sunrise on a wooden dock by a calm lake with mist on the water, a woman in her fifties with medium brown skin and short gray locs, in a plain sage-green top and gray leggings, barefoot on a plain blue mat, does a yoga pose: one knee bent forward, the other leg stretched back, and both arms stretched out to the sides, with a calm face. Pine trees stand on the far shore. There are no signs or writing. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person who keeps many things of one kind because they like them.
definition.vi: nhà sưu tầm, người sưu tầm

sentence.text: The collector is showing one of her many teapots.

scene: In a sunny room with plain cream walls, a collector in her sixties with light skin and a short silver bob, in a plain blue cardigan, proudly holds up a small round teapot painted with pink flowers, in front of tall white shelves filled with dozens of teapots of every shape and color. A cup of tea sits on a small table beside her. The teapots have only flowers and simple patterns on them, with no letters, numbers or writing, and there are no books, labels or signs. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: To swim deep under the water.

sentence.text: They are diving in the clear blue sea.

scene: Deep under the clear blue sea, two divers in plain black wetsuits, with gray air tanks on their backs, swim slowly over a colorful coral reef full of bright fish, and one of them points at a big sea turtle swimming by. The two divers swim one above the other with clear blue water between them, so their bodies, arms, legs and fins never overlap, and each diver has one body, two arms and two legs, with one black fin on each foot. Each diver wears a mask over the eyes and nose and holds a black mouthpiece firmly between the lips, with a hose going back to the air tank, and small bubbles rise from the mouthpiece. A long dark braid floats behind one of them. The tanks, masks, fins and wetsuits have no logos, letters, numbers or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A large group of musicians who play classical music together.
definition.ja: オーケストラ、管弦楽団

sentence.text: The orchestra is playing in the concert hall.

scene: Seen from the audience, on the stage of a grand concert hall with warm lights, a large orchestra in black clothes plays: rows of violins, cellos, flutes and horns, with a big pair of drums at the back. In front, a conductor in his sixties with light skin and white hair, in a black jacket whose sleeves are plain all the way to the ends with no buttons, raises a thin baton with one hand. The players have no music stands or sheet music, the instruments have no names or logos, and there are no signs, screens or writing. The conductor's wrists are bare.

definition.en: A game in which you fit small pieces together to make a picture.
definition.ja: ジグソーパズル、パズル
definition.vi: tranh ghép hình, trò xếp hình

sentence.text: They are doing a big puzzle together.

scene: At a wooden table in a sunny room with plain walls, a couple in their seventies do a big jigsaw puzzle together; the almost finished picture shows a red barn, green hills and a blue sky. A woman with deep brown skin and short white curls, in a plain yellow cardigan, fits a piece into place, and a man with light skin and a bald head, in a plain green sweater, holds another piece and smiles. Loose pieces lie around the puzzle. There is no box. There are no shelves, books, pictures or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person who is just starting to learn something.

sentence.text: This guitar class is for beginners.

scene: In a bright music room with plain white walls, three adult beginners sit on chairs in a half circle and hold acoustic guitars awkwardly, looking down at their fingers with careful, unsure faces, while their teacher, a man in his forties with tan skin and a short black ponytail, in a plain blue shirt, shows them how to hold a chord on his own guitar. The beginners are a woman in her sixties with light skin and short gray hair, a man in his twenties with deep brown skin and a high-top fade, and a woman in her thirties with East Asian features and round glasses, all in plain sweaters and plain leather shoes. The guitars are plain wood with no logos, names or stickers, and there are no music stands, sheet music, shelves, posters or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A very large animal that lives in the sea and breathes air.

sentence.text: A whale jumped out of the water.

scene: On a calm blue sea under a clear sky, a huge gray whale leaps out of the water, its whole body in the air and white water splashing around it, while two people in a small plain white boat nearby look at it in amazement: a woman in her thirties with light skin and short wavy blond hair, in a plain yellow raincoat, and a man in his forties with deep brown skin and short gray hair, in a plain navy sweater. The boat has no name, letters, numbers or flags, and there is no writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A small, thin bag that you fill with air or gas.

sentence.text: Her balloon is floating up into the sky.

scene: In a sunny park with green grass and trees, a big red balloon on a long white string floats up into the blue sky, and a woman in her twenties with East Asian features and long black hair in a half-up knot, in a plain yellow dress, reaches up after it with one hand, her mouth open in surprise, while her friend, a man in his twenties with light skin and curly brown hair, in a plain blue T-shirt, laughs beside her. The picture shows them from the waist up, with lots of sky above. The balloon is plain red with no pictures, letters or writing, and there are no signs. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A very large gray animal with big ears and a long nose called a trunk.

sentence.text: The elephants are drinking at the river.

scene: On a sunny afternoon on the wide grassy plains of Africa, a family of elephants stands at the edge of a broad brown river and drinks, lifting water with their long trunks, and a young elephant splashes beside its mother. Flat-topped trees and soft hills stand in the distance. There are no people, cars, signs or writing.

definition.en: To fill something with air.
definition.ja: 膨らませる、空気を入れる

sentence.text: They are inflating an air mattress.

scene: At a campsite in a pine forest, two friends in their twenties inflate a big plain blue air mattress beside a plain green tent: a woman with deep brown skin and short braids, in a plain orange sweater and plain beige trousers, pushes the handle of a hand pump up and down with both hands, and a man with light skin and wavy brown hair, in a plain gray hoodie and plain dark gray trousers, holds the half-full mattress steady with both hands. Their clothes are smooth and plain, with no pockets, straps, tabs, buttons, patches, labels or marks anywhere. Both wear plain brown leather boots. The mattress, pump and tent have no logos, letters or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: Bowls, cups and plates made from clay, or the art of making them.

sentence.text: She is making pottery on a wheel.

scene: In a bright pottery studio with plain white walls, a woman in her thirties with olive skin and dark curly hair tied up, in a plain gray apron over a white T-shirt, sits at a spinning pottery wheel and shapes a wet clay bowl with both hands. Finished cups and bowls in soft blue and cream stand on a wooden table nearby. The cups and bowls have no labels or marks, and there are no shelves of books, signs or writing. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: To move on ice or the ground wearing special shoes with blades or wheels.

sentence.text: They are skating on the frozen pond.

scene: On a frozen pond in a snowy park on a sunny winter day, a couple in their sixties skate hand in hand on the smooth ice, smiling: a man with light brown skin and a gray mustache, in a plain red sweater and a knitted hat, and a woman with light skin and short white hair, in a plain blue coat and a white scarf. They wear plain white leather skates with silver blades. There are no signs or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A short board with four wheels that you stand on and ride.

sentence.text: He is riding his skateboard in the park.

scene: In a sunny concrete skate park, a young man in his twenties with deep brown skin and short dreadlocks, in a plain mustard T-shirt and jeans, rides his skateboard up a smooth ramp with his arms out for balance. The skateboard has a plain wooden top and four white wheels, and he wears plain solid black canvas shoes with white soles and no stripes, logos or marks. The ramps and walls are plain gray concrete, with no graffiti, stickers, signs or writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: A box or room made of bars, where birds or animals are kept.

sentence.text: The parrot is sitting in its cage.

scene: By a sunny window in a living room with plain walls, a green parrot with a red head sits on a perch inside a tall, round white metal cage, and a man in his eighties with tan skin, a bald head and a white mustache, in a plain blue cardigan, offers it a sunflower seed through the bars. The cage is plain, with no tags or writing. There are no shelves, books, pictures or writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: A building where people go to watch films.

sentence.text: They are watching a film at the cinema.

scene: Inside a big cinema, seen from the back row, rows of red velvet seats are filled with people sitting in the dark, the backs of their heads toward us, and the huge screen in front shows a bright orange sunset over the sea. Soft light from the screen falls across the room. The screen shows only the sunset, with no words, letters, numbers or logos, and there are no exit signs, lit signs or writing anywhere.

definition.en: A person who goes for long walks in the mountains or the country.
definition.ja: ハイカー、ハイキングをする人

sentence.text: The hiker is resting at the top of the mountain.

scene: At the rocky top of a mountain, a hiker in her forties with tan skin and a short black pixie cut, in a plain red sweater, sits on a big rock and rests, drinking water from a plain metal bottle, with her plain backpack beside her, and looks out over a sea of clouds and far peaks. She wears plain brown leather hiking boots. The bottle and backpack have no tags, patches, logos or writing, and there are no signs or flags. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: A party where people meet again after a long time apart.
definition.vi: buổi họp mặt, buổi họp lớp

sentence.text: The old school friends are hugging at their reunion.

scene: In a sunny garden with a long table of food and drinks, old school friends in their fifties meet again at their reunion. In front, two women hug each other tightly with happy tears and smiles: a woman with deep brown skin and short gray curls, in a plain yellow dress, and a woman with light skin and a gray bob, in a plain blue blouse. Behind them, three other old friends laugh and talk. Everyone wears plain leather shoes. There are no banners, name tags, signs or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A musical instrument with four strings that you play with a bow.

sentence.text: She is playing the violin by the window.

scene: By a sunny window in a quiet room with plain cream walls, a woman in her twenties with light skin and long straight brown hair, in a plain white blouse, plays the violin with her eyes closed, holding it under her chin with one hand on its neck and the bow in the other. There is no music stand or sheet music, no music notes are drawn in the air, and the violin has no letters or labels. There are no shelves, books, pictures or writing. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: A musical instrument that you hit with your hands or with sticks.

sentence.text: He is playing a big drum.

scene: At an outdoor music festival in a sunny park, a man in his forties with deep brown skin and a shaved head, in a plain orange shirt and plain brown leather sandals, sits on a low stool and plays a big wooden hand drum held between his knees, hitting its plain skin top with both hands and smiling, while a few people dance on the grass behind him. The drum has no pictures, logos or writing, and there are no signs, banners or music notes in the air. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person who watches a sports game or a show.

sentence.text: The spectators are watching the tennis match.

scene: In the stands beside a tennis court on a sunny day, rows of spectators in plain hats and sunglasses all turn their heads to the left at the same time to follow the ball. In front, a woman in her sixties with light skin and short white hair, in a plain pink blouse and a wide sun hat, and a man in his thirties with deep brown skin and short black hair, in a plain white shirt, turn their heads together. Part of the green court and the net can be seen below them. There are no scoreboards, signs, banners, numbers or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A game in which two teams hit a ball over a high net with their hands.

sentence.text: They are playing volleyball in the park.

scene: On a sand court in a city park with tall trees around it, four adult friends play volleyball barefoot. In front, a woman in her twenties with light brown skin and a high ponytail, in a plain teal T-shirt and shorts, jumps and hits the white ball over the high net with both hands, while on the other side a man in his thirties with pale skin and short red hair, in a plain white T-shirt, jumps to block it. Two more friends wait behind them. The ball is plain white, the net is plain, and there are no numbers, logos, signs or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A short show of your skill to try to get a part in a play, film or band.
definition.vi: buổi thử vai, buổi thử giọng

sentence.text: She is singing at her audition.

scene: On a bare theater stage under one bright light, a woman in her twenties with deep brown skin and long box braids, in a plain lavender dress, sings with her arms open, while three people sit in the dark seats in front of the stage and listen closely: a man in his fifties with light skin and a gray beard, a woman in her forties with East Asian features and short black hair, and a man in his thirties with tan skin and round glasses. They hold no papers, and there are no microphones, signs or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A show with acrobats, clowns and other acts, often in a big tent.

sentence.text: The circus is in town this week.

scene: Inside a big red-and-white striped circus tent full of people, an acrobat in a plain blue costume swings high on a trapeze under the bright lights, and below in the ring a clown with a red nose and big yellow shoes juggles while the audience laughs and claps. There are no animals, signs, banners, letters or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person whose job is to watch swimmers and help them if they are in danger.

sentence.text: The lifeguard is watching the swimmers.

scene: On a sunny beach, a lifeguard in her twenties with tan skin and a black ponytail, in a plain red swimsuit, sits on a tall white wooden chair and looks out at the swimmers in the sea through plain black binoculars, with a red rescue float on her lap. The swimsuit, chair, float and binoculars have no crosses, letters, numbers, symbols or writing, and there are no flags or signs. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: To draw something quickly with a pencil.
definition.ja: スケッチする、素描する

sentence.text: He is sketching the old bridge.

scene: On a low stone wall by a river on a sunny afternoon, a man in his sixties with light skin, gray hair and round glasses, in a plain blue linen shirt and plain brown leather shoes, sketches an old stone bridge in a sketchbook on his knee with a pencil. The drawing on the page shows only pencil lines of the bridge and the water, with no words, numbers or signature, and there are no signs or writing. His wrists are bare.

definition.en: To shout with joy, or to shout to support someone.
definition.ja: 歓声を上げる、声援を送る

sentence.text: They are cheering for their team.

scene: In a cozy living room with plain blue walls in the evening, three friends in their twenties, in socks, jump up from the sofa and cheer with their arms in the air and their mouths open in joy, as their team scores on the big TV in front of them, which shows a green soccer field with tiny players: a woman with light skin and long red curls, in a plain green sweater; a man with deep brown skin and a short fade, in a plain yellow T-shirt; and a man with East Asian features and short spiky black hair, in a plain red hoodie. The TV is plain black with no logo, and the screen has no scores, numbers, words or logos. There are no shelves, books, pictures or writing. Their wrists are bare.

definition.en: A cream that keeps your skin from burning in the sun.

sentence.text: She is putting on sunscreen.

scene: On a sunny beach under a blue-and-white striped umbrella, a woman in her forties with deep brown skin and short gray curls, in a plain blue one-piece swimsuit, sits on a striped towel facing the viewer. She holds her left arm straight out in front of her, and with her right hand she rubs a streak of white sunscreen along her left forearm. She has only two arms and two hands, one arm held out and one hand rubbing it, and no other arm or hand appears anywhere. A plain white bottle stands upright on the towel beside her by itself, and nobody holds it. The picture shows her from the waist up, large in the frame, with the sea behind her. The swimsuit has no logos, stripes, marks or writing, the bottle has no label, letters or pictures, and there are no signs or writing. Her wrists are bare.

definition.en: A person who takes part in a contest.

sentence.text: The contestant is showing her cake to the judges.

scene: At an outdoor baking contest in a sunny garden, a contestant in her fifties with medium brown skin and short black hair with gray streaks, in a plain white apron over a green dress, proudly holds out a tall three-layer cake with berries on top to three judges sitting at a long table: a man in his sixties with light skin and a white mustache, a woman in her thirties with East Asian features and short black hair with bangs, and a woman in her forties with deep brown skin and short locs. Other contestants in aprons wait behind her with their cakes. There are no numbers on the aprons, and there are no name cards, banners, signs or writing. Their wrists are bare.
